For more than a decade, Numerator has pioneered and led the science of representing consumer purchasing behavior across retailers, channels, brands, categories, demographics, and geographies.

As Director of Data Science, you will lead the team responsible for Numerator's consumer panel — the quality, currency, and representativeness of the signal at the heart of our data. Your team owns how well the panel reflects the population, how we understand where it doesn't, and the methodologies that keep it accurate, current, and trustworthy. You'll partner closely with Market Science, Engineering, Product, and GTM to turn that signal into products and estimates clients rely on.

We’re looking for a leader who enjoys challenging assumptions, translating client needs into innovation, and developing exceptional data scientists. You should be equally comfortable debating statistical methodology, mentoring a team, partnering with Engineering and Product, and explaining complex concepts in language that drives better business decisions.

What You'll Do:

Team Leadership:

Lead, coach, and develop a team of data scientists and data science managers focused on consumer behavior, panel methodology, and measurement science Grow the leaders on your team — developing managers, not only individual contributors — and raise the technical bar through mentorship, methodology reviews, and adoption of modern statistical approaches Foster a culture of scientific curiosity, rigor, and peer review, where decisions are grounded in evidence and healthy debate rather than precedent or intuition Build an AI-native data science team by thoughtfully integrating AI into research, experimentation, software development, and scientific workflows — helping scientists move faster while maintaining rigorous standards Maintain regular engagement with clients to deepen understanding of their challenges, build confidence in Numerator's methodology, and keep client needs central to the team's priorities 

Consumer Science & Methodology 

Own the quality, currency, and representativeness of the panel signal end to end — advancing methods for attribution completeness, compliance, anomaly detection, and keeping panelist demographics current Characterize how the panel represents — and mis-represents — the population, treating that as a first-class, proactive modeling discipline rather than reactive data cleanup Steward the panel as a living asset, partnering across the business on recruitment, engagement, and panel health, and turning evidence of where the panel is thin into targeted, prioritized investment Design methodologies that improve the stability, consistency, explainability, and scientific defensibility of Numerator's consumer data 

Statistical Innovation

Challenge existing approaches through first-principles thinking, and research, prototype, and productionize new statistical and machine learning methods where they strengthen the platform Partner with Market Science to advance the statistical foundations of Numerator's products 

Cross-Functional Leadership

Partner closely with Market Science, Engineering, Product, and GTM — contributing the deep panel understanding that powers the broader measurement system, and translating scientific advances into scalable product capabilities Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences Balance scientific rigor with practical business impact and client value 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

8+ years applying advanced statistical modeling to large, complex, real-world datasets Experience leading data science teams, including developing managers or leading through other leaders Deep expertise in statistical modeling, machine learning, and probabilistic reasoning Strong grounding in panel, survey, or sampling methodology — weighting, representativeness, and measurement science Experience working with noisy observational data and developing methods to improve data quality, representativeness, or inference Experience developing production methodologies rather than exploratory analyses, and designing statistical systems rather than simply applying existing techniques Strong programming skills in Python, with working knowledge of SQL Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex statistical concepts to diverse audiences, including external/client audiences 

You'll stand out if you have:

Experience with Bayesian statistics, hierarchical modeling, probabilistic inference, or state-space models Experience with causal inference, experimental design, or behavioral modeling Experience developing statistical methods for consumer, retail, marketing, or longitudinal datasets A demonstrated ability to challenge existing methodologies and introduce new scientific approaches into production A systems-thinking approach that considers how improvements in one area influence the broader measurement platform

rows.title: Software Engineer II
rows.descriptionText:
Domino’s is a purpose-inspired, performance-driven company powered by exceptional people who are committed to feeding the power of possible—one pizza at a time. Founded in 1960 as a single store in Ypsilanti, Michigan, Domino’s has grown into the largest pizza company in the world, with more than 22,300 stores across 90+ markets. Our success is built on the strength of our people, technology, and franchise system. As a leader in innovation, we continue to transform the pizza and QSR industry while creating opportunities for team members to learn, grow and thrive. If you're ready to make an impact, build a meaningful career and help shape what's next, there's a place for you at Domino's.

Job Description

A Software Engineer II is proficient with the most-often used features of the programming language, its core library, commonly used 3rd party libraries, and commonly used code management and build tooling.

Initially a Software Engineer II is expected to be able to develop a medium set of defined, inter-related modules, articulate why the code and application they are working on are designed the way they are, and be able to provide some instructive feedback to newer developers through code reviews and in-person Q&A. As they progress, they should be able to implement smaller subsystems independently, begin to design small portions of the systems, and begin to understand the design principles and practices that cut across all the applications.

The goals of a Software Engineer II are:

Develop an understanding of why some libraries, frameworks, and tooling are designed the way they are: what tradeoffs were made? why might the developer have done that? Through this work, develop an understanding of the practical use of design patterns. Begin to understand some of the externalities associated with running an application: performance, security, operations, monitoring, etc. Be able to troubleshoot application, infrastructure, and environment issues. 

Or, more succinctly, the Software Engineer II is gaining the ability to determine why things are done in a particular way and apply that knowledge to new situations.

General Responsibilities

Development - 90%

Produces estimates for their assigned tasks given well defined business requirementsProduces quality code that meets internal and industry standardsPromotes reusability within the application they are developingWrites performant code according to industry standards and project/organizational KPIsUnderstands business concepts in their area of focusWrites clear documentation to ensure code is understandable to provide wider focus and understanding into design decisionsProvides input into designs for assigned tasksTranslates designs into code for their assigned tasksUnderstands build/deployment processes and can support moving their code and any other changes (ex: database) through these phases. Creates build/deployment artifacts as neededSupports production systems through troubleshooting/triaging issues and providing on-call support where needed

Mentoring - 10%

Participates in PR reviews with others on their teamProvides feedback by answering questions from newer developers

Qualifications

Basic understanding of design methods/patterns such as DRY, SOLID, ReSTExcellent team player with good communication skills with both non-technical & technical co-workersHighly motivated and driven by a desire to solve difficult problems, and learn new technologyProficient in writing quality unit testsProficient with build and debug toolsExperience with profiling toolsExperience with continuous integration systems like Jenkins/GitHub and version control systems like GitExperience with development of internationalized software (multi-lingual, multi-currency, geographic, and locale awareness) Experience with agile practices and tools preferred (Jira or similar)Experience with database concepts (queries, data models)Understanding of development in a distributed system is preferredUnderstanding of basic networking concepts like http protocol and its usage is preferred

Native App Qualifications

5+ years overall development experience using an object oriented language Proficient in Kotlin and/or Swift Demonstrable proficency with XCode and/or Android Studio Demonstrable experience with Java and/or Objective-C. Demonstrable experience consuming Restful JSON web services Demonstrable experience with Agile development and unit testing. Demonstrable experience with push notifications, location services. Experience with various architecture patterns like MVC, MVVM, VIPER, or similar Experience with accessibility frameworks Experience with analytics frameworks such as Firebase, Adobe, or similar Experience builds tools like Gradle and Fastlane Knowledge of submitting and publishing applications through app store

Additional Information

Benefits:

 Paid Holidays and Vacation   Medical, Dental & Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment No-cost mental health support for employee and dependents Childcare tuition discounts No-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs Fertility benefits Adoption assistance 401k matching contributions   15% off the purchase price of stock   Company bonus  

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

rows.title: Senior Manager II, Client Sales and Insights - Sales Agency & Specialty Retail
rows.descriptionText:
Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer-packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action. Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 

What will you be doing?

As a Senior Manager II on Circana's Sales Agency (Broker) and Specialty Retailer team, you will play a critical role in managing and growing strategic client partnerships. You will serve as a trusted advisor to assigned clients, proactively engaging with key stakeholders to ensure Circana's insights, data, and solutions are aligned with their business priorities, growth strategies, and evolving market needs.

This role is responsible for supporting and executing account growth strategies, identifying and developing new business opportunities, and expanding client adoption of Circana's broad portfolio of solutions, including syndicated data, AI, technology and data integration capabilities, and other offerings. You will work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to deliver client value, strengthen relationships, and drive long-term revenue growth.

Success in this role requires balancing account leadership with operational execution. You will partner closely with Client Service, Product, and Commercial teams to ensure solutions are delivered accurately, on time, and with measurable business impact for clients. The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, has strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and has the ability to uncover client needs and position appropriate solutions.

Job Responsibilities

Build Client Relationships: Serve as the trusted day-to-day partner to expand client relationships and drive collaboration. Consultative Selling: Identify and pursue opportunities to expand Circana products/solutions with clients by aligning with their strategic goals. Achieve Revenue Targets: Contribute to achieve team sales goals through disciplined pipeline management and strategic account planning. Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with internal teams (e.g., Client Service, Extract/Technology, Product, and Consumer) to deliver integrated solutions and ensure client success. Maintain Industry Expertise: Stay current on trends in retail, CPG, and general merchandise to position Circana as a thought leader and trusted advisor. Utilize Sales Tools and Platforms: Leverage Circana’s proprietary platforms (e.g., Unify+, Liquid Data, Extracts/Intelligence Suite) to support client engagements and solution delivery. Champion Client Success: Ensure client satisfaction by proactively addressing challenges, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering consistent value. Advanced Analytic Skills: Demonstrated ability to conceive, manage, and deliver fact-based analyses, including consumer solutions, providing clients with clear, actionable insights to inform strategy. 

Requirements

5+ years of experience working with syndicated POS data utilizing Circana/IRI/NielsenIQ tools. Background in sales and/or marketing within a Consumer-Packaged Goods (CPG) company or Retailer or comparable data-driven environment. Ability to listen and understand client’s needs and translate into business questions to be answered through available data sources. Demonstrated ability to translate data and analysis into compelling, business-relevant insights. High proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and syndicated data tools like Unify+. Strong project management and organizational skills; able to balance and prioritize multiple priorities. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels. Consultative, solution-oriented approach to both client and internal team interactions. 

Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Remote, USA.

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $100,000.00 to $125,000.00 USD.

This job is also eligible for bonus pay.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

You can apply for this role through the Circana careers website or Intranet site for internal candidates. This role is subject to AI-assisted screening. Circana uses artificial intelligence (AI) to assess resumes for alignment with job requirements by helping locate details in resumes that relate to the job description.

This position is expected to remain open for approximately 30 days and may close earlier if sufficient qualified candidates are identified.

rows.title: Data Triage Manager
rows.descriptionText:
We’re reinventing the market research industry. Let’s reinvent it together.

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow’s success starts with today’s market intelligence. We empower the world’s leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it.

Numerator is looking for a Data Triage Manager to lead our Data Triage team within the Product Business Intelligence organization. This is a dual-focused role in which you will act as both the people leader for the team and the product owner for the data triage function. You will work with an established and rapidly evolving platform that handles millions of requests and massive volumes of events and other data, and you will be accountable for how quickly and reliably data quality issues are surfaced, prioritized, and resolved.

This position blends people leadership, product management, and hands-on technical judgment. As a people manager, you will coach, develop, and grow a team of analysts responsible for identifying, diagnosing, and driving resolution of data quality issues. As a product owner, you will define the roadmap and priorities for data triage—turning recurring problems into scalable, systemic solutions and partnering closely with Product, Data, and Engineering teams. You'll set the standards, processes, and metrics that keep our data trustworthy, and you'll translate what the team learns into insights that inform decisions across the business.

What You'll Do: 

People Management

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of data triage analysts—setting goals, managing performance, and supporting career growth in a fast-paced environment Establish and scale the processes, workflows, and best practices the team uses to diagnose and resolve data quality issues Own team capacity and workload, ensuring the most impactful issues get the right attention at the right time 

Product Ownership

Own the roadmap and priorities for the data triage function, balancing urgent production needs against longer-term scalability and prevention Translate recurring data quality problems into clear requirements, and partner with Product, Data, and Engineering teams to drive durable solutions Define and track the key metrics for data quality and triage performance—issue volume, time to resolution, recurrence—and use them to guide decisions and communicate impact Explore opportunities to adopt and integrate AI into the team's tooling and workflows—using it to accelerate triage, automate repetitive work, and improve data quality at scale 

Technical & Analytical

Work alongside the team to identify and diagnose data quality issues, communicating findings and potential production impacts clearly Identify opportunities for analytical and process improvement, and contribute to the design and implementation of solutions and automation 

Cross-functional & Communication

Provide regular reporting and insights that support operational planning and strategy execution Communicate results and business impacts to both technical and business audiences Support senior leadership by preparing analyses that inform business growth initiatives Help create and maintain dashboards and scorecards, ensuring accurate and timely data delivery 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

BS in Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Physics, or other behavioral and/or equivalent quantitative science 8+ years of experience in data analytics, data operations, or a closely related field 3+ years of experience managing or leading data or analytics teams Experience in a product management or product-owner capacity, including owning a roadmap and prioritizing across competing needs Working proficiency in SQL—enough hands-on technical ability to investigate data and partner credibly with engineering, without needing to operate as a full-time engineer Familiarity with building or maintaining internal dashboards and reporting tools such as Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar platforms Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across teams, deliver results autonomously, tackle complex problems with sound judgment, and lead both people and projects in a dynamic, fast-changing environment Strong analytical skills with an ability to identify trends and translate data into actionable insights Effective communication skills tailored to both technical and non-technical audiences Passion for data and curiosity in uncovering meaningful questions and opportunities through analysis Curiosity about AI and a demonstrated interest in adopting and integrating new AI tools and techniques to improve how work gets done

How You’ll Make an Impact

Epsilon is building the next generation Retail Media Network (RMN) platform to power onsite advertising at scale, leveraging services from our industry-leading platform that already serves billions of offsite ads across the open web. Our vision is a unified platform for both onsite and offsite ads, delivering low-latency, high-throughput performance across the board. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Core Platform Engineering team, someone with a self-starter mindset who thrives with minimal direction, can quickly grasp business and technical goals, and takes ownership from concept through delivery. This is a high-impact role where you’ll shape the architecture, optimize performance, and ensure our systems are built for scale, reliability, and innovation. You’ll be at the forefront of building a next-generation advertising platform that combines the speed and sophistication of programmatic ad serving with the personalization and commerce power of retail media. Your work will directly shape how millions of users experience advertising across top retailers and brands.

What You’ll Achieve

Design, implement, and maintain high-performance, low-latency services for advertising.Collaborate with product, platform, and operations teams to integrate new capabilities into the platform.Optimize system performance, fix production issues, and eliminate bottlenecks across the stack. Contribute to frontend integrations (SPAs, dashboards, tools) when needed, ensuring seamless workflows for internal and external users.Partner with data engineering teams to design and integrate event tracking, analytics, and reporting pipelines.Champion code quality, testing standard processes, and CI/CD automation.Deliver mission-critical enhancements enabling fast, accurate, and scalable ad delivery.Build robust, future-proof services and interfaces that empower rapid feature development.Improve system observability, monitoring, and fault tolerance.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience).6+ years of experience in backend and/or full stack software development.Strong backend expertise in Java, with experience in high-performance, distributed systems.Experience with streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis, Pulsar).Proficiency with relational databases (SQL) and NoSQL data stores.Understanding of low-latency, high-throughput architectures and clean software design principles.Experience building SPAs with TypeScript and modern frameworks (Angular, React, or similar).

Why You Might Stand Out From Other Talent

Master’s degree or 10+ years software engineering experience.Experience in ad tech, especially ad serving, RTB, or programmatic platforms.Familiarity with cloud-native environments (AWS, Kubernetes, Docker).Experience with large-scale event tracking, data pipelines.

Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision, 1 Voice.

Because You Matter

rows.title: Lead Franchise Business Consultant
rows.descriptionText:
Domino’s is a purpose-inspired, performance-driven company powered by exceptional people who are committed to feeding the power of possible—one pizza at a time. Founded in 1960 as a single store in Ypsilanti, Michigan, Domino’s has grown into the largest pizza company in the world, with more than 22,300 stores across 90+ markets. Our success is built on the strength of our people, technology, and franchise system. As a leader in innovation, we continue to transform the pizza and QSR industry while creating opportunities for team members to learn, grow and thrive. If you're ready to make an impact, build a meaningful career and help shape what's next, there's a place for you at Domino's.

Job Description

This role is responsible to drive franchisee business results within assigned portfolio . The Business Consultant will provide leadership and coaching to franchisees. The business consultant is expected to discuss the state of the business and provide recommended tactics to improve overall performance and ensure contractual compliance and adherence to brand standards. This would include areas of the business, such as but not limited to: sales, profits, operations, products and store builds/acquisitions. This position also must be able to work cross-functionally and understand how to engage with Center of Excellence support teams.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:

Key Responsibilities: 

Accountable for owning the Franchisee relationship, achieving results, and driving/leading change for success. Achieve portfolio objectives in the areas of new unit store growth, sales, and profitability by ensuring execution of market specific business plans and commitments. Partner with Franchisees to develop plans, using insights, data, analytics, knowledge, and past experiences to drive short, medium, and long-term goals for Franchisee enterprises. Partner with appropriate cross-functional COE and services and support teams such as Marketing, Development, Supply Chain, Training, Finance, Operations Support, to launch and achieve targeted results for business plans and initiatives. Deliver complex and/or difficult messages to franchisees. Plans field time appropriately to gain efficiencies and utilizes all systems and tools needed to execute highly effective in-market and virtual Franchisee visits. 

Execution & Standards:

Responsible for understanding, interpreting, upholding and enforcing consistent execution of our standards and franchisee agreements to ensure food safety, menu compliance and trademark protection. Field initial variance requests from franchisees and escalate as appropriate. Communicate National Promotions and rationale to drive engagement within the Domino’s franchise system. Manage the SFA and the contractual relationship. Follow up with individual compliance issues with franchises including all CQ7 defaults cures, second attempt ops cures and issuing ops cures based on the ops support teams recommendations. 

Provide Business Insights: 

Have a clear understanding of industry and economic factors that impact profitability and recommendations for how to combat these factors. Complete regular SWOT analyses to assess the needs of your assigned portfolio. Partner with COEs to develop plans to address any gaps identified. Act as an expert on the Domino’s business and a resource for information to the marketplace. Facilitate franchise peer connections and best practice sharing when applicable. Understand and adhere to the legal guardrails when providing insights and recommendations

Portfolio Management:

Serve as the local consultant by delivering sales analyses to assess the overall health, and identify growth opportunities, at the market and franchisee level, by utilizing available proprietary tools/resources. Facilitate regional meetings, such as business planning meetings that are tailored to the specific needs of the DMA/franchisees. Follow up of all new product and process roll-outs in their region/markets. Partner with the marketing COE to recommend local marketing plans and initiatives and drive franchisees understanding and engagement of these programs. Including co-op spend, local coupons and pricing. Responsible for training the franchisees on new products and initiatives. Leverage development resources (SIMMS, CoStar, Development COE) to identify targeted development opportunities and cultivate development discussions with FranchiseesNegotiate development agreements with Franchisees to include store growth commitments, store opening schedules and incentivesCoordinate contractual deliverables with Legal and Franchisees for new DAs and oversee post-contractual work related to addendums, incentives, relocations, terminations, etc. Provide regular reporting to the Regional Leadership Teams and the Development COE, leveraging Domino’s ConnectManage site approval process and transition development project to the Construction Team

Brand Engagement/Franchise Relations: 

Collaborate with peers to develop business cases and best practices that can be shared across the system. Be an advocate for continuous team development and people growth.  Be the primary point of contact for all business and brand matters for the franchisee. Grow Franchisee pipeline by assisting current franchise owners in how to identify future franchise candidates and place them in the FMS program. 

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business or related fieldWith a minimum of 5years of proven experience in a multi-unit operations or consulting, QSR and/or franchisee experience preferredExperience in a multi-unit environment, knowledge of retail or restaurant industry operations and financial reportingStrong verbal and written communications skills, including public speaking, with an ability to clearly articulate concepts and programs to a variety of audiences. Ability to read and interpret financial statements, strong analytical skills. Strong ability to multi-task and prioritize multiple projects and requests simultaneously, within an intense, deadline-driven environment. Proven ability to build relationships and work effectively with others at all levels of an organizationDemonstrated ability to lead, motivate, hold accountable, develop, and direct. Strong organizational, interpersonal, problem solving and influencing skills. Proficiency in computer skills, i.e. Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, PowerBi, MicroStrategy, etc. Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% of the time. (Some overnight travel required)

Additional Information

Benefits:

 Paid Holidays and Vacation   Medical, Dental & Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment No-cost mental health support for employee and dependents Childcare tuition discounts No-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs Fertility benefits Adoption assistance 401k matching contributions   15% off the purchase price of stock   Company bonus

rows.title: Research Consultant
rows.descriptionText:
We’re reinventing the market research industry. Let’s reinvent it together.

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow’s success starts with today’s market intelligence. We empower the world’s leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it.

The salary range for this role is $73,000 - $90,000/year + Bonus

Numerator Verified Voices combines verified purchase behavior with mobile surveys to unlock consumer and shopper insights that build stronger brands. Powered by the industry's largest and most diverse consumer purchase panel, our Research Consulting team delivers unmatched insight into consumer influencers, behaviors, and opinions, and we deliver actionable, decision-driving insights for some of the world's leading brands.

As a Research Consultant on Numerator's Research Consulting team, you'll independently own client relationships across a core set of clients and ad-hoc projects. You will act as a trusted advisor to your clients by synthesizing complex data into clear insights, building compelling narratives, and delivering actionable recommendations that strengthen client partnerships and directly influence business decisions. You will guide clients to the right research solution - full-service custom, DIY, or do-it-together - while protecting scope, quality, and timelines. This role requires strong judgment, comfort operating with minimal oversight, and the ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, including thoughtful AI use, comfort with ambiguity, and clear client expectation-setting.

How You’ll Spend Your Time: 

Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients and ad-hoc projects, owning client relationships end-to-end, delegating to members of your project team as needed, and building strong cross-functional partnerships with Sales, Consulting, and Operations. Own the full project life cycle for client-specific work - from scoping and project design (including proposal writing and pricing as needed) through execution - covering project design, questionnaire development, sample definition, data tabulation and analysis, client-ready deliverables, and presentation of results. Design and deliver both custom, full-service research and tech-enabled, DIY survey solutions on Numerator's platform, guiding clients towards the right approach based on objectives, timelines, budget and capabilities. Support clients using Numerator’s platform by offering the appropriate level of help, whether that means answering questions, providing education, recommending A La Carte services, or supporting subscription-based work. Help clients understand what the platform can do, what support is available, and when a request may need a different service model. Set clear expectations before work begins by clarifying the client’s request, confirming timing and level of effort, and aligning on what is included. Manage scope carefully, especially when client needs fall in the gray area between in-platform support and full-service custom research. Apply a strong understanding of quantitative research methodologies, sampling approaches, industry standards, and intermediate panel structures to design high quality research. Identify opportunities for advanced analytics and effectively interpret results, partnering with internal analytics experts as needed. Go beyond reporting results to deliver high-level insights, strategic storytelling, and clear actionable recommendations tailored to client business questions. Use AI-enabled tools as part of a thoughtful, accountable workflow to improve speed, quality, synthesis, project planning, and deliverable development while validating outputs and maintaining Numerator's standards for accuracy and client readiness. Leverage Numerator’s shopper panel and collaborate with the Consulting team to create holistic, high-impact research designs and outputs. Contribute to broader client strategy in partnership with the account team and provide support for sales initiatives. Manage client workload and multiple projects simultaneously with minimal supervision/oversight required, prioritizing effectively while maintaining a high bar for quality and client service. Delegate appropriately to and mentor Research Analysts and Research Operations partners, providing clear direction, feedback and support. Travel, as required, to support the above responsibilities. 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience5+ years of hands-on quantitative research experience, including end-to-end ownership of custom research projects. Demonstrated experience working with clients to translate their business questions and objectives into a research design. Strong command of survey research methodologies, questionnaire design, sampling strategies and data analysis techniques. Advanced storytelling, data visualization, and presentation skills, with a track record of translating complex data into clear, actionable insights. Proven ability to independently manage and grow client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor to mid- to senior-level client stakeholders. Proven ability to manage multiple projects at varying stages simultaneously, with the ability to prioritize accordingly while maintaining superior client service. Comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment, including experience with or openness to tech-enabled and DIY research platforms. Strong technical curiosity and comfort supporting platform, self-service, or do-it-together workflows; able to translate platform capabilities and limitations into clear client guidance. Demonstrated AI fluency or strong willingness to build AI fluency: uses AI thoughtfully to support core work, understands tool limitations, validates outputs, and owns the final work product. Ability to operate in ambiguity, set clear expectations, and manage client boundaries in a consultative way. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

What We Offer:

An inclusive and collaborative company culture- we work in an open environment while working together to get things done, and adapt to the changing needs as they come. Market competitive total compensation package. Volunteer time off and charitable donation matching. Strong support for career growth, including mentorship programs, leadership training, access to conferences and employee resource groups. Great benefits package including health/vision/dental, Personal Spending Account, unlimited PTO, flexible schedule, 401K matching, travel reimbursement and more.

rows.title: Senior Principal, Product Management
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

As the Senior Principal, Product Management, you will set the vision and lead a transformative initiative to centralize Epsilon’s corporate data into a single source of strategic insight. You will own the product strategy for CIP and will rally cross-functional support to turn siloed data into enterprise intelligence. You’ll lead a small product team (including product managers and analysts) and work across Finance, Sales, Product, Operations, and IT to deliver a platform that empowers data-driven decisions at all levels. This high-impact leadership role demands both strategic foresight and hands-on execution. You will ensure CIP continuously delivers value, champion a data-driven culture, and position the platform as a trusted, indispensable tool for Epsilon’s business leaders.

Responsibilities

Vision & Roadmap: Develop and own the comprehensive product vision and multi-phase roadmap for CIP. Identify and prioritize high-impact analytics use cases (e.g., resource allocation insights, performance scorecards) that align with Epsilon’s objectives. Ensure CIP’s evolution keeps pace with technological advancements in data analytics and AI.Product Execution Oversight: Guide the end-to-end development of CIP data products, from concept through launch and adoption. Work with product managers, data engineering, and analytics teams to build robust data pipelines, integrate key source systems, and deliver intuitive user experiences (e.g., self-service analytics, conversational BI) that unlock insight for non-technical users.Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as the primary liaison to senior business partners. Work closely with leaders in Finance, Operations, Sales, and other departments to capture requirements and align CIP’s deliverables with their strategic needs. Secure collaborators' agreement for CIP’s capabilities, governance model, and rollout plans; keep executives engaged and informed about the platform’s progress and wins.Performance & ROI Management: Define clear success metrics and KPIs for CIP (e.g., user adoption rates, reduced manual reporting, decision-making speed). Monitor and report on these metrics and use data-driven feedback to refine the product strategy. Demonstrate CIP’s value through business outcomes and iterate on the roadmap to improve return on investment.Change Management & Adoption: Drive organization-wide adoption of CIP. Partner with enablement and communications teams to create training programs, demos, and success stories that encourage usage. Address cultural or process barriers to adopting the platform, positioning yourself as a champion for data-driven decision-making across Epsilon.Continuous Improvement & Innovation: Stay ahead of industry trends in data, analytics, and AI. Continuously scan for opportunities to enhance CIP’s capabilities – whether by introducing new technologies or improving governance and performance. Foster a culture of continuous improvement on the team, encouraging experimentation and learning to keep CIP at the forefront of innovative enterprise intelligence.

Qualifications

Strategic Product Leader: You have 8+ years of product management experience, including leading data-intensive or analytics products. You excel at setting a vision for complex products and translating broad business objectives into actionable roadmaps. A track record of driving enterprise data initiatives or BI platforms is highly valued.Cross-Functional Influencer: Outstanding communication and partner management skills. You can engage with C-suite and functional leaders, understand their needs, and inspire them around a data product vision. You are effective at breaking down silos, aligning cross-functional teams, and driving decision-making by consensus.Hands-On: While highly strategic, you aren’t afraid to get involved with the specifics of how things are accomplished. You have experience overseeing development teams or complex projects and can guide a team through planning, development, and launch of new capabilities. You have the discipline to drive projects to completion and the flexibility to adjust course based on feedback.Data & Technology Savvy: Strong understanding of modern data analytics technology (cloud data warehouses/Lakehouses like Databricks or Snowflake, data visualization tools, AI/ML for analytics). You appreciate the possibilities and limitations of data engineering and AI, enabling you to have meaningful technical discussions and make informed, high-level decisions about CIP’s architecture and features.Passionate Change Agent: You are energized by the opportunity to transform how an organization uses data. You have led or been deeply involved in change management efforts – implementing new tools or processes, driving adoption, and measuring success. Resilient and adaptable, you navigate challenges with a positive, forward-looking approach, keeping the team focused on the big picture.Education: Bachelor’s degree required (technical or business field preferred). An MBA or advanced degree in a relevant field (Data Science, Information Systems) is a plus, reflecting your ability to interface between technical teams and business leadership.

Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision, 1 Voice.

Additional Information

When you join Epsilon, we’ll create something EPIC together. We’re a global leader in data and identity, with deep expertise in digital media, clean rooms, customer data platforms, loyalty and marketing services. Positioned at the center of Publicis Groupe, Epsilon helps brands deliver personalized experiences at scale and build lasting customer relationships by unlocking the full potential of data and identity. Epsilon operates in 30+ countries across EMEA, the Americas and APAC, with more than 8,000 employees.

Check out a few of these resources to learn more about what makes Epsilon so EPIC:

Our Culture: https://www.epsilon.com/us/about-us/our-culture-epsilon

Life at Epsilon: https://www.epsilon.com/us/about-us/epic-blog

Epsilon Has Five Values That Define Our Culture And Guide Us As We Create Value For Our Clients, Our People And Consumers. We Seek Candidates Who Align With Our Company Values, Demonstrate Them And Make Them Meaningful In Their Day-to-day Work

Act with integrity. We are transparent and have the courage to do the right thing.Work together to win together. We believe collaboration is the catalyst that unlocks our full potential.Innovate with purpose. We shape the market with big ideas that drive big outcomes.Respect all voices. We embrace differences and foster a culture of connection and belonging.Empower with accountability. We trust each other to own and deliver on common goals.

Because You Matter

Benefits

As an Epsilon employee, you deserve perks and benefits that put you, your family and your finances first. Our benefits encompass a wide range of offerings, including but not limited to:

Time to recharge: Flexible time off (FTO), 14 paid holidays, paid sick timeFamily well-being: Parental/new child leave, childcare & elder care assistance, adoption assistanceExtra perks: Comprehensive health coverage, 401(k), tuition assistance, commuter benefits, professional development, employee recognition, charitable donation matching, health coaching and counseling

Epsilon benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms.

Epsilon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Epsilon’s policy is not to discriminate against any applicant or employee based on actual or perceived race, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy), marital status, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, mental or physical disability, religion, creed, color, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression (including transgender status), veteran status, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law. Epsilon also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories. Epsilon will provide accommodations to applicants who need accommodations to complete the application process. Please reach out to LeaveofAbsence@epsilon.com to request an accommodation.

For San Francisco Bay and Los Angeles Areas: Epsilon will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment in a manner consistent with the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance and San Francisco Police Code Sections 4901-4919, commonly referred to as the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. Applicants with criminal histories are welcome to apply.

Compensation Range: USD $132,800.00 - USD $246,600.00/Annually. This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the skills, qualifications, and experience of the applicant along with the requirements of the position, and the Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. Temporary roles may be eligible to participate in our freelancer/temporary employee medical plan through a third-party benefits administration system once certain criteria have been met. For regular roles, the Company will offer medical coverage, dental, vision, disability, 401k, and paid time off.  5+ years of software development experience in a scalable, distributed, or multi-node environment.  BA/BS in Computer Science or related discipline. At least 5 years of experience as a big data software developer. rows.title: Senior Business Analyst, Content Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
Description

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

As a Senior Business Analyst within the Content Analytics team at Audible, you'll serve as an analytical leader and trusted thought partner for our senior Content leadership team, as well as the primary analytics conduit for European Content teams. You'll be responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving the analytical frameworks and reporting processes that deliver critical KPIs and business insights across our organization.

Working in complex and often ambiguous problem spaces, you'll transform multi-source data into clear, actionable recommendations that drive long-term strategy. Your deep expertise in the Content business — spanning audiobooks, physical books, and/or other digital media — will allow you to proactively anticipate leadership questions and surface insights before they're asked. As a content data SME, you'll help drive data quality standards within your domain while making insights readily accessible through efficient, scalable, self-service solutions.

About You

You are an analytical leader who balances technical expertise with deep business acumen, particularly within the world of content. You excel at working cross-functionally, translating complex business challenges into robust analytical frameworks and long-term solutions. You're naturally curious, with a talent for looking beyond immediate data requests to identify the underlying strategic questions driving our Content business forward.

You thrive in ambiguous situations, delivering independently with strong judgment while continuously raising the bar on data processes and analytical best practices. Your communication skills are exceptional — you distill complex analyses into compelling, influential narratives for both technical and executive audiences. You build strong, trust-based relationships with stakeholders that position your insights to meaningfully influence business strategy and decision-making across the organization.

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will...

 Proactively identify complex or ambiguous business problems and serve as a thought partner to senior Content leadership — anticipating questions, designing long-term analytics solutions, and developing analyses and visualizations that address emerging business needs before they're raised Design and own end-to-end reporting processes that track KPIs, support business reviews, and enable self-serve data access — ensuring speed, reliability, and scalability; break down high-level metrics into constituent components and leading indicators that generate actionable insights and recommendations for MBR/QBR/HBR cycles Develop concise, impactful narratives and visualizations — including MBR/QBR documents and 6-pagers — that communicate complex trends, root cause analyses, and strategic recommendations to executive audiences; automate the identification of key dimensions driving metric variance to enable faster, more consistent analysis Apply deep content domain expertise — spanning production, distribution, and audience engagement — alongside awareness of micro and macro industry trends in books and digital media, to ensure analytics solutions are grounded in real business context Serve as the analytics conduit for European Content teams, facilitating analyses and surfacing insights that connect regional performance to Global team strategy Partner cross-functionally with data scientists, Business Intelligence Engineers, product managers, and business leaders to align analytical solutions with strategic objectives; own the effective communication of metrics and analyses across your organization, and identify when to bring in technical partners to unlock new insights Drive operational excellence and data governance by improving, streamlining, and/or eliminating excess processes; work with data owners to onboard new sources, guarantee data fidelity, and ensure consistency in metric definitions, documentation standards, and data quality Mentor and develop peers within your organization, modeling analytical best practices in design, delivery, and long-term scalability; develop clear documentation that enables both technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand and replicate reporting methodologies

About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic Qualifications

 Knowledge of advanced skills in Excel as well as any data visualization tools like Tableau or similar BI tools (familiarity with Tableau preferred) Experience in a data driven/analytical role Experience delivering complex, end-to-end analytics solutions independently in ambiguous spaces, with track record of generating recommendations that influenced organizational strategy Content-related experience, ideally with audiobooks, physical books, and/or other digital media Experience building relationships and running projects across multiple functions with diverse stakeholder groups

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience supporting executive reporting and business reviews, including ownership of MBR/QBR narratives or equivalent documents Demonstrated ability to drive operational excellence through process improvement, automation, or streamlining of data and business processes Understanding of data governance principles and practices, including metric definition standardization and data quality management Experience partnering with Business Intelligence Engineers or Data Scientists to apply advanced analytics techniques and unlock new data sources Ability to work a flexible schedule that occasionally accommodates US time zone meeting requirements Experience working with or supporting European markets or cross-regional teams

We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. rows.title: Effectiveness Manager, Media
rows.descriptionText:
Workplace: White City, London - 2 days a week in the office
The role
We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented, do-er to act as the guardian of our measurement framework and the engine behind its operations. In this role, you will have the opportunity to champion our sources of truth as well as plan, lead and unify the cross channel delivery of test & learn agendas.
Sitting at the intersection of our media channel leads and our analytics specialists, you will ensure our Marketing Mix Models (MMM) are fed with the right data and that our Test & Learn ideas are translated into rigorous, actionable experiments. 
Main responsibilities
MMM Operations 
 As the primary point of contact for all data sharing and queries from MMM partners, you will manage a timely process of gathering, cleaning, and formatting media delivery and performance data for our econometric models.Accuracy & Quality Assurance: Ensuring all shared data is accurately formatted and reflects the reality of our media activity across all platforms. Performance Interpretation and storytelling: Assist in interpreting model results, helping to translate statistical outputs into a clear story focused on which channels are under-performing, and where the opportunity for growth lies.Agency partner: Maintain regular contact with our econometrics agency partners. In this position you will manage the flow of requests, ensure adherence to briefs, and interrogate recommendations where necessary. Internally you will champion their work and ensure engagement with the output.Evolution and innovation: To maximise the impact and effectiveness of our model, you will consider opportunities to further improve the data feed. By maintaining knowledge of industry best practice, and building a strong relationship with relevant contacts, you will have the opportunity to maximise the impact of MMM throughout the wider business.
 Experimentation rollout
In collaboration with channel managers, you will manage the measurement framework and experimentation roadmap. In which we will detail our test and learn priorities that you will spearhead as the year goes on.Learning Prioritisation: Own the rollout of the experimentation and measurement roadmap. Ensuring the tests deemed most important are executed in timely and rigorous manners.The "Knowledge Bank": Maintain the central test & learn log. Documenting every outcome, and sharing those with wider stakeholders to ensure that learnings are actively used to ameliorate media plans.Technical Translation: Collaborate with specialists and analysts to take ambitious ideas from Channel Leads (owned and paid), and translate them into technical briefs for specialists to build. Initiative Support: Design and set up cross-channel Test & Learn initiatives, including A/B testing, Meta/Google Lift studies, and regional Geo-tests across both owned and paid media.
Skills you’ll need (minimum criteria)
Have demonstrable experience within a media business. Either agency (Data/Analytics/Planning/ Transformation) or an in-house effectiveness operations role.Experience with both paid and owned media with an ability to evidence the nuances in their measurement challenges.Proven experience working across multiple media channels.Proven experience working with, Marketing Mix Modeling, Multi-Touch Attribution, and Incrementality Testing.Familiarity with the “plumbing” of measurement - how pixels, APIs and Clean Rooms function to collect data.Experience managing relationships with third-party measurement partners.
Other things we’re looking for (key criteria)
You will be detail orientated - That could manifest in being able to spot errors that others may overlook, or to ensure excellence in every data sheet you share. You are highly organised and capable of managing multiple work streams between different teams with competing deadlines.

rows.title: Deputy Head of Video
rows.descriptionText:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism, and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals, and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.
We are looking for a deputy head of video to join the Guardian. This role reports to and supports the UK head of video in delivering our video strategy, overseeing daily editorial operations and ensuring the production of high-quality, impactful journalism.
The deputy head of video has particular responsibility for the Guardian's video news features, leading the delivery of ambitious original journalism on YouTube, establishing a distinctive video proposition that expands the reach and impact of our journalism.
Examples of the video news features team's work include the Green Line series and the On The Ground series, which sees our journalists reporting right from the heart of the action.
This position is offered on a permanent, full-time NUJ contract.
About the roleLead and line manage producers in the video news features teamWork closely with the head of video and the head of documentaries to help coordinate the commissioning and production of all longform features and documentaries produced by the GuardianWork with the head of shortform video in delivering the Guardian's video strategy across YouTube, Instagram and TikTok as well as the Guardian's own platformsAct as a senior editorial decision-maker for video content, deputising for the head of video and attending meetings on behalf of the department as requiredEnsure video output reflects the organisation's editorial values, standards and brandWork with editors and reporters throughout the Guardian to identify stories and reporting that can be developed into distinctive video news featuresDrive audience growth, engagement and watch time on YouTubeMonitor performance and audience insights to inform commissioning decisions and strategyEnsure efficient workflows and effective resource allocation within the news features video team to ensure projects are kept within budget at all timesCoordinate commissioning, production schedules and publishing priorities for news features videoSupport the head of video in coaching and developing the video department, helping to set best practicesFoster a collaborative, inclusive, dynamic and high-performing team culture.Collaborate with audience, social teams and marketing to maximise reach and engagement, and identify opportunities for experimentation and growthPromote video-first thinking and work with Project Berger teams on programmes which enable colleagues to develop video skillsThis is an office based role and will not involve regular on the ground shooting
About youSignificant experience in video journalism, digital publishing or broadcast newsSignificant experience as an executive producerStrong editorial judgment and understanding of journalistic standardsExperience managing editorial teams and production workflowsSignificant experience of shooting and editing videoProven track record of delivering a varied portfolio of high-quality long form video content for broadcast or digital audiencesStrong understanding of YouTube analyticsExcellent organisational, communication and leadership skillsAbility to make sound decisions under pressure and manage multiple competing priorities and deadlinesExperience commissioning freelancers and managing production budgetsActively demonstrate inclusive leadership by promoting equity, valuing diverse perspectives, and addressing barriers that affect your teamIdeally, you'll have a demonstrable ability to bring a diverse perspective to this role
We actively encourage applications from groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media.
We operate in a hybrid environment working at least three days a week from our offices in King's Cross in London.
Job share applications are welcome. If you are keen to apply jointly with someone else as a job share, you should make a single application and combine your application documents.
How to applyTo apply, please upload your latest CV and a cover letter which outlines why you'd love to take on this role, and why you're a great match for what we're looking for. The application form will also ask you to share examples of relevant work that you have executive produced.
We appreciate the time taken to prepare each application we receive. We do not use AI-assisted technology to review applications; every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team. Thank you for bearing with us during the screening process.
The closing date for applications is Wednesday September 23 2026.
All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to help your application, this includes providing documents in accessible formats or personalising the process to better support your needs.
Benefits at the GuardianYou'll have six weeks of annual leave per year (plus bank holidays) with the option to purchase an additional 5 days. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.
You are entitled to private healthcare, life cover, income protection, and eye tests. You can also opt in to dental insurance.
We have enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave policies in place. We also support our employees by offering an IVF, menopause, baby loss, and trans equality policy.
Culture and wellbeingWe want everyone to feel like they belong at the Guardian and we champion diversity of thought. Our various employee forums provide a platform to use their voice to foster an inclusive workplace. We became the first major media organisation to achieve B Corp status.
We offer tools to help you prioritise your wellbeing including access to our employee benefits platform which provides tailored support for health and wellbeing. In addition, we also offer free yoga and pilates classes. These run alongside our corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.
Our canteen has views overlooking the Regents Canal and caters for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

rows.title: Senior Software Engineer - Java, AWS
rows.descriptionText: Teamwork makes the stream work. Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.  What does the team work on?The Roku Enterprise Engineering team is at the forefront of building a robust, integrated, and scalable platform that powers critical business processes across the organisation. As a cornerstone of Roku's corporate strategy, this team is instrumental in automating workflows across all Business Systems, including Supply Chain, Finance, Sales Operations, and Human Resources. By challenging traditional approaches to workflow automation, the team leverages cutting-edge engineering practices and API-driven design to streamline internal processes, boost efficiency, and deliver innovative solutions. The team's expertise spans a wide range of technologies, including Java and Python-based MicroServices, AWS/GCP cloud backend systems, Big Data technologies like Hive and Spark, and modern web applications. With a globally distributed presence across the US, India, and Europe, the team thrives on collaboration, bringing together diverse perspectives to solve complex challenges. At the heart of their success is a shared commitment to technical excellence, creativity, a strong sense of ownership, and a collaborative spirit that drives impactful results for Roku's business operations.What is the role?Roku is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the Enterprise Engineering team, focused on designing, building, and deploying scalable web applications and services that power critical business processes. In this role, you will serve as a platform services developer, building innovative solutions using modern software frameworks and paradigms across a multi-tier, distributed architecture. You will drive architecture discussions, take ownership of new projects, and deliver high-quality software within tight timelines. You will partner closely with security, compliance, and cross-functional teams to ensure applications meet audit, security, and compliance requirements. This role requires a self-driven problem solver with a strong background in building large-scale software platforms, microservices, and cloud-based systems. You will also contribute to the continual improvement of engineering tools, cloud-based technologies, and development processes, playing an integral role in shaping the team's technical direction.How will I use AI at Roku?At Roku, AI agents do most of the keystroke-level coding. Engineers act as the technical leads for those agents — setting architecture, reviewing output, and ensuring everything meets Roku's quality bar. If you've already shipped features where an AI agent wrote the initial code and you steered it to production, or you've built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe a clear, repeatable workflow: how you prompt, how you scope tasks, how you drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.At Roku, we're embracing AI as a powerful tool to amplify human creativity, accelerate innovation, and deliver better results across the company. You already have experience using AI tools — or you're excited to learn how — to enhance your work, make smarter decisions, and collaborate more effectively. Whether you're in engineering, marketing, finance, HR, or any other team, AI will be part of how you work here. We want to talk to you.What are the responsibilities of the role?Design, develop, and deploy scalable web applications and services, contributing to web technology and framework stack decisions, use case design, and data model designDrive architecture discussions, take ownership and responsibility over new projects, and deliver high-quality software within tight timelinesPartner with security and compliance teams to ensure applications meet compliance, security, and audit requirementsParticipate in the continual improvement of engineering tools, cloud-based technologies and services, and development processesDefine and participate in Agile development processes, including scoping, technical design, estimation, coding, testing, debugging, code reviews, maintenance, and supportCollaborate with cross-functional teams and demonstrate strong communication skillsDevelop and maintain microservices using modern frameworks and cloud-native technologiesImplement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) workflows to support reliable and repeatable deploymentsWhat experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?5+ years of experience delivering multi-tier, highly scalable, distributed web applicationsDeep understanding of software architecture, object-oriented design principles, and data structuresStrong experience with test-driven development and test automationExtensive experience developing microservicesExperience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) workflowsDemonstrated ability to be proactive, self-driven, and make practical trade-offs based on business needsExcellent verbal and written communication skillsBachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experienceExperience developing finance applications is a plusWorking experience with Terraform is a plusExperience creating workflows for Apache Airflow is a plus What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com. What should I know about Roku's culture?Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. Our ambition is to be the home of the most powerful, entertaining, and inspiring stories for people all around the world.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Digital Content Lead in BBC Studios Audio. This new role will report directly to the Commercial & Business Development Director and will support our podcast production teams in developing and producing social-first video content that extends the reach of our podcasts via fully visualised episodes and short form clips and digital assets.

The role will act as the editorial lead for one or more social media accounts within BBC Studios Audio, delivering a coherent, consistent social media experience for audiences, ensuring each account delivers on the agreed social strategy, maximises engaged reach with the account's target audiences, delivers content of the highest creative quality, delivers commercial objectives for sponsors and advertisers and drives traffic around the BBC Studios Audio commercial portfolio.

WHY JOIN THE TEAM

This is key commercial role in the central Audio team, working with production teams who deliver a breadth of outstanding content, from impactful investigative serials such as To Catch A King and Things Fell Apart; long running prestige Radio 4 series such as Desert Island Discs and In Our Time; and an extensive slate of award-winning Comedy and Drama output. The Audio Unit has a mission to create and deliver compelling, premium audio to a wide-ranging global audience.

 Work with audio production teams to develop, produce, film and edit long- and short-form video content around select podcasts, collaborating closely with ad sales, marketing, media planning and distribution teams. Produce visual podcast episodes and social-first video content, optimising assets for digital platforms through editing, captioning, motion graphics and platform-specific formatting. Lead the editorial publishing strategy across social channels, including content planning, scheduling, targeting and YouTube optimisation, ensuring activity supports commercial and audience growth objectives. Support and upskill production teams in visual content creation, providing guidance on production workflows and best practice in partnership with the Head of Production. Line manage and develop a Digital Executive, overseeing workload, priorities and professional development. Build strong relationships with talent, influencers, brands and internal stakeholders to maximise audience engagement and support content launches and campaigns. Ensure all social activity is compliant with BBC editorial, advertising and governance standards, including community management and the responsible use of AI.

 Proven experience creating and delivering social media content strategies, managing communities, and using analytics to inform decision-making. Demonstrable hands-on experience producing social-first and long-form video content, including filming, editing, adding graphics/effects, and publishing across digital platforms. Strong understanding of podcast production and distribution, with a passion for audio and video storytelling. Ability to lead and influence stakeholders at all levels, driving new initiatives and contributing to strategic thinking. Strong planning and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing demands. Excellent understanding of audience behaviours across platforms and devices, using insights to shape content and engagement strategies.

 General Business and Strategy experience in a commercial organisation, demonstrating a sound business understanding. Experience of working in a matrix organisation. Experience of building and developing a successful team.
