rows.title: Senior Software Engineer, Web Development – AI
rows.descriptionText:
Teamwork makes the stream work. Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.   What does the team work on? The Ads Customer Interfaces team develops full-stack web application services, APIs, and UIs that provide a unified approach to interfacing with internal and external customers across Roku's suite of advertising products. Our mission is to provide the best-in-class user experience and service while aiming to delight users of our products by making their jobs easier and allowing them to focus on their customers instead of getting bogged down by tedious business processes. In this role, you will work as a key member of the Ads Customer Interfaces team. What is the role?Roku pioneered streaming to the TV and continues to innovate and lead the industry. While we are well-positioned to help shape the future of television and streaming media worldwide, continued success stems from experienced software engineers like you developing core features for the Roku platform.Our new Senior Software Engineer will be contributing extensively to our container orchestrated platform, bringing together some of the latest web technologies with Ai expertise to develop a truly scalable and responsive web applications. To be successful you’ll need extensive experience of building reliable and scalable cloud-based solutions, a strong background in software engineering and an appetite to keep on top of modern software practices. This is a great role for a senior professional who enjoys a high level of visibility and thrives on great business impact.The features and performance improvements you implement directly impact millions of users every day. This is a great role for an experienced professional who has innovative ideas for complex problems and can translate these ideas into ultra-reliable software.  How will I use AI at Roku? 
At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 
We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you. What are the responsiblities of the role? Design, develop and deliver high-quality web applications and back-end services with modern frameworks and technologies. Work as a part of a high functioning team consisting of UX designers, software engineers, dev-ops, quality assurance and product management. Build and integrate AI-powered features into web applications and enterprise tools. Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions to power chatbot interactionsWork both independently and paired with other team members to ensure efficient delivery of prioritised features. Take part in the planning and refinement of features along with the team to come up with innovative and collaborative designs. Develop new features and write test cases to ensure the quality of your code. Work with CI/CD tools to ensure that all software developed adheres to both quality and scaling requirements. Take a role in continuously improving our software delivery process, making it as efficient as possible, reducing wasteful activities and creating value. See a feature go all the way from design stage to being deployed into customer facing environments. Demonstrate the ability to dig deep to find solutions to challenging problems affecting our users.  What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku? Extensive expeirence in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern web frameworks (React, Next.js, Angular, Node.js, Express) on cloud-based technology, such as AWS and GCP. Experience of building large scale and low latency distributed systems. Solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, performance optimisation techniques, object-oriented programming. Experience using modern AI-assisted and agentic development workflows in day-to-day engineering using AI/ML APIs and SDKsHands-on experience developing RAG solutions or working with LLMs for chatbots is preferredIn-depth understanding of CI/CD and the tools used to implement them, such as Jenkins. Experience with software repository tools, such as GitLab and GitHub. Experience with productivity tools, such as Jira and Confluence. A good understanding of Agile practices. Ability to accurately estimate software tasks and work to schedule. Exposure to observability tools and practices (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana) are preferred. Understanding of databases and data architecture choices (SQL vs NoSQL, caching layers, and data access patterns)Track record of tuning performance and reliability for highly available services and web applicationsFamiliarity with web security fundamentals and secure engineering practicesBachelors of Masters Degree in Compute Science/Software Engineering or related subject  What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com. What should I know about Roku's culture?Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. rows.title: Head of Creator Technologies
rows.descriptionText:
Description

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

Audible’s Head of Creator Technologies is responsible for strategy, product, and execution in emerging technologies to scale creator offerings in support of Audible’s catalog expansion goals. The role will also work closely with partners in Audible’s Content organization to support and enhance Audible Creator eXchange (ACX) and new creator products. This role will work closely with Amazon partner organizations to leverage skillsets and technologies to deliver innovative technical solutions for creators. As per Audible’s People Principles: “We obsessively focus on other key stakeholders as if they are customers too: We serve the writers, actors, and other creative professionals who craft the words we deliver, as well as the people who live in the communities where we work. At Audible, we prize the capacity to see the world through others’ eyes.” Audible will continue to innovate on behalf our creators, finding new ways to attract and engage them. This role will lead a team of high-performing builders to deliver on Audible’s ambitious creator products and will help further establish Audible as the leader of the spoken word category we created.

This role will also serve as Audible’s Hub Lead in Cambridge, Massachusetts to ensure cultural continuity across Audible as well as localizing Audible’s Activate Caring mission. This is a senior leadership role directly reporting into Audible's Chief Technology Officer (CTO).

Audible's People Principles celebrate who we are and where we've been, and guide the way we work shoulder to shoulder to enhance the lives of our millions of customers. Our diverse team depends on differing backgrounds and perspectives to foster robust conversations that lead us to the right solutions for our customers.

About You

You are curious, innovative and entrepreneurial, you stay on top of tools, trends, technologies and best practices. You have a passion for marketing and the related industry technologies and challenges and the expertise, strategic thinking, technical depth, and leadership skills needed to play a crucial leadership role in driving Creator technologies and innovations. You embrace ambiguity and aren’t afraid of changing directions if something isn’t working out. You will lead an product engineering team focused on emerging AI capabilities (we could even leave AI out if there are any concerns as “emerging technologies“ works) that reach current and future creators globally.

As a Head of Creator Technologies, you will...

 Define the strategy and lead the full product and delivery life cycle of emerging creator technologies Work at both the strategic and tactical level to champion bold, innovative creator solutions Have ownership over creator stack tool decisions, technical implementation, resource & roadmap planning and issue remediation Manage the complete software development lifecycle: defining, prioritizing, designing, and leading implementation and testing of new features within an Agile environment Partner effectively with all levels of leadership and with key stakeholders in Marketing, Content, Legal, and Amazon partner teams Influence through data-driven business cases to drive decisions Represent, verbally and in writing, complex decisions, trade-offs, and potential strategies clearly to executives to help them understand the decisions they have to make Constantly strive to raise the bar on delivery, operational excellence, performance, and quality in a fast-paced agile environment Define, manage, and improve the software and product development processes by working closely with high-performance builders Coach and mentor our high-performing architects and engineers to help them grow their skills, enhance their knowledge of our systems and their ability to get things done, while enabling them to be future leaders who are focused on building a high growth and inclusive culture Architect and develop the innovative technical design and implementation approach with the overall product line goals and objectives in mind Own team’s operational excellence, including creation of and monitoring of metrics and alarms in a continuous process improvement environment Be a passionate builder of talent and teams: hire, coach, and mentor builders on the team

About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic Qualifications

rows.descriptionText:
Description

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

As a Senior Business Intelligence Engineer within the Customer Service Analytics team at Audible, you'll serve as a data-driven decision enabler for our Customer Service leadership team. You'll be responsible for designing, implementing, and

optimizing the reporting processes that deliver critical KPIs and business insights across our organization. Working with loosely defined problems, you'll transform complex data into clear, actionable narratives. Your role will be pivotal in

maintaining data governance standards while making insights readily accessible through efficient, self-service data solutions.

About You

You're a data storyteller who balances technical expertise with strong business acumen, particularly in the world of content. You excel at working cross-

functionally, translating business requirements into robust analytical frameworks. You're naturally curious, with an ability to look beyond immediate data requests to identify the underlying strategic questions that drive our Customer Service. You

thrive in ambiguous situations, delivering independently with minimal guidance while continuously improving data processes. Your communication skills are exceptional, allowing you to distill complex analyses into compelling insights for both technical and executive audiences. You establish strong relationships with your stakeholders that earn trust and influence decision-making.

As a Senior Business Intelligence Engineer, you will...

 Design, implement, and optimize BI solutions that effectively track KPIs and provide insights for business reviews and executive reporting, as well as develop dashboards that enable self-serve access to data, ensuring speed, reliability, and scalability Break down high-level business metrics into constituent components and leading indicators that provide actionable insights for leadership as part of monthly and quarterly business reviews Be a proactive thought partner, anticipating leadership questions and developing analyses and visualizations that address emerging business needs Automate the identification of key contributing dimensions to metric variance, enabling faster root cause analysis Develop concise, impactful data visualizations that communicate complex trends and insights effectively to executive audiences Develop clear documentation that bridges technical implementation with business context, enabling both technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand reporting methodologies Communicate findings and insights to stakeholders in a clear, concise, and actionable manner Balance stakeholder requirements with technical constraints while maintaining a focus on long-term solutions Serve as a data governance advocate, ensuring consistency in metrics definitions and data quality Partner with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and business leaders to align reporting with strategic objectives Invest in stakeholder relationships that build trust and enable insights to influence business decision-making

About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic Qualifications

 Experience with data analysis tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, SQL, Tableau, etc. 7+ years equivalent relevant experience in a data driven/analytical role or 5+ years with an advanced/technical degree in Analytics, Business, Operations Research, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Sciences (Political or Natural) or similar field Experience running projects across multiple functions with diverse stakeholder groups (cross functional, cross-geo)

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience supporting executive reporting and business reviews 2+ years prior experience in customer service analytics Ability to work in ambiguous situations with limited guidance Ability to work an adjusted or flexible schedule that meets the occasional needs of US meeting times Understanding of data governance principles and practices Track record of process improvement initiatives that enhanced data accessibility or quality Strong interpersonal skills with ability to build relationships

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

We are looking for a Creator Marketing Manager to help grow and accelerate Audible's creator ecosystem and product offerings globally. This role has an outbound focus — you'll be a storyteller, working across all external-facing channels (website, blog, paid media, SEO, email, influencer marketing, and events) to bring products together into cohesive messaging for Audible's audiences, particularly authors and narrators. You'll get exposure to both B2B and B2C audiences — working with end consumers who listen to audiobooks and the creators who produce that content.

You'll run integrated, multi-channel campaigns where all your marketing channels work together with consistent messaging and coordinated timing. You'll also build and manage the content strategies and editorial calendars that guide execution across these channels.

You'll have the opportunity to shape the future of Audible's creator products by translating the needs of authors, publishers, narrators, and other creative stakeholders into customer-centric strategies that inform technology, content partnerships, and marketing investment. Your work will surprise and delight the creators who bring content to our catalog across the globe. You'll contribute to defining our go-to-market strategy with an eye on expanding Audible's value proposition for creators, growing our content supply, and deepening relationships with the creative community that powers our catalog.

About You

You're a hands-on marketer who can flex between strategy and execution. You've run integrated campaigns across multiple channels and know how to coordinate messaging, timing, and content so everything works together — not in silos. You're comfortable building editorial calendars, writing briefs, managing paid media, and partnering with cross-functional teams to bring a product story to life.

You're a generalist and an athlete — someone who wears multiple hats and thrives in a fast-moving environment. You have a passion for data-driven results, a spirit that anything is possible, and an unapologetic focus on the customer. You thrive in a highly collaborative environment where people are driven, enthusiastic, and not afraid to take risks. Your mission (and ours) is unique: fill hearts, minds, and souls with premium audio content that entertains, informs, and enriches.

As a Creator Marketing Manager, you will...

 Define and deeply understand Audible's target audiences — both consumers and creators — and champion their needs throughout the organization Craft compelling product stories and messaging for existing and prospective customers by creating clear and consistent propositions articulated through effective messaging Run integrated, multi-channel campaigns with ownership across paid media, editorial content, email, social, SEO, and other touchpoints — ensuring consistent messaging and coordinated timing Build and manage content strategies and editorial calendars that guide multi-channel execution across website, blog, paid media, SEO, and other marketing touchpoints Partner with Product teams to understand the product story and translate it for external audiences — developing positioning and messaging that drives awareness, demand, and adoption Drive business case development, bringing together customer insights, research, financial data, and analytics to develop a perspective on revenue and profitability potential for new-to-market initiatives Partner with Finance, Analytics, and Data Science to define, measure, and report on success and opportunity areas Communicate marketing plans and campaign performance to stakeholders and leadership

About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic Qualifications

 Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements Experience building, executing and scaling marketing campaigns from concept to completion 5+ years of experience in product marketing and business strategy Experience in growth marketing, brand marketing, or audience marketing Experience in integrated marketing — building and managing content strategies, editorial calendars, and coordinating messaging across multiple channels (website, blog, paid media, SEO, email) Experience defining and driving new customer-centric products and features toward market launch rollout Experience in always-on/evergreen marketing programs such as lifecycle, retention, or sustained product marketing Bachelors Degree

Preferred Qualifications

 B2B marketing experience Experience working with sales teams on enablement or small business marketing Experience in membership-based or subscription business models Experience in digital content, media, or audio companies Experience managing external partners to develop marketing programs Experience working with creators

As an Applied Scientist, you will solve large complex real-world problems at scale, draw inspiration from the latest science and technology to empower undefined/untapped business use cases, delve into customer requirements, collaborate with tech and product teams on design, and create production-ready models that span various domains, including Machine Learning (ML), Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Reinforcement Learning (RL), real-time and distributed systems.

rows.title: Subscriptions & SSP Insights Manager, Premium Subscriptions

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Teamwork makes the stream work. Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.  What does the team work on?The Subscriptions & SSP Insights team is at the forefront of driving data-driven decision-making for Roku's Subscriptions business. This team is responsible for building out the data and information suite that the Subscriptions business runs on: the metrics, KPIs, reports, dashboards, deep-dive analyses, and more. By working closely with cross-functional teams, including Core Analytics/Data Science and Engineering, the Subscriptions Business Insights team will be a key enabler of growth and contribute to Roku's success. 
What is the role?Roku is seeking a Subscriptions & SSP Insights Manager, Premium Subscriptions to lead insights for our Premium Subscriptions business as it scales globally. This role owns the analytics that power high-value subscription offerings – spanning international expansion, bundling, partner performance in PS, and the tools our partners rely on to grow with us. You'll build out international analytics – bringing rigor and consistency to how we measure PS performance across regions, accounting for market dynamics. You'll also be an analytical voice as we re-envision the Partner Portal: helping solidify the metrics that drive partners’ decisions and guiding how self-serve reporting can deepen partner relationships and accelerate growth. Your insights will directly inform high-stakes decisions at the intersection of Product, Partnerships, Marketing, Finance, and Strategy, ensuring Roku builds a durable, global Premium Subscriptions business. This role is for someone with strong business acumen and genuine curiosity – someone who doesn't just report the numbers, but asks why they're moving, what they mean for the business, and what we should do next. For New York Only – The estimated annual salary for this position is between $145,000 -$157,500. Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location.This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off. How will I use AI at Roku?At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We value curious, adaptable builders, who can show how they’ve used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact. Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment. What are the responsibilities of the role?Own Premium Subscriptions insights: Define, track, and tell the story behind the metrics and KPIs that matter most to Roku's Premium Subscriptions business, across partners and markets. Drive international analytics: Build a consistent framework to measure Premium Subscriptions performance across regions – accounting for market maturity, partner mix, and local dynamics - and surface where the biggest global opportunities lie. Re-envision the Partner Portal: Partner with Product and Engineering to reimagine the data and reporting partners see - defining the metrics, views, and self-serve capabilities that help partners make better decisions and grow with Roku. Build and own reporting: Develop scalable dashboards and reporting that give stakeholders a trusted, real-time view of Premium Subscriptions health across products, geographies, and partners. Diagnose the drivers: Go beyond the 'what' to the 'why' – connecting subscriber behavior and market factors to performance and translating findings into clear business actions. Influence through storytelling: Deliver compelling dashboards, presentations, and narratives around Premium Subscriptions performance, tailored for executive and partner audiences. Cross-functional leadership: Collaborate with Subscription Growth, Partner Growth, Product, Marketing, and Finance to align Premium Subscriptions insights strategy with Roku's strategic goals. Operational excellence: Bridge technical expertise (Core Analytics, Data Engineering) with business stakeholders to ensure Premium Subscriptions and partner data is actionable and trusted. Champion a data-driven culture: Promote curiosity and insight as a foundation for Premium Subscriptions success across Roku and its partners.  What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku? 5+ years of professional experience in the Analytics & Insights space. Strong business acumen – you understand what drives a subscription business and can connect analysis to commercial outcomes and strategy. Genuine curiosity – you instinctively dig into the 'why' behind the numbers and aren't satisfied with surface-level answers. Exceptional storytelling and communication skills – able to translate complex analyses into executive-ready and partner-ready narratives and presentations. Strong Tableau skills, with the ability to build interactive dashboards that stakeholders and partners rely on. Advanced analytical skills, including SQL expertise and comfort working with large, complex datasets. Strong modeling ability in Excel. Experience working with international/multi-market data is a strong plus (regional nuance, cross-market comparability). Experience defining requirements for data products, portals, or self-serve reporting tools is a plus. Highly collaborative, with the ability to influence and align diverse teams – including external partners - around shared goals. Comfortable navigating ambiguity and prioritizing the highest-impact work in a fast-paced environment. Passionate about building lasting value for subscribers, partners, and the business. Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business-related field (Economics, Business, Marketing, Analytics). MBA or advanced degree is a plus.  What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com. What should I know about Roku's culture?Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

You will deliver the right technical solution (analytics- or data-product) to influence, guide, and force-multiply (via automation) our business functions, increase their effectiveness and efficiency, and hold them accountable. You will help drive continuous improvement by designing and building measurement frameworks, and other communications conduits (presentations and documents) to track initiative and business performance, driving focus on results and execution. You will frame hypotheses and potential decisions into a testable structure and develop robust experimental designs. You will leverage deep cross-functional knowledge to be a trusted advisor across a wide range of issues.

Alternate locations available: This position can also be located in Audible's Berlin or London hubs.

You are able to work with minimal instruction and oversight, conduct multiple high-stake tasks and projects simultaneously, and own deliverables end-to-end with limited dependencies on the work of others. You have the ability to think strategically, develop insightful analysis, and frame decisions, and communicate findings concisely to senior leaders in your and other organizations.

 Design and lead hands-on decision science initiatives that support Audible strategy and programs. Use causal inference methods (experimentation and models) to understand the incremental impact of our activity on business performance Learn and master the intricacies of our economics, understand pain points and opportunities, and provide solutions short-term and long-term Develop an in-depth knowledge of all relevant data sources, business intelligence technologies, data science, and analytical tools available to maximize their potential. Ensure and own the accuracy, relevance, quality, and impact of your deliveries Communicate crisply in both oral and written forms for different levels of audiences (Tech, non-Tech, manager to executive) Develop compelling presentations and documents

About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

 Experience in analyzing data to drive decisions 5+ years of relevant experience in the areas of Strategic Analytics, Business Intelligence, Decision Science, or Consulting in a digital environment or in a related field Degree in technology, mathematics or a related field, speaks of a person who is comfortable in data-centric environments Experience in developing data-driven products, and sharing business recommendation and their financial/customer impact with the stakeholders Experience managing challenging assignments with aggressive schedules Experience with programming languages (such as Python, R, etc.), SQL and visualization tools (Tableau, Microstrategy, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications

 Advanced degree, Business (MBA), MS, PhD or equivalent experience Previous experience in large B2C companies a plus Experience working with C-level leaders

rows.title: Senior Curation Editor
rows.descriptionText:
JOB DETAILS

BBC Studios — Commercial News

Location: Washington, DC Office (Hybrid - 3 days)

Schedule: Mon–Fri, 11am–7pm ET

WE ARE BBC STUDIOS

A globally renowned media company borne of the BBC. We make and distribute the world’s most sought-after TV, audio, and digital content. At Digital News & Streaming, our ambition is to entertain, educate, and inspire through world-class journalism in all forms. Our reporting takes you across the world and then provides the tools to live a more informed and fulfilled life.

BBC Studios is seeking a Senior Curation Editor for bbc.com, based in Washington, DC, reporting to the Lead Curation Editor. We continue to consolidate and enhance our BBC website and apps for global audiences, including in North America, and you will be a key part of the team curating this experience — managing the homepage and other key indexes during the US afternoon and evening window.

The right candidate will demonstrate strong editorial judgment, a sharp eye for engaging headlines and visuals, and a keen sense of US and global audience needs in the digital space. During your shifts, you will work hands-on in the CMS to ensure we always have a rich, timely content mix across the site and app. You will also contribute to daily editorial planning and curation strategy for major news events and special initiatives.

You will have experience with digital publishing best practices and optimization tactics, and a desire to deepen your understanding of analytics and develop your ability to draw actionable, real-time insights to improve engagement.

Success in this role requires close collaboration with colleagues across time zones — from Singapore and London through to the US East and West coasts. Strong communication, handover discipline, and organizational skills are essential, as is the ability to work autonomously during your shift while staying aligned with the team's editorial priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Curate and optimize content for bbc.com and the app, maintaining editorial integrity and responsiveness to breaking newsCraft compelling headlines and select impactful visuals, prioritizing mobile-friendly presentationPlan and execute real-time updates, push alerts, and long-term curation strategiesLeverage audience data and industry trends to enhance engagement and user experienceCollaborate with teams across BBC News, Sport, Features, BritBox, Audience Development, and Product to align prioritiesCommunicate effectively across time zones, managing handovers and stakeholder relationships with colleagues in Singapore, London, and New York to ensure seamless 24/7 coverageDocument clear handovers and flag technical issues promptlyParticipate in a rotating schedule for public holiday coverage, with occasional weekend work. 

Knowledge, Skills, Training And Experience

5+ years in digital journalism, with experience in homepage management, news curation, or digital publishingStrong editorial judgment and ability to prioritize under pressureDeep understanding of audience behavior, engagement strategies, and analyticsEffective communication and collaboration skills in a fast-paced, distributed environmentCommitment to impartiality and BBC's editorial values

COMPETENCIES 

Strong communicator — able to convey editorial decisions clearly to colleagues across departments and time zones, including non-specialists, and to communicate effectively with people working remotely across multiple BBC sitesAutonomous and problem-solving oriented — able to exercise sound editorial judgment and make confident calls independently during your shift, escalating when appropriateDetail-focused while maintaining a view of the bigger picture — brings precision to headline writing and content selection without losing sight of the overall editorial mix and audience goalsKeen to challenge the status quo and take initiative — proactively identifies opportunities to improve curation workflows, surface content more effectively, and drive positive changes across the teamFlexible and adaptable — able to sustain high performance under pressure and pivot quickly as breaking news, changing priorities, or evolving audience needs demand

Benefits And Perks

100% Employer-Paid Medical and Dental Insurance (PPO plans)Generous Paid Time OffFlexible, Hybrid Working ArrangementsStrong commitment to work/life balanceFree Retirement Consulting for all employeesPet InsuranceCommuter BenefitsGym Reimbursement

Compensation

The anticipated annual base salary for this position is $90,000 to $100,000. The actual base salary offered depends on the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and geographic location of the position.

rows.title: Product Owner (Technical)
rows.descriptionText:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Role

The Product team shapes the experiences that power Revolut. They turn complex problems into simple, scalable solutions — working across design, engineering, and data to build features our customers love.

We’re looking for a Product Owner who knows how to take responsibility over their product roadmap, including day-to-day operations, project execution, and addressing risks. From conception to launch and beyond, you’ll collaborate cross-functionally and communicate with senior management to be the go-to person for your product.

If you have an entrepreneurial passion and drive to never settle, we’d like to hear from you.

What You’ll Be Doing

Setting your team's goals, success metrics, and roadmap to align with Revolut’s missionDriving maximum impact for your product based on data analysis, market research, and company strategyCompletely owning your team's products and features, from ideation, through development, to launch, growth, and maintenanceHaving technical discussions with engineers regarding approaches, requirements, etc.Collaborating with other stakeholders, such as Financial Crime, Legal, and Security teams

What You'll Need

2+ years of experience working with a high-growth tech company or in banking/finance-related business areas (acquiring, payments, cryptocurrency, insurance, etc.)2+ years of experience working on technical products (platforms, distributed systems, data science, machine learning, computer vision, robotics, etc.)1 year of experience managing people (Product Owners at Revolut directly manage Engineering, Operations, and Design team members)Outstanding written and verbal communication skillsHigh analytical and technical acumen along with solid business sense that guides ROI-based prioritisationExperience formulating and driving a focused product vision, and owning the narrative with leadership, customers, and partnersA bias towards action and bootstrapping major projects, rolling up your sleeves and being hands-onExperience developing and launching products from scratch The ability to provide insight and deliver measurable results for sophisticated products under ambiguous situations in a fast-paced environment

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

 Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

rows.title: Senior Data Scientist - Fraud Model Validation
rows.descriptionText:
Klarna, briefly

At Klarna, we're building an everyday finance network, helping over 120 million consumers across 26 countries save time and money, and worry less about their finances. Working here means taking on problems most companies never get to solve, and being hands-on enough that the interesting part of the work lands with you, not someone else — you'll build with AI, not watch it happen.

This is the stretch zone. Come find out what you're capable of.

About The Role

First-line fraud teams at Klarna build models against real-time attacks on payments, logins, and identity — trained on transaction volumes north of 100 million records and pipelines with hundreds of features. Your job is to make sure those models actually hold up: independently reproducing results, building challenger models, and stress-testing every assumption from data pipeline to production deployment before a model earns trust at scale.

This is a second-line position, reviewing methodologies built with scikit-learn, LightGBM, graph models, anomaly detection, and increasingly GenAI-based components. You'll also build your own tooling — agentic AI systems that read model documentation and code and surface risks automatically, so validation keeps pace with how fast first-line teams ship.

The scope spans the full model lifecycle: data integrity and feature engineering, conceptual soundness, deployment design across Docker, Jenkins, and AWS, and the monitoring and drift detection that keeps a model honest after launch.

What You'll Do

You'll assess model performance using fraud-specific metrics — precision/recall, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, cost-sensitive metrics, and fraud capture rate — and weigh each against its real business trade-off.You'll review transaction datasets exceeding 100 million records and feature pipelines with hundreds of features for representativeness, leakage risk, and bias.You'll evaluate drift detection, retraining strategies, and production monitoring practices to confirm they catch degradation before it costs the business.You'll assess CI/CD and deployment controls — Docker, Jenkins, and the AWS SageMaker, S3, Athena, and Lambda environments models run in.You'll evaluate model governance documentation, explainability approaches, and compliance with regulatory expectations on model risk, fairness, and data privacy.You'll validate emerging techniques as first-line teams adopt them — graph networks, behavioral biometrics, anomaly detection, and GenAI-based systems.You'll document validation outcomes and communicate model risks directly to first-line data scientists, ML engineers, and business stakeholders.

Who You Are

You've spent 3+ years hands-on in fraud-related modeling — transaction fraud, account takeover, identity fraud, or payments fraud.You know tree-based models like LightGBM, anomaly detection techniques, and graph or network models well enough to challenge someone else's implementation choices, not just build your own.You've worked across the full ML lifecycle — from feature engineering through production deployment and monitoring — and know where each stage tends to go wrong.You're fluent in Python and SQL, and you've used PySpark or Spark to process data at scale.You've built agentic AI workflows — not just used off-the-shelf tools, but designed the automation yourself.You understand model validation principles and model risk governance well enough to assess bias, fairness, explainability, and privacy risk, not just accuracy.You can take a complex model apart, explain what's wrong with it, and make that case clearly to both technical teams and senior stakeholders who aren't.

Bonus points for

An advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in a quantitative field such as data science, statistics, mathematics, computer science, physics, or engineering.Experience in BNPL, credit cards, or other transaction-heavy payment products.You've mentored junior validators or led validation reviews.Exposure to inference on rejected transactions and how fraud risk and credit risk overlap.Familiarity with AI governance frameworks and emerging AI regulatory requirements.

Things you should know before applying

Working together: we value co-located teams; most teams currently meet in the office 2–3 days per week, and this varies by team and can change over time.Non-obvious backgrounds are welcome. Diversity of skills, perspectives, and backgrounds is how we create, innovate, and disrupt like no other.Final compensation will be based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and experience.This is a second-line, independent validation position — you'll work closely with first-line fraud data science and ML engineering teams, without reporting into them.

Please include a CV in English. Concrete beats comprehensive — what you built, what it did, what it cost. Curious to learn more about Klarna and what it's like to work here? Explore our career site!

rows.title: Senior Analyst Markets Middle Office Trade Controls
rows.descriptionText:
JOB TITLE: Senior Analyst, Markets Middle Office Trade Controls

LOCATION(S): LondonHOURS: Full-timeWORKING PATTERN: Our work style is hybrid, which involves spending at least two days per week, or 40% of our time, at one of our office sites. 

Why join us?

This is an opportunity to join Markets Middle Office Trade Controls as it transforms from a traditional reconciliation function toward a contemporary, global control environment.You'll contribute to a team using product expertise, automation, analytics and AI-enabled controls to strengthen proactive risk management and provide deeper insight to the business. 

What you'll be doing

Markets Middle Office Trade Controls is evolving into a modern, data-driven control function. By combining strong product expertise with automation, analytics and AI-enabled controls, the team is moving beyond traditional reconciliations to provide proactive risk management, deeper business insight and greater value to its interested parties.As a Senior Analyst, you'll undertake and supervise intraday, or T0, reconciliations across a range of tradable products. You'll play an important role in protecting revenue, maintaining trade integrity and ensuring exceptions are investigated and resolved promptly.You'll work closely with Front Office colleagues, Markets platform teams and other support functions to resolve breaks, identify underlying causes and prevent issues from recurring. You'll also contribute to the development of a forward-looking control environment that aims to predict, prevent and resolve issues before they affect the business. 

Your key responsibilities will include:

Undertaking and monitoring intraday reconciliations across tradable products, including derivatives, foreign exchange, money markets, financial futures, bonds and repos.Investigating reconciliation breaks and exceptions, completing detailed analysis and supporting their timely resolution.Working with Front Office colleagues and support teams to request trade amendments, adjustments and updates.Ensuring T0 exceptions are cleared promptly to protect trade integrity and revenue.Completing root cause analysis across breaks, exceptions and associated reporting.Identifying trends and raising issues to relevant collaborators to help prevent recurrence.Using and updating automation tools with clear explanations of exceptions and the actions taken to resolve them.Working with Markets platform teams to understand and resolve systemic issues affecting Trade Controls.Reviewing reconciliations completed by colleagues to validate outcomes and retain control standards.Constructively challenging decisions and recommending improvements where appropriate.Following the daily control checklist and ensuring reconciliations, exceptions and reporting are completed by the end of the day.Supporting risk, control and audit activity in partnership with second- and third-line teams.Sharing technical knowledge and supporting colleagues to develop their understanding of products and control processes. 

What we're looking for



Essential skills and experience

Solid understanding of Middle Office control frameworks, including reconciliations, exception management and reporting.Experience of investigating and resolving reconciliation breaks or trade exceptions.The ability to identify and mitigate risk through a robust understanding of reconciliation processes and their role within a control environment.Good product knowledge across one or more relevant areas, such as foreign exchange, money markets, derivatives, financial futures, bonds or repos.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify trends and complete root cause analysis.A strong understanding of risk, control and audit processes.The ability to communicate clearly with Front Office colleagues, internal stakeholders and support teams.Confidence reviewing work, constructively challenging decisions and recommending improvements.The ability to respond positively to changing business needs, systems, processes and requirements.Strong attention to detail, with the ability to work to daily control deadlines and maintain accurate records.A collaborative and professional approach, with the ability to guide and support colleagues. 

And any experience of these would be great

Experience of working within Markets, Markets Operations or a Middle Office environment.Knowledge across multiple tradable products, including derivatives, foreign exchange, money markets, financial futures, bonds and repos.Experience of working with trade-processing or Markets platforms.Experience of automation, analytics or data-led process improvement within a control environment.Experience of supporting internal or external audit activity.Experience of working with second- and third-line risk and control teams.Experience of coaching colleagues or supporting the development of technical knowledge.An understanding of AI-enabled controls or their potential application within operational risk management. We know that great talent comes from many backgrounds. Whilst this job advert may reference specific years of experience, we recognise that skills are developed in many ways, so if you have relevant, transferable experience, we encourage you to apply. 

This is a place for you

Our ambition is to be the leading UK business for diversity, equity and inclusion, supporting our customers, colleagues and communities. We're committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, learn and develop.We offer reasonable workplace adjustments for colleagues with disabilities, including flexibility in office attendance, location and working patterns.As a Disability Confident Leader, we guarantee interviews for a fair and proportionate number of applicants who meet the minimum criteria for the role and have a disability, long-term health condition or neurodivergent condition through the Disability Confident Scheme.We also provide reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process to reduce or remove barriers. Just let us know what you need. 

We also offer a wide-ranging benefits package, which includes:

A generous pension contribution of up to 15%.An annual performance-related bonus.Share schemes, including free shares.Benefits you can adapt to your lifestyle, such as discounted shopping.28 days' holiday, with bank holidays on top.A range of wellbeing initiatives and generous parental leave policies.Ready to make an impact? Apply today.

rows.title: Data Science Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

This role is for Angstrom Sports, a proprietary sports pricing and product provider, building intricate, simulation driven pricing and risk systems to support the success of key sports brands across the Entain group.

Founded in 2018 and having established itself as a pioneer in player-level, play-by-play simulations and forecasting, Angstrom was acquired by Entain in 2023. Today, we operate as a semi-autonomous division, responsible for delivering the group’s most advanced pricing and risk capabilities with a focus on the US market. We’re committed to building the next generation of sports betting products — sports-first, recreationally-focused, and designed to make betting more engaging, more intelligent, and more fun.

We’re proud to be a high-performing, low-ego team where brilliant people are empowered and people work to become brilliant. While we’re ambitious and delivery-driven, we take real pride in how we operate and the health of our independent culture, underpinned by mutual trust and respect.

Job Description

We have an exciting opportunity for a talented organiser of people & projects to join our rapidly expanding Sports Analytics company based in London Bridge.

As Data Science Manager, you are responsible for managing the Leads of multiple sport-specific modelling teams. You ensure consistency, alignment, and delivery across the portfolio of models while supporting the career development of Lead Data Scientists.

You will work closely with the Head of Data Science on planning, staffing, and setting the direction for the function. You will be instrumental in scaling the data science capability and ensuring technical quality, delivery efficiency, and team cohesion across the department.

Key Responsibilities

Resource planning of the Data Scientists to optimise departmental objectives and tasks in ongoing projects.Manage, coach, and develop Data Science Leads across multiple teams.Support Leads in planning, prioritisation, and delivery of high-quality forecasting models.Help set and maintain a high bar in technical standards, code practices, and documentation across teams.Identify and address capacity, capability, or performance challenges across the department.Collaborate with Delivery and Engineering counterparts to maintain efficient team operations.Work with the Head of Data Science to shape department-wide strategy, tooling, and hiring plans.Facilitate cross-team learning, innovation, and the sharing of best practices.Act as an escalation point for technical or resourcing issues across teams.Represent the Data Science function in cross-departmental discussions or leadership meetings.Help maintain a collaborative, supportive, and high-performance culture across the modelling organisation.

Qualifications

Essential

Demonstrated success managing Data Science Leads and growing high-performing teams.Skilled in aligning delivery across multiple projects, sports, or technical domains.Strong technical background in model development and deployment, with the ability to support and challenge teams when needed.Advanced programming experience (R/Python/C#/Java)Excellent communication and leadership skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.Proven ability to manage hiring, performance, and team development.Familiar with cross-functional planning, prioritisation, and capacity management.Champions a culture of collaboration, experimentation, and delivery.Domain expertise in sports modelling or betting products.2+ years managing teams and leading delivery across multiple modelling projects

Desirable

Experience building or scaling data science functionsFamiliarity with model governance, risk, or compliance processes.Knowledge of tooling and infrastructure challenges across data and ML teams.Strategic thinking in resource allocation and modelling roadmaps.Passion for modelling excellence and deep awareness of current trends in applied data science.Experience using cloud services (AWS preferred)A degree (PhD, MSc, BSc) in a STEM subject or similar provable numerate and quantitative skills

Additional Information

At Entain, we know that signing top players requires a great starting package, and plenty of support to inspire peak performance. Join us, and a competitive salary is just the beginning.

Depending on your role and location, you can expect to receive benefits like:

Generous bonus schemeHybrid workingPrivate medical insurancePension Scheme - matched to 6%Ability to buy and sell holidayFree subscription to wellbeing app UnmindEntain & Enhance daysSharesave Scheme

Join a winning team of talented people and be a part of an inclusive and supporting community where everyone is celebrated for being themselves.

Should you need any adjustments or accommodations to the recruitment process, at either application or interview, please contact us.

rows.title: Data Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

About Entain

There's nothing like a career at Entain. We're a leading, global sports betting and gaming company and we're upping the excitement and increasing player safety. We're a FTSE company with iconic brands including Ladbrokes, Coral, BetMGM, Eurobet and bwin, and we have an energy that drives us to perform at the height of our potential. Whether you're an engineer, marketer or retail specialist, a career here is a complete game changer.

Job Description

This is a hybrid role. As a Data Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and building scalable, resilient data solutions that power analytics, marketing effectiveness measurement, and decision-making across Entain's industry-leading digital brands. You'll work at the heart of our data ecosystem, creating the platforms and datasets that enable teams to generate insights, optimise performance, and drive commercial growth.

Reporting to the Data Engineering Manager, you will be part of the Group Analytics Data Engineering Team, who build and maintain the data products and infrastructure that support analytics, econometric modelling, marketing optimisation, and regulatory reporting across the business. Working closely with analysts, data scientists, econometricians, and marketing stakeholders, you'll help deliver robust data solutions that improve budget allocation, campaign performance, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes.

Data and Analytics play a transformational role in how we create value today and shape our future. We have a bold ambition to become a world-class data and analytics organisation, helping our teams make smarter decisions and deliver better outcomes for our customers. This is an exciting opportunity to join a team that combines deep technical expertise with real business impact, working on large-scale data challenges that directly influence how we invest, grow, and innovate. If you're passionate about building high-quality data products and want to help shape the future of data-driven decision-making at Entain, we'd love to hear from you. Could this be your next challenge?

You Will:

Design, build and maintain scalable data pipelines, transforming complex internal and external data into reliable, business-ready data products.Develop and enhance data quality frameworks, monitoring and validation processes to ensure accurate, timely and trusted data.Partner with business, marketing and technology teams to translate requirements into effective data solutions and challenge assumptions where needed.Contribute to solution architecture and technical design, owning delivery from discovery through to implementation and ongoing support.Collaborate with central data, platform and engineering teams to ensure alignment with enterprise standards and strategic objectives.Drive continuous improvement across processes, datasets and tools, increasing efficiency, reliability and business value.Communicate technical concepts and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leaders.Champion engineering best practices in testing, observability, documentation and maintainability to deliver scalable, resilient solutions.Evaluate new data sources, technologies and approaches to expand analytical capabilities and shape the future data landscape.Thrive in a fast-paced environment, helping define requirements and deliver pragmatic solutions where processes and ownership models are evolving.

Qualifications

You Have:

Strong experience building and maintaining data pipelines using SQL, Python, or similar technologies.Experience with modern cloud data platforms, ideally Snowflake, or alternatives such as Databricks, Redshift, Synapse, BigQuery, or Azure Data Lake.Experience developing cloud-based solutions, with AWS preferred, or equivalent experience in Azure or GCP.Familiarity with data transformation and ELT frameworks, ideally dbt.Experience implementing data quality, testing, monitoring, and observability solutions, with tools such as Monte Carlo.Experience with workflow orchestration tools, preferably Prefect, or alternatives such as Airflow, Dagster, or Azure Data Factory.Understanding of event-driven architectures, distributed data processing, and large-scale data platforms.Experience with source control and CI/CD practices, ideally using GitLab, GitHub, or Azure DevOps.Familiarity with containerisation technologies such as Docker or Podman, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform.Strong understanding of data modelling, warehousing, and analytics engineering best practices.Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

Benefits

Additional Information

At Entain, We Know That Signing Top Players Requires a Great Starting Package, And Plenty Of Support To Inspire You. Join Us, And a Great Compensation Package Is Just The Beginning. You Can Expect To Receive Benefits Like:

A regular bonus and great pension.25 days annual leave and all Bankholidays.Extra paid leave, including wellbeing and development days.Life assurance and Income Protection.Private healthcare and wellbeing support.A stake in our success through our ShareSave scheme.

Equal Opportunities.

If you need any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us and we'll support you.

We're committed to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to be themselves.

We're an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone and we do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender or gender reassignment, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marriage/civil partnership, or any other basis.

We comply with all applicable recruitment regulations and employment laws in the jurisdictions where we operate, ensuring ethical and compliant hiring practices globally

rows.title: Head of Digital Platforms
rows.descriptionText:
Purpose of the role

To lead and manage engineering teams, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and support to ensure the delivery of high-quality software solutions, driving technical excellence, fostering a culture of innovation, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to align technical decisions with business objectives.

Accountabilities


Lead engineering teams effectively, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture to achieve project goals and meet organizational objectives.Oversee timelines, team allocation, risk management and task prioritization to ensure the successful delivery of solutions within scope, time, and budget.Mentor and support team members' professional growth, conduct performance reviews, provide actionable feedback, and identify opportunities for improvement.Evaluation and enhancement of engineering processes, tools, and methodologies to increase efficiency, streamline workflows, and optimize team productivity.Collaboration with business partners, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions and ensure a cohesive approach to product development.Enforcement of technology standards, facilitate peer reviews, and implement robust testing practices to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions.


Director Expectations


To manage a business function, providing significant input to function wide strategic initiatives. Contribute to and influence policy and procedures for the function and plan, manage and consult on multiple complex and critical strategic projects, which may be business wide..They manage the direction of a large team or sub-function, leading other people managers and embedding a performance culture aligned to the values of the business. Or for an individual contributor, they lead organisation wide projects and act as deep technical expert and thought leader, identifying new ways of working and collaborating cross functionally. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..Provide expert advice to senior functional management and committees to influence decisions made outside of own function, offering significant input to function wide strategic initiatives.Manage, coordinate and enable resourcing, budgeting and policy creation for a significant sub-function.Escalates breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.Foster and guide compliance, ensure regulations are observed that relevant processes in place to facilitate adherence.Focus on the external environment, regulators, or advocacy groups to both monitor and influence on behalf of Barclays, when appropriate.Demonstrate extensive knowledge of how the function integrates with the business division / Group to achieve the overall business objectives.Maintain broad and comprehensive knowledge of industry theories and practices within own discipline alongside up-to-date relevant sector / functional knowledge, and insight into external market developments / initiatives.Use interpretative thinking and advanced analytical skills to solve problems and design solutions in often complex/ sensitive situations.Exercise management authority to make significant decisions and certain strategic decisions or recommendations within own area.Negotiate with and influence stakeholders at a senior level both internally and externally.Act as principal contact point for key clients and counterparts in other functions/ businesses divisions.Mandated as a spokesperson for the function and business division.


All Senior Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

rows.title: Senior Data Governance Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Purpose of Role:
The Senior Data Governance Analyst helps shape how trusted data is governed and used across Baillie Gifford.
You will take ownership of one or more core Data Governance areas:
- Governance by Design, Data Products & Technology Enablement- Federated Ownership, Data Quality & Adoption- Enterprise Governance, Risk & Assurance
You will lead colleagues within your sub-team, strengthen data ownership and quality, and embed practical governance across Data Products, modern data platforms, analytics and AI-enabled change. Substantial Data Governance experience, sound judgement and stakeholder influence are essential.
Responsibilities:
Portfolio Leadership and DeliveryLead one or more core Data Governance areas, setting priorities, maintaining a roadmap and tracking risks, dependencies and outcomes.Lead governance work from problem definition through implementation and adoption, coordinating business and technology colleagues.Build trusted stakeholder relationships, make proportionate recommendations and escalate material issues early.Governance Framework and Embedded DeliveryDevelop and embed practical governance policies, standards and controls, translating them into procedures and decision routes teams can apply consistently.Embed governance requirements in Data Products, change initiatives, modern data platforms, analytics and AI-enabled use cases, including input to data models and integrations.Shape governance tooling and automation where processes and accountabilities are clear.Data Quality, Ownership and AssuranceStrengthen Data Owner and Data Steward accountability, supporting decisions on definitions, quality, access and remediation.Define scalable data-quality rules and thresholds, lead complex investigations and agree proportionate fixes with accountable owners.Produce reporting and assurance evidence showing whether governance is working and where action is required.Leadership and Continuous ImprovementLead your sub-team to deliver agreed priorities, review work quality and build capability through coaching and meaningful ownership.Maintain repeatable methods, clear documentation and effective cross-cover, using management information and feedback to improve outcomes.
What Success Looks Like:
Clear ownership and delivery across your Data Governance area, with predictable engagement routes, prioritised outcomes and useful measures.Governance that is easier to apply, with practical standards and timely support reducing uncertainty, rework and avoidable escalation.Improved ownership and trust in priority data, with visible quality rules, issues, decisions and remediation.A resilient, capable sub-team with reusable methods, strong documentation and effective cross-cover.
Your Knowledge and Experience:
Substantial hands-on Data Governance experience, with expert knowledge of governance frameworks and developing and applying policies, standards and controls.Strong knowledge of data ownership, data quality, metadata and lineage.Practical understanding of data models, databases, integrations, reporting and the data lifecycle.Experience with governance, metadata or data-quality tooling such as Informatica, Collibra, Talend Data Fabric or equivalent.Understanding of Data Products and modern data platforms such as Snowflake, including how governance is embedded across their lifecycle.Working knowledge of DAMA-DMBOK principles and their application to Data Governance and Data Management.Experience delivering cross-functional initiatives, with strong planning and delivery-management skills.Able to investigate issues across multiple data sources or systems, define quality rules and thresholds, and drive resolution.Experience creating reporting, controls or assurance evidence to support decision-making.Able to manage competing priorities effectively.Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical audiences.Experience influencing governance adoption and helping stakeholders embed new ways of working.Confident influencing senior stakeholders and explaining complex requirements in practical language.Experience leading and mentoring colleagues, reviewing work and establishing repeatable methods.CDMP certification or another recognised Data Management or Data Governance qualification (Preferred)Analytics or AI Data Governance experience. (Preferred)Restricted or licensed data controls. (Preferred)

You’ll be an experienced Data Governance professional who combines strong technical knowledge with a practical, collaborative approach. You’ll be comfortable working across business and technology teams, turning governance requirements into clear, workable solutions and helping stakeholders embed good data practices. You’ll also be confident managing competing priorities, influencing senior colleagues and driving improvements across data quality, ownership, metadata and controls.

Data LiteracyNurture relationshipsAdaptabilityDigital effectivenessImprovement mindsetSystems thinking
