rows.title: Global AI Markets NFR - VP
rows.descriptionText:
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking a professional to join our team in the role of Global AI Markets NFR – VP.

This is a new role within MSS AI Risk Management, established to provide dedicated governance, challenge and oversight of AI risk across Markets & Securities Services (MSS). The role will provide focused non-financial risk (NFR) coverage for AI Markets and related front-office AI capabilities, supporting safe and controlled adoption of AI in line with MSS and broader CIB risk standards.

This is an exciting opportunity to partner closely with the AI Markets business, helping to identify, assess, challenge and escalate AI-related risks, drive control enhancements, and ensure activity is managed in line with internal policy, responsible AI expectations and applicable regulatory standards.

As an HSBC employee in the UK, you will have access to tailored professional development opportunities and a competitive pay and benefits package. This includes private healthcare for all UK-based employees, enhanced maternity and adoption pay and support when you return to work, and a contributory pension scheme with a generous employer contribution.

In This Role You Will Be Responsible For

 Acting as the primary NFR point of contact for Risk and Governance of the AI Markets platform , including associated front-office AI / GenAI capabilities within MSS  Supporting and promoting the operating effectiveness of the AI Markets control framework , including governance, procedures, escalation routes and evidence of control operation  Reviewing and challenging non-financial risk and control activity , including assessments, designs, material changes, new model/feature deployments, geographic rollouts, data scope changes and associated operating model impacts  Partnering with key stakeholders across the organisation, (such as business representatives, COO, Technology & Product Owners, Cybersecurity, Compliance, Legal, Data, Model Risk Management and others) to ensure AI Markets risks are identified and managed appropriately  Ownership of governance forums and associated materials, ensuring issues, incidents and remediation actions are tracked and escalated in line with Group requirements where required  Providing oversight of monitoring and reporting , including model/performance reporting, issue management and control attestations as required  Co-ordinating reviews and enquiries , acting as a key point for deep dives relating to AI Markets from internal review teams, auditors, regulators or first/second line partners  Driving continuous improvement and simplification across the AI Markets control environment while maintaining strong governance standards  Embedding a strong control and conduct culture for AI-enabled activity across Markets, supporting the business and NFR leadership 

To Be Successful In This Role You Should Have

 Experience in Markets/front-office non-financial risk, control, audit, business management and governance  Strong understanding of front-office control frameworks and environments, including conduct risks and governance expectations in a regulated banking context  Demonstrable knowledge across AI / model / analytics risk (including governance, change risk, data lineage, explainability, monitoring and output risk) and related disciplines such as model risk, cyber, data governance and operational resilience  Experience supporting AI, analytics, digital or front-office technology programmes, and working effectively across business and technology change agendas  Proven ability to manage senior stakeholders across business, technology and control functions (without direct reporting lines), with strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment 

 Opening up a world of opportunity. 

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we’re dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces - no matter their gender, ethnicity, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or age. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. We take pride in being a Disability Confident Leader and will offer an interview to people with disabilities, long term conditions or neurodivergent candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role.

rows.title: Senior Analyst, Technology & Data Assurance
rows.descriptionText:
The Risk Assurance & Insight function supports Baillie Gifford’s Investment Risk, Compliance, Business Risk and Anti-Financial Crime functions through second-line monitoring, assurance, risk oversight, reporting, training coordination and operational support activities.
The Risk and Compliance Assurance team provides independent check and challenge across key regulatory, compliance, operational, investment and financial crime risk areas. The team assesses whether controls are designed and operating effectively, identifies areas for improvement and supports the business in maintaining effective risk management arrangements.
Data, management information and technology are used to improve the quality, consistency, coverage and efficiency of monitoring, assurance and reporting activity.
Purpose of roleThe Senior Analyst, Technology & Data Assurance will manage and strengthen the technology, data and automation capability that underpins the firm’s second-line Risk and Compliance Assurance programme. The role will also perform risk-based monitoring and assurance activity, including surveillance case review, control testing, analysis of system outputs and the identification of trends, anomalies and potential control issues.
The role will act as a bridge between assurance professionals, Technology, data teams and system owners, helping to turn assurance requirements into scalable monitoring, surveillance and analytical solutions. It will support the effective use of trade surveillance, e-communications monitoring, data platforms, automation and AI-enabled tools across assurance activity. A key focus will be the day-to-day management and use of trade surveillance and e-communications systems, including system tuning and configuration, alert and case review, analysis of system performance and escalation of matters requiring further review.
This is not a software development role. The role requires experience managing or using compliance surveillance systems, sufficient technical capability to understand systems, data, workflows and controls, and a practical understanding of assurance needs and risk-based testing. The role holder will help confirm that technology supports effective assurance coverage, consistent control testing and clear insight, while retaining appropriate professional judgement and challenge.
Responsibilities
Support the day-to-day management, configuration and effective use of compliance surveillance systems, including trade surveillance and e-communications monitoring. This includes rules, parameters, workflows, user access, alert quality and oversight of system outputs.Perform risk-based monitoring and assurance work across Investment Risk, Compliance, Business Risk and Anti-Financial Crime, supporting technology-enabled approaches where these improve coverage, consistency and efficiency.Review alerts and cases, analyse system outputs and assess whether issues require escalation, further review or wider assurance activity.Use data, management information and AI-enabled tools to identify trends, anomalies, exceptions, potential control issues and emerging risks, and to improve the targeting of monitoring and assurance work.Work with assurance colleagues to translate monitoring and testing requirements into repeatable data queries, dashboards, automated workflows and analytical routines.Support data quality, lineage, access and reconciliation activity where these affect the reliability of monitoring or assurance outputs, working with Technology, data owners and system owners to resolve issues.Contribute to the design and implementation of continuous monitoring capability, including automated exception identification, risk indicators and repeatable review processes.Assess, test and validate new monitoring, surveillance, automation and AI capabilities before implementation, balancing efficiency and innovation with control, evidential quality and appropriate human oversight.Produce clear management information on system performance, alert volumes, data quality, trends, exceptions, escalations and assurance outcomes for senior colleagues and relevant stakeholders.Help develop standards, documentation and repeatable practices that allow the wider Risk Assurance & Insight team to use surveillance systems, data, technology and AI confidently and consistently.
Your knowledge and experienceExperience using technology, data or automation to support and deliver risk-based monitoring, assurance, oversight, audit or control activity, preferably in financial services or asset management.Experience performing risk-based monitoring activity, including reviewing alerts and cases, analysing system outputs, identifying potential issues and documenting clear conclusions.Experience managing compliance surveillance systems, including trade surveillance, e-communications monitoring, workflow, reporting or other oversight platforms.Confidence working with system configuration, rules, parameters, workflows, user access, testing, issue resolution and oversight of system outputs.Strong data literacy, with the ability to analyse alerts, cases, system outputs and management information to identify trends, anomalies, exceptions and potential control issues.Practical understanding of risk and control concepts, including how technology can support evidence-based assurance, control testing and alert-based review.Experience using automation, AI-enabled tools, analytics or low-code/no-code solutions to improve monitoring, assurance or reporting activity.Understanding of responsible AI use, including the need for human judgement, validation, data protection, clear records and appropriate challenge of outputs.Ability to work effectively with assurance specialists, Technology, data owners and system vendors, translating between business, assurance and technical requirements.Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues, limitations, assurance findings and opportunities clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
The type of candidate that we're looking forYou will be a practical systems, technology and data professional who is comfortable managing compliance surveillance systems and operating in a second-line risk and assurance environment. You will understand how trade surveillance, e-communications monitoring and related oversight systems support risk-based monitoring and assurance activity. You will be able to perform assurance work. This includes reviewing process and control, alerts and cases, analysing system outputs and evidence, identifying trends, anomalies and potential control issues, and documenting clear conclusions. You will be curious and improvement-focused, but disciplined about controls, evidence and accuracy. You will be able to challenge technology and AI outputs rather than accept them at face value. You will understand that AI and automation support professional judgement rather than replace it.
This is not a software development role. It is suited to someone with experience managing or using compliance surveillance systems, working with Technology and data owners, and helping assurance teams make effective use of data, technology and AI.
Critical SkillsData literacyDigital effectivenessImprovement mindsetOpenness and discernmentTeam working
Closing DateSeptember 26, 2026
Should you choose to use AI tools to support your application, we ask that you do this thoughtfully. We encourage you to ensure your application reflects your own voice, experience, and motivations. We value authenticity and want to understand your individual strengths and perspectives.
At Baillie Gifford, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful culture in which each of our colleagues can thrive and develop. We believe that our clients are best served by a diverse workforce with the experiences, ideas and perspectives that this brings.
If you are currently working at Baillie Gifford as an employee or contractor please apply to this job from the firm's Workday internal career site.

rows.title: XDP Data Architect
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as an XDP Data Architect and help shape how data is structured, governed, and used across our bank. You will contribute to a trusted, secure, and scalable data environment. This environment supports our colleagues, customers, and business priorities. Working across technology and business teams, you will help ensure data is available, reliable, and easy to use.

As an XDP Data Architect, you will play an important role in supporting the responsible use of data across the organisation. You will define enterprise-wide data models and establish architectural standards. You will also support the adoption of data governance frameworks that align with regulatory requirements and business needs. Working closely with stakeholders across engineering, operations, analytics, and business teams, you will help create a reliable data foundation for the organisation.

You will contribute to the development of target-state data architectures. You will help teams adopt scalable and sustainable approaches to data stewardship, integration, and governance. You will provide guidance on data architecture patterns, data flows, and platform capabilities. This will help promote consistency, interoperability, and long-term value. You will also support the evolution of data practices while helping teams make effective use of data.

As part of our team, you will work with a wide range of stakeholders. You will contribute to future priorities and help shape the direction of data across the bank. Success in this role will involve building relationships, sharing knowledge, and working collaboratively. Together, we deliver data solutions that support innovation, operational efficiency, and positive outcomes for our customers and colleagues.

To be successful as an XDP Data Architect, you must have the following essential skills:


Data Modelling and Data Architecture Design, coupled with the ability to partner with platform teams to influence and shape solutions at the solution and integration level.Data Governance and Data Stewardship.Data Integration and Platform Architecture.Standardised Architecture Governance.


Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include


Analytics, AI and Machine Learning Architecture.Cloud Data Platforms.Master Data Management (MDM) and Reference Data.


You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role will be based out of our Knutsford or Glasgow offices.

Purpose of the role

To define, direct and govern the bank’s target data architecture (inc. shared data environment, data model and standards) in support of business strategy, ensuring that data is accurate, secure and accessible to meet the needs of stakeholders.

Accountabilities


Development of the banks data architecture strategy, including the translation of bank-wide goals and objectives into target data architecture and transition plan.Collaboration with stakeholders, including data operations, engineers and analysts, to provide subject matter expertise and share knowledge to promote standardised, consistent, safe and value-driven data usage.Development and maintenance of the banks data architecture governance, standards and protection policies, regarding data models, authoritative data stores, and data capabilities, to support data quality, accuracy and consistency and the protection of sensitive information.Management of the alignment of projects to the target data architecture through the provision of guidance, data solutions and monitoring of progress.Definition of the shared reusable data capabilities, assets, tools and technologies required to connect disparate data sources, optimise data storage and provide seamless data access.Custodianship of an overarching data model that directs how data is logically and physically structured within the banks physical data resources, e.g. database, interfaces and reports.Monitoring applicable regulatory standards and industry developments for potential impact on the banks operations, controls and application portfolio.Identification and selection of best-in-class data technologies and ongoing assessment of compliance with the bank's service level agreements and quality standards.


Vice President Expectations


To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

rows.title: 2027 Operations Analyst Degree Apprenticeship Programme London
rows.descriptionText:
Annual Salary £25,200 + benefits

Getting qualified. It's a huge achievement that can completely change your prospects – but it’s not always open to everyone, whether that's due to the cost of university or the timing not being right. But with our apprenticeships, all that can change. Here at Barclays we offer a world-class programme that provides you with a permanent, full-time job with a competitive salary from day one - all whilst gaining a professional qualification at the same time. Whether you're a school-leaver looking for alternative options to the traditional university route or you're someone thinking differently about your future, we'll help you to build an extraordinary career at Barclays, no matter your background.

Our programme is designed for school leavers and career changers, but is open to anyone, no matter your background or your age. If you already have a degree, make sure you visit https://search.jobs.barclays/graduates and consider our graduate opportunities.

Why a Barclays Apprenticeship?

You’ll get the opportunity to earn whilst working towards a Data Scientist Degree Apprenticeship, a perfect blend of theoretical learning and real-life practical work whilst on a full-time salary in a permanent job. A unique chance to get a professional qualification without the student loan, all whilst getting years of work experience under your belt. Due to the evolving nature of Apprenticeships, a new Apprenticeship might become available and if deemed more relevant to your role, we'll change the Apprenticeship before you start.

We’ve spent over a decade perfecting the support that you’ll receive on our Apprenticeship programme. From day one, you’ll be assigned a Programme Support Manager matched to your needs and background, and together with your People Leader, they’ll support you as an individual. We’ll also match you to an expert in your specialist subject, ready to share their knowledge.

The Apprenticeship route gives you the opportunity for self-discovery and helps you to explore different career paths. With over 325 years of expertise in Banking, Barclays operates in 39 countries, employing around 90,000 people to help move, lend, invest and protect money for customers and clients worldwide.

Why the Operations Apprenticeship programme?

Operations keeps Barclays moving for customers, clients and colleagues. You’ll learn how banking services are delivered, how processes are improved, and how teams work together to manage risk, solve problems and provide excellent service.

Are you eligible?

First, you’ll need the right qualifications. For this apprenticeship opportunity you’ll need 3 A-levels at grades BBC, plus GCSE qualifications in both Maths and English at Grade C (4) or an equivalent qualification.

Beyond that though, we’re also looking for commitment and enthusiasm. Our Apprenticeships place deep investment in you as an individual. That means we need you to match that commitment: you’ll turn up every day ready to work hard, push yourself, and think differently about what you’re capable of.

To apply for our apprentice programme, you must meet the Government's apprentice funding requirements that apply to you (as outlined in https://www.gov.uk/ for apprentices in England and in https://www.saas.gov.uk/ for apprentices in Scotland).

The Government apprentice funding requirements include a number of requirements that you must meet, including a 3 year residence requirement (subject to certain exceptions). To qualify for the Government's apprentice funding requirements, you must also have the legal right to work for the full duration of the programme at the point of enrolment, with no gaps in your legal right to work or dependency on future visa applications during the period of your apprenticeship (August 2027 to August 2031).

You must also not have undertaken any previous study, education, training, qualifications, or apprenticeship, gained learning or competence from prior work experience, or received prior funding or financial support which renders you ineligible for the Government’s apprentice funding.

Working In London

If you love the buzz of city life, our global HQ is the place to be. Our London hub is in Canary Wharf, at the heart of London’s financial district, with opportunities to explore many functions across a global financial institution.

What happens once you apply?

Step 1 - We'll review your application

Step 2 - You'll be asked to complete our online assessments

Step 3 - We'll ask you to complete a survey, so we can be sure of your eligibility

Step 4 - It's time to attend an in-person assessment day, where you'll be assessed during a group activity and interview (this will take place from October 2026)

Step 5 - We'll let you know the outcome and give you feedback.

It is the policy of Barclays to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law.

The closing date for applications is 25 September 2026. Please note that this vacancy may close ahead of the advertised date due to application volumes, and we therefore recommend submitting your application as early as possible.

Purpose of the role

To support the day-to-day operations of the operations business division providing insights and expertise that help more senior colleagues make informed decisions, develop new products and services, and identify new market opportunities

Accountabilities


Performance of KYC tasks while following standard procedures related to Client Due Diligence and AML policies.Monitoring of real time transaction flow, trade updates and exception queues to ensure timely and accurate trade representation across systems.Address incident, problem and change management issues to improve services across the bank.Provision of support to continuous improvement of the operational process and the development of best practices; coming up with ways to improve systems and processes.Provision of support for cleared derivatives, performing perform daily reconciliation of related fees undertake a range of complex customer and product related processing activities.Participation in training and development programs to enhance skills and knowledge.


Analyst Expectations

Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.Gain and maintain an understanding of own role, how the team integrates to achieve overall objectives, alongside knowledge of the work of other teams within the function.Work within well-defined procedures that may involve a variety of work routines.Demonstrate an understanding of the procedures.Evaluate and select the appropriate alternatives from defined options.Make judgements based on the analysis of factual information.Build relationships with stakeholders and customers to identify and address their needs, in support of a smooth operating process, handling sensitive issues as required.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. rows.title: 2027 Technology Developer Graduate Programme Knutsford
rows.descriptionText:
If you're a recent graduate or soon-to-be graduate, join us and unlock a world of carefully curated experiences, knowledge, and connections to shape your career. Along the way, you can expect all the training and support you need to make your mark on the world. Put simply, we’ll empower you to help determine how we do things and where we go next. Our graduates are a vital part of our success, and we welcome applications from people from all walks of life. Whoever you are and wherever you want to join us, if you’re curious, creative, and ambitious, this is a world in which you can truly belong.

Our Expert Programme

You'll join our expert programme, a 1 year targeted, fast-track programme designed to give you depth and breadth of experience. Participating in job-based bespoke training from the start enabling you to go fully-equipped into your role as you develop specialist technical expertise.

Why the Technology Developer programme?

As a Developer, you’ll help design, build, test and maintain systems used across Barclays. This is more than writing code; you’ll play a role in solving complex problems for clients and customers. You may work with technologies including Java, C++, C#, Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, containers, DevOps, cloud, machine learning, scripting and real-time systems.

To be considered for this opportunity, you'll be motivated with a strong degree or expected degree achieved before June 2027.

You’ll also bring a genuine interest in technology, strong problem-solving skills and the drive to deliver innovative solutions.

Barclays will accept applications from candidates who require visa sponsorship to work in the UK and will provide a skilled worker visa for successful applicants if they meet the Home Office’s eligibility criteria for a skilled worker visa.

Successful applicants who are not eligible to receive a skilled worker visa, and who we are therefore unable to secure a skilled worker visa for, will be required to have their own legal right to work in the UK on a full-time basis from August 2027 to August 2028.

rows.title: 2027 Compliance Analyst Summer Internship Programme London
rows.descriptionText:
Explore the world of Barclays as a Summer Intern

Spend 10 weeks diving into real projects, gaining hands-on experience, and shaping your future. You’ll receive full support, take on meaningful responsibilities, and build lasting connections—all while discovering what makes our culture unique.

If you're in your penultimate year and ready to grow, learn, and make an impact, this is your opportunity to belong and thrive.

Why the Compliance Summer Internship programme?

As one of the world’s largest and most respected full-service banks, Barclays has a huge responsibility, to millions of people, to do the right thing. That’s why the work we do in Compliance really matters. A broad-ranging, multi-disciplinary function, Compliance oversees the way Barclays does business. This means satisfying the ever-evolving demands of the banking regulators, as well as maintaining our own standards and codes of conduct and protecting our reputation in the world. Compliance is essential to every business, every function, every team and every location. That gives us a broad understanding of the global business: we see the big picture, and we touch on every facet of the bank’s operations.

This is your chance to be part of a positive, proactive team doing fascinating, challenging and rewarding work of great importance – and huge variety. Compliance people research and investigate. We gather, study and analyse complex data from a wide range of sources. We follow leads, identify risks, evaluate threats and predict trends that will define the future. We’re involved in surveillance and control, product design and implementation. We are trusted, influential advisers in every area of our global business – simply put, without Compliance, Barclays could not operate.

To be considered for this opportunity, you must be in your penultimate year of university. You must be graduating in 2028.

You’ll also have a genuine passion for Compliance and an enthusiastic mindset that will empower you to thrive and make an impact.

The location for this role is indicated in the job title, and you will be based at that location. If you are successful in receiving a return offer to our graduate programme, your location will be the same as it was during your internship.

Barclays will accept applications from candidates who require visa sponsorship to work in the UK and will provide a skilled worker visa for successful applicants if they meet the Home Office’s eligibility criteria for a skilled worker visa.

If you love the buzz of city life, our global HQ is the place to be. Our London hub is in Canary Wharf, at the heart of London’s financial district. Here, you won’t just be perfectly placed to explore the nation’s capital; you’ll be in a place where you can explore the many functions and opportunities of a global financial giant.

rows.title: Senior Product & Proposition Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as a Senior Product & Proposition Manager at Barclays where you will lead the future of customer onboarding, owning and evolving the strategic vision and roadmap for onboarding capabilities that deliver seamless customer journeys, strengthen fraud and financial crime controls, and drive sustainable growth. You will lead and inspire several cross-functional feature teams, ensuring the delivery of scalable, resilient, and compliant onboarding solutions that enhance customer experience and efficiency. As the owner of the onboarding inbound demand portfolio, you will transform the operating model through capability-led delivery, simplifying prioritisation and enabling the reuse of services and components across the organisation. This is a high-impact leadership role where you will champion agile ways of working, drive continuous improvement, and coach Product Owners and teams to achieve outstanding delivery performance and value realisation.

To be successful as a Senior Product & Proposition Manager, you should have the following essential skills:


Considerable Product Owner experience demonstrated through management of product backlogs, prioritising roadmaps and delivering through Agile methodologies.Experience of customer onboarding, and digital customer journey management within a regulated environment.Proven ability to lead through matrix structures and deliver outcomes across multiple agile teams.Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at senior levels across business, technology and control functions.Product strategy development, including ability to use customer insights, analytics and KPIs to identify opportunities to improve customer journeys and drive measurable outcomes.


Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include


Experience working within customer onboarding, KYC, financial crime and fraud prevention or customer due diligence environments within financial services.Experience using experimentation, automation and AI to simplify journeys.


You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role can be based in Glasgow, London, Manchester or Northampton.

Purpose of the role

To manage and develop existing and new products and/or services; and where applicable, ownership of related customer and colleague journeys, develops the product strategy, drive change through Barclays execution teams, make key decisions in the product lifecycle and own associated outcomes for customers, colleagues and the bank, achieved through appropriate service level agreements, regulatory compliance, risk management and controls.

Accountabilities

rows.title: 2027 Operations Analyst Graduate Apprenticeship Programme Glasgow
rows.descriptionText:
Annual Salary £25,200 + benefits

Getting qualified. It's a huge achievement that can completely change your prospects – but it’s not always open to everyone, whether that's due to the cost of university or the timing not being right. But with our apprenticeships, all that can change. Here at Barclays we offer a world-class programme that provides you with a permanent, full-time job with a competitive salary from day one - all whilst gaining a professional qualification at the same time. Whether you're a school-leaver looking for alternative options to the traditional university route or you're someone thinking differently about your future, we'll help you to build an extraordinary career at Barclays, no matter your background.

Our programme is designed for school leavers and career changers, but is open to anyone, no matter your background or your age. If you already have a degree, make sure you visit https://search.jobs.barclays/graduates and consider our graduate opportunities.

Why a Barclays Apprenticeship?

You’ll get the opportunity to earn whilst working towards a Business Management Graduate Apprenticeship, a perfect blend of theoretical learning and real-life practical work whilst on a full-time salary in a permanent job. A unique chance to get a professional qualification without the student loan, all whilst getting years of work experience under your belt. Due to the evolving nature of Apprenticeships, a new Apprenticeship might become available and if deemed more relevant to your role, we'll change the Apprenticeship before you start.

We’ve spent over a decade perfecting the support that you’ll receive on our Apprenticeship programme. From day one, you’ll be assigned a Programme Support Manager matched to your needs and background, and together with your People Leader, they’ll support you as an individual. We’ll also match you to an expert in your specialist subject, ready to share their knowledge.

The Apprenticeship route gives you the opportunity for self-discovery and helps you to explore different career paths. With over 325 years of expertise in Banking, Barclays operates in 39 countries, employing around 90,000 people to help move, lend, invest and protect money for customers and clients worldwide.

Why the Operations Apprenticeship programme?

Operations keeps Barclays moving for customers, clients and colleagues. You’ll learn how banking services are delivered, how processes are improved, and how teams work together to manage risk, solve problems and provide excellent service.

Are you eligible?

First, you’ll need the right qualifications. For this apprenticeship opportunity you’ll need SQA Highers at ABBB or equivalent.

Beyond that though, we’re also looking for commitment and enthusiasm. Our Apprenticeships place deep investment in you as an individual. That means we need you to match that commitment: you’ll turn up every day ready to work hard, push yourself, and think differently about what you’re capable of.

To apply for our apprentice programme, you must meet the Government's apprentice funding requirements that apply to you (as outlined in https://www.gov.uk/ for apprentices in England and in https://www.saas.gov.uk/ for apprentices in Scotland).

The Government apprentice funding requirements include a number of requirements that you must meet, including a 3 year residence requirement (subject to certain exceptions). To qualify for the Government's apprentice funding requirements, you must also have the legal right to work for the full duration of the programme at the point of enrolment, with no gaps in your legal right to work or dependency on future visa applications during the period of your apprenticeship (August 2027 to August 2031). You must be residing in Scotland from 1 August 2027.

You must also not have undertaken any previous study, education, training, qualifications, or apprenticeship, gained learning or competence from prior work experience, or received prior funding or financial support which renders you ineligible for the Government’s apprentice funding.

Working In Glasgow

Our state-of-the-art campus in Glasgow is somewhere you'll want to work. It's home to colleagues who thrive in an environment designed with collaboration and the future of work in mind, with creative spaces, technology and plenty to get involved in outside your day job.

What happens once you apply?

Step 1 - We'll review your application

Step 2 - You'll be asked to complete our online assessments

Step 3 - We'll ask you to complete a survey, so we can be sure of your eligibility

Step 4 - It's time to attend an in-person assessment day, where you'll be assessed during a group activity and interview (this will take place from October 2026)

Step 5 - We'll let you know the outcome and give you feedback

rows.title: AI Product Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as an AI Product Manager at Barclays where you'll be primarily responsible for planning, delivering, and managing AI-driven products or features, with a great focus on roadmaps, prioritisation, and execution. You will translate business needs into product requirements, leveraging your understanding of AI fundamentals, data analytics, and market insights to support product development. Working closely with stakeholders, you’ll coordinate delivery using tools like Jira while building robust relationships and ensuring clear communication. You’ll play a key role in supporting product success, contributing to continuous improvement and the broader AI product agenda.

To be successful as an AI Product Manager, you should have experience with:


Proven experience in product ownership and end-to-end product management, supporting delivery from concept through to implementationGreat planning, organisational, and project management skills, including experience using Jira to manage backlogs and maintain product roadmapsExperience in sprint planning and agile delivery, ensuring effective prioritisation and execution of workConfident stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate plans, priorities, and progress to a range of audiences


Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include


Understanding or exposure to coding, Machine Learning, or AI concepts, supporting effective collaboration with technical teamsAwareness of commercial considerations, with an understanding of how product decisions contribute to business value and outcomes


You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role can be based in either London, Glasgow or Northampton.

Purpose of the role

To manage and develop existing and new products and/or services; and where applicable, ownership of related customer and colleague journeys, develops the product strategy, drive change through Barclays execution teams, make key decisions in the product lifecycle and own associated outcomes for customers, colleagues and the bank, achieved through appropriate service level agreements, regulatory compliance, risk management and controls.

About The Role And Team

Science and Engineering at Uber mean building for real-world impact under real-world constraints. As a Senior Applied Scientist, you will work at the high-stakes intersection of economics, statistics, and computer science to build the intelligent systems that power our global marketplaces. Unlike purely analytics roles, this is a production-focused position where you will turn "messy" behavioral data into scalable, machine-readable insights and automated decision-making engines.

You will join a high-stakes environment where the work is fast-moving, and the systems you build directly affect how millions of people and things move across our global platforms every single day. Collaborating closely with Product and Engineering, you will lead high-visibility projects from conceptualization to global productionization, navigating technical debt and shifting priorities along the way. If you are a systems-thinker who stays calm under pressure and is motivated to build production-grade models that solve unstructured problems without a textbook solution, this is where you'll grow.

What You'll Do

 Build and deploy production-grade ML models and statistical algorithms that enhance platform intelligence and user experience in real-time environments.  Design complex experiments and causal inference frameworks to interpret results and drive trade-offs between short-term wins and long-term system reliability.  Architect underlying systems, observability platforms, and automated tooling required to monitor model performance and detect degradations at scale.  Solve high-impact problems by translating ambiguous business needs into rigorous mathematical frameworks and production-ready code.  Collaborate across Engineering, Product, and Operations to influence technical roadmaps and drive the adoption of scientific best practices.  Own your work end-to-end, from identifying raw features and handling data imbalance to debugging production issues when the stakes are high.

 Minimum 4 years of professional experience as a Machine Learning Scientist, Research Scientist, or Applied Scientist with a record of scoping complex problems independently. Advanced coding proficiency with the ability to contribute to production-level codebases and develop modular tools re-used across teams.  Experience performing extensive testing, monitoring, and instrumenting alerting to ensure the reliability of real-time systems. rows.descriptionText:
About The Team

Uber's Customer Obsession AI team is building one of the largest GenAI products at Uber, serving nearly one billion customer interactions annually across all of Uber's products globally - Rideshare, Delivery, Merchants, Autonomous Vehicles, Third-party offerings, and more.

Customer experience is at the heart of cutting-edge applied AI today. The opportunity is expanding from handling individual customer queries into an end-to-end proactive AI assistant across the full user journey. We are rebuilding the product from the ground up to be AI-native, with a world-class team across Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Design.

The team is also AI-pilled - every day, we find and deploy new ways to use AI internally to accelerate development, improve quality, and increase innovation.

About The Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to help build the next generation of Agentic AI for Customer Experience at Uber.

You will work on products and platform capabilities that enable AI agents to understand customers and their context, reason through complex situations, make decisions, and take actions on their behalf. Depending on the product area, you may work on the customer-facing agent experience, agent reasoning and orchestration, multimodal capabilities, context and memory, quality and evaluation systems, developer tooling, or other foundational capabilities required to operate AI agents at Uber's scale.

This is an opportunity to work on AI with real-world consequences and learn how to build and operate agentic systems at massive scale. Our AI serves nearly one billion customer interactions annually across a wide range of products, markets, and customer scenarios. Building these experiences requires us to move quickly at the frontier of AI while maintaining a high bar for customer experience, quality, accuracy, and safety.

You will partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Design, User Research, and Operations to turn advances in AI into products that meaningfully improve the customer experience.

What You'll Do

Build agentic AI products: Own and ship product capabilities that help Uber's AI understand customer needs, reason through complex situations, make decisions, and take actions. Turn AI advances into customer experiences: Stay close to rapidly evolving AI capabilities and identify opportunities to translate them into intuitive, differentiated experiences for Uber customers. Own a product area end-to-end: Contribute to product strategy and roadmap, define requirements and success metrics, make tradeoffs, and work closely with cross-functional partners from discovery through launch and iteration. Drive AI quality: Partner with Engineering and Data Science to understand agent behavior and improve it through capabilities such as evals, experimentation, simulations, observability, debugging, and human feedback. Champion the customer: Use customer insights, research, data, and product intuition to deeply understand customer problems and ensure technology translates into a high-quality user experience. Work across the stack: Develop enough technical depth to engage with how agentic systems work - from models and reasoning to tools, context, orchestration, platform infrastructure, and the experiences customers ultimately see. Use data to learn and iterate: Define success metrics, analyze product and model performance, identify opportunities, and use experimentation and customer feedback to continuously improve the product. Drive cross-functional execution: Work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Design, User Research, Operations, and other Uber product teams to move quickly from ideas to products in customers' hands. Operate with speed and curiosity: Experiment with new AI tools and ways of working, including using AI to accelerate product discovery, prototyping, analysis, testing, and iteration. 

Basic Qualifications

Product experience: Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of Product Management experience, including high-impact internships. You have contributed to shipping and improving technology products used by real customers. Strong product thinking: You can take an ambiguous customer or business problem, break it down, identify the highest-leverage opportunities, and translate them into a clear product plan. AI curiosity and technical depth: You are excited about AI and have a strong desire to understand how modern AI and agentic systems work. You can engage deeply with Engineering and Data Science on technical tradeoffs without needing to be an engineer yourself. Customer obsession: You care deeply about the quality of the end-user experience and can combine product intuition, customer research, and quantitative data to make good decisions. Strong execution: You are comfortable operating in ambiguity, getting into the details, making tradeoffs, and driving cross-functional teams toward outcomes in a fast-moving environment. Analytical mindset: You use data to understand problems, evaluate product performance, test hypotheses, and make decisions. Communication and storytelling: You can clearly articulate the customer problem, product rationale, and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences. High ownership and learning velocity: You are curious, hands-on, and eager to learn. You move with urgency, seek out feedback, and are excited to build in a space where the technology and product possibilities are evolving rapidly

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working on mobile experiences and consumer products.

Phenomenal track record of working with engineering, analytics and design teams, with proven examples to prioritize work across the team.

Grittiness: you never hesitate to roll up your sleeves and tackle something hands-on.

Proven track record of growing and scaling a product.

In compliance with applicable laws, HSBC is committed to employing only individuals who are authorized to work in the United States. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S., as HSBC will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.

Our purpose — Opening up a world of opportunity — explains why we exist. At HSBC, we use our unique expertise, capabilities, breadth and perspectives to open up new kinds of opportunity for our more than 40 million customers. We bring together people, ideas and capital that nurture progress and growth, helping to create a better world — for our customers, our people, our investors, our communities and the planet we all share.

As Senior Audit Manager - Enterprise-wide Risk Management (ERM) and Governance Audit, you will lead audit coverage of ERM and Governance in the US. The ERM and Governance Audit team is responsible for audit coverage of the management of the ERM function and Corporate Governance across HSBC Group, including the management of operational and resilience risks. This is achieved through both direct audit coverage and providing subject-matter expertise to monitor and direct the audit coverage across Global Internal Audit.

As Senior Audit Manager - Enterprise-wide Risk Management (ERM) and Governance Audit, you will:

 Lead a team of 3 audit managers, overseeing delivery of all US audits in the ERM and Governance Audit Plan Interact with local regulators regarding GIA coverage of relevant activities, notably 2LOD oversight of operational and resilience risks Manage the relationship with relevant stakeholders in the US on major plans, projects, strategic developments, and industry trends, both to understand and provide input to emerging risks and issues and assess the impact on the planned schedule of audits. Co-ordinate GIA coverage of applicable regulatory requirements, such as Heightened Standards, across multiple audit teams in the US Effectively manage some individual audits and activity through planning and delivery of the annual audit plan within expected timeframe, standards, methodology, budget, and best practices Confirm that audit findings and recommendations are understood and appropriately addressed Demonstrate knowledge of the applicable business and regulatory environment impacting ERM and Governance, including developing trends, risks, controls, and expectations Support a strong risk and conduct culture across the Group and promote awareness and sound operational and strategic decision-making Critically analyses and determine key drivers of change for area of coverage and assess how these will impact GIA’s engagements Identify audit process improvements to increase productivity and efficiency without impacting effectiveness

Qualifications And Experience

You’ll likely have the following qualifications to succeed in this role:

 Extensive relevant work experience in the Financial Services Sector, with prior experience in internal audit, consultancy, or external audit preferred, but not essential Experience of team management Knowledge of the applicable regulatory requirements in the US and business processes related to ERM and Governance Relevant accounting, audit, analytical, financial, project management, quantitative, risk, and technology skills, qualifications or certifications Undergraduate or graduate degree in business, accounting, mathematics, or social sciences. rows.descriptionText:
Explore the world of Barclays as a Summer Intern

Spend 10 weeks diving into real projects, gaining hands-on experience, and shaping your future. You’ll receive full support, take on meaningful responsibilities, and build lasting connections—all while discovering what makes our culture unique.

If you're in your penultimate year and ready to grow, learn, and make an impact, this is your opportunity to belong and thrive.

Why the Compliance Summer Internship program? 

As one of the world’s largest and most respected full-service banks, Barclays has a huge responsibility, to millions of people, to do the right thing. That’s why the work we do in Compliance really matters. A broad-ranging, multi-disciplinary function, Compliance oversees the way Barclays does business. This means satisfying the ever-evolving demands of the banking regulators, as well as maintaining our own standards and codes of conduct and protecting our reputation in the world. Compliance is essential to every business, every function, every team and every location. That gives us a broad understanding of the global business: we see the big picture, and we touch on every facet of the bank’s operations.

This is your chance to be part of a positive, proactive team doing fascinating, challenging and rewarding work of great importance – and huge variety. Compliance people research and investigate. We gather, study and analyse complex data from a wide range of sources. We follow leads, identify risks, evaluate threats and predict trends that will define the future. We’re involved in surveillance and control, product design and implementation. We are trusted, influential advisers in every area of our global business – simply put, without Compliance, Barclays could not operate.

To be eligible for this opportunity, you must be graduating between December 2027 and June 2028 and have a GPA of 3.2 or above.

You'll also have a genuine passion for Compliance and an enthusiastic mindset will empower you to thrive and make an impact, regardless of your role. Combine that with a customer-first attitude, adaptability, and a hunger to learn new technologies, and you’ll be well-positioned to drive meaningful results.

The location for this role is indicated in the job title, and you will be based at that location. If you are successful in receiving a return offer to our graduate program, your location will be the same as it was during your internship.

Barclays will not offer or consider offering sponsorship for work visas or offer any employment-based immigration sponsorship for individuals, now or in the future, unless such individuals are enrolled in or graduate with a degree in a field of study that the U.S. Department of Homeland Security and the Department of Education consider to be a science, technology, engineering or mathematics (STEM) field of study for purposes of the 24-month STEM OPT extension. This includes for any internship, post-graduation program, or permanent employment, now or in the future.

Working in New York

Join us at our Americas Headquarters, located at 745 Seventh Avenue—right in the heart of Times Square. This iconic 37-story tower offers more than just a prime Manhattan address. Inside, you’ll find a vibrant workplace with a modern cafeteria, a fully equipped fitness center, and cutting-edge LED signage lighting up the skyline. It’s a dynamic space designed to energize your day and inspire your best work.

rows.title: Staff Scientist, Tech - Science
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role And Team

As a Staff Scientist at Uber, you will solve the complex, global-scale puzzle of how millions of people and things move in the real world. Operating as a technical multiplier at the high-stakes intersection of digital systems and physical movement, you will navigate extreme ambiguity, set scientific strategy, and make critical decisions with imperfect information. Whether you are architecting next-generation marketplace mechanisms or defining experimentation guardrails, you will thrive in an environment where high performance and massive scale are inextricably linked.

You will join the Rider Pricing and Incentive team, which owns the real-time algorithms powering our mobility business. In this role, you will define the scientific strategy for measuring marketplace performance and optimizing complex pricing systems. Beyond building models, you will develop data insights to identify high-impact opportunities and influence executive roadmaps. You will also drive execution by providing technical guidance to junior scientists and partnering cross-functionally with Product and Engineering teams to deliver high-impact, productionized results.

What You'll Do

 Set Scientific Vision: Define the 1-2 year scientific strategy and technical roadmap for real-time rider pricing, identifying high-impact opportunities.  Lead the Architecture and Design: Define the scientific frameworks and next-generation pricing algorithms that ensure our models are modular, extensible, and observable at global scale.  Act as a Technical Multiplier: Elevate team-wide technical execution by identifying opportunities for system efficiency, model performance, and reduction of technical debt across software and science pipelines.  Influence Senior Leadership: Partner directly with Product, Engineering, and Business Executives, translating complex data and technical findings into clear strategic recommendations.  Own Technical Trajectory: Direct the evolution of critical pricing systems, balancing short-term needs with long-term scalability and efficiency.  Establish Scientific Guardrails: Set experimentation standards and statistical frameworks across multiple teams, driving organization-wide adoption of best practices in causal inference and marketplace testing. 

Basic Qualifications

 Ph.D., M.S., or B.S. in Economics, Operations Research, Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or related quantitative fields.  Minimum of 6+ years (M.S./Ph.D.) or 8+ years (B.S.) of industry experience building, deploying, and scaling quantitative models in production environments.  Deep expertise in statistical inference, advanced experimental design (e.g., switchbacks, cluster-randomized trials), and quantitative economic modeling.  Proficiency in SQL and Python working with large-scale distributed data tools (e.g., Spark, Presto). 

Preferred Qualifications

 Domain Mastery: Recognized expertise in marketplace design, pricing algorithms, industrial organization, ML system design, or large-scale optimization in high-throughput environments.  Technical Vision: Proven track record of anticipating scientific or system bottlenecks 12+ months in advance and building foundational frameworks to address them.  Cross-Functional Leadership: Demonstrated success leading multi-quarter, org-wide initiatives that moved major marketplace or financial metrics in production.  Executive Impact: Ability to synthesize complex statistical or economic insights into compelling strategic narratives for senior leadership.

rows.title: VP of Product Management, Monetization
rows.descriptionText:
Summary

At Yelp, our mission is to connect people with great local businesses. We’re seeking a VP of Product Management, Monetization to lead product strategy, vision and execution for overall Yelp monetization. Reporting directly to our Chief Product Officer, you'll oversee how Yelp monetizes, ensuring Ad products and platform systems work together across all consumer-facing experiences to deliver value to both sides of the marketplace.

In this senior product leadership role, you’ll inspire and develop exceptional talent, push the state of the art on an industry leading Ad system, set a high bar for product quality, and collaborate with partners across Consumer and Ads Engineering, Data Science, Search Relevance, and Revenue.

You'll play a pivotal role in shaping how we balance the trade-offs between monetization, business value, and maintaining a delightful user experience. You'll be the voice of our advertisers, from the single-location coffee shop to the multi-location enterprise, ensuring we grow revenue without compromising the quality of the experience for consumers or the businesses we serve.

This role sits at the intersection of Product, Revenue, Data, and Engineering. It requires a player-coach leader who can engage cross-functional teams to build Ad products that drive revenue while enhancing the overall user experience. You'll take the time to deeply understand our local marketplace and customer dynamics before driving change.

We’d love to have you apply, even if you don’t feel you meet every single requirement in this posting. At Yelp, we’re looking for great people, not just those who simply check off all the boxes. This is a full-time remote role based in the United States.

What You'll Do

Unify the larger organization across Product, Engineering, Operations, and GTM teams under a single vision, increasing momentum of innovation and driving alignment as a player-coach who leads strategically while remaining hands-on in solving complex challenges.Set the long-term vision, strategy, and roadmap for monetization products and platform - aligned with company revenue, advertiser value, and consumer and business experience goals.Lead and develop PMs; build strong partnerships with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and Revenue teams to ensure effective delivery, resourcing, and cross-org alignment.Prioritize product investments across competing roadmaps with clear business cases - balancing short-term revenue, long-term user trust, business value, and execution risks.Drive improvements to sponsored results, Ad delivery and reporting, creative optimization, and Ad load/placement strategy including direct ownership of Ads auction and bidding teams.Raise performance and engagement on business pages; enhance how Ads and organic results work together on the SERP (with Adaptive SERP and relevance partners).Build trusted internal partnerships with Search Quality, Yelp Assistant (AI-powered conversational chatbot), and Ads & Machine Learning teams where consumer entry points, monetization, and relevance intersect.

What It Takes To Succeed

Ability to navigate executive stakeholders with strong, sometimes competing opinions, and drive cohesive forward movement.You are a thoughtful, strategic product leader. You plan 12-24 months out, mentoring and developing PMs into better product thinkers, and empowering your team to succeed autonomously. Proven track record of building and launching innovative Ad products or monetization features at scale, within auction-based systems (not just operating existing systems).You bring deep, hands-on experience with advertising products — not just familiarity, but the kind of understanding that comes from having lived the trade-offs. You know how auction mechanics affect the consumer experience. You understand why advertiser controls matter and where they create unintended consequences. You've navigated the tension between short-term revenue optimization and long-term user trust, and you have strong instincts about where to draw the line.You’re experienced with revenue-generating products backed by clear business metrics, and you actively collaborate with finance and revenue partners.You have proven ability to lead large cross-functional initiatives across Engineering, Design, Data Science, and Go-to-Market and communicate effectively at the executive level.Familiarity with consumer marketplaces or local discovery and how search UX and Ads interact with organic results is strongly preferred.

What You'll Get

Effective your first day: Full medical, vision, and dental 15 days PTO (accrual begins on date of hire and increases with 2+ years of tenure thereafter), 12 paid holidays, plus one floating holidayUp to 14 weeks of parental leaveMonthly wellness subsidyWork from home reimbursementFlexible spending account401(k) retirement savings planEmployee stock purchase planCompensation range for this position is $300,000 - $400,000 annually. You may also be offered a bonus, restricted stock units, and benefits.

Closing

At Yelp, we believe that diversity is an expression of all the unique characteristics that make us human: race, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, disability, and education — and those are just a few. We recognize that diverse backgrounds and perspectives strengthen our teams and our product. The foundation of our diversity efforts are closely tied to our core values, which include “Playing Well With Others” and “Authenticity.”

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, medical condition or disability.

Actual salary offered may vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to, an individual's location and experience. 

We will consider for employment qualified candidates with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable law (including, for example, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for roles based in San Francisco, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for roles based in the unincorporated areas of Los Angeles County, and the California Fair Chance Act for roles based in California).

Where required by law, a criminal background check will not be conducted until after a conditional offer of employment is made, and any evaluation of a candidate's criminal background check will be subject to an individualized assessment that takes into account the candidate's specific criminal records and the responsibilities and requirements of the particular role.

Yelp’s mission of connecting people with great local businesses requires the use of cutting-edge Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to scale across a vast and diverse base of users and businesses spanning various geographical locations. As a Staff-level ML Engineer on the Content Contributor Intelligence team, you will help build connections across millions of users and business listings. Your work will involve using cutting-edge industry tools, including neural networks (NNs), large language models (LLMs), and various embedding techniques for text, images, and videos. Additionally, you will apply traditional ML methods such as XGBoost and linear models to enhance our systems. You’ll be responsible for turning raw data into valuable signals and building ML systems end-to-end. If you're a recent graduate or soon-to-be graduate, join us and unlock a world of carefully curated experiences, knowledge, and connections to shape your career. Along the way, you can expect all the training and support you need to make your mark on the world. Put simply, we’ll empower you to help determine how we do things and where we go next. Our graduates are a vital part of our success. If you’re curious, creative, and ambitious, this is a world in which you can truly belong.

Our Expert Program

You'll join our expert program, a 1 year targeted, fast-track program designed to give you depth and breadth of experience. Participating in job-based bespoke training from the start enabling you to go fully-equipped into your role as you develop specialist technical expertise.

Why the Quant Graduate Program? 

Our team is an integral part of the bank, researching and developing models and producing data analysis tools for valuation and risk management across various business areas at Barclays.

Risk Quantitative Analytics (Risk QA) 

As a Graduate in Risk Quantitative Analytics (Risk QA), you will join a group of specialised modellers and developers powering Barclay’s ability to manage financial risk. From day one, you’ll be part of a team that uses statistical methods, AI techniques, and coding strategies to build the tools and models Barclays uses to make big decisions. Along the way, you’ll collaborate with colleagues across risk, finance, global markets, and technology - gaining exposure to how different parts of the business come together to navigate market shifts and meet regulatory demands.

The chance to make an impact

We’ll provide you with challenging projects and opportunities to grow and learn. We’ll keep you motivated with encouragement, feedback and support as you build your technical know-how, business acumen and leadership skills. We’ll help you connect with mentors, and network with colleagues and senior leaders alike.

To be considered for this opportunity, you will have completed or be in your final year of a postgraduate degree (Masters degree, equivalent or higher) and have a GPA of 3.4 or above. You will be completing your studies in a technical discipline such as Mathematics, Quantitative Finance, Statistics, Calculus Physics, Economics, Computer Science, Machine Learning or other similar subjects.

You'll have strong mathematical and programming skills (ideally in C++, or Python), some financial knowledge (regarding financial instruments, asset simulation or pricing models) and a passion to learn more about the banking sector, the financial services industry and capital markets.

You’ll be great at communicating and collaborating – driven to identify the best solution to a problem and then motivated to deliver that solution at pace.

You’ll also be ready to develop a deep understanding of what we do, why we do it, and how your role impacts our business outcomes.

These are qualities people at Barclays have in abundance, and we’ll help you further develop them from the day you arrive.

Barclays will not offer or consider offering sponsorship for work visas or offer any employment-based immigration sponsorship for individuals, now or in the future, unless such individuals are enrolled in or graduate with a degree in a field of study that the U.S. Department of Homeland Security and the Department of Education consider to be a science, technology, engineering or mathematics (STEM) field of study for purposes of the 24-month STEM OPT extension. This includes for any internship, post-graduation program, or permanent employment, now or in the future.

Working in New York

Join us at our Americas Headquarters, located at 745 Seventh Avenue—right in the heart of Times Square. This iconic 37-story tower offers more than just a prime Manhattan address. Inside, you’ll find a vibrant workplace with a modern cafeteria, a fully equipped fitness center, and cutting-edge LED signage lighting up the skyline. It’s a dynamic space designed to energize your day and inspire your best work.

rows.descriptionText:
About The Role And Team

Working in Science at Uber means solving complex marketplace problems in a high-stakes, fast-moving environment. You will be joining the Rider Pricing and Incentives Science team, which owns our automated real-time pricing systems. You'll turn massive amounts of unstructured marketplace data into focused algorithmic strategies, navigating ambiguity to build technologies that directly influence every ride decision made across our global mobility marketplace.

In this role, you'll serve as the vital bridge between technical depth and real-world business impact. We are looking for experienced candidates with strong quantitative expertise across data science, operations research, statistics, and economics. You will thrive here if you possess an owner's mindset, combine algorithmic rigour with practical execution, and excel at driving complex initiatives through close cross-functional collaboration with product and engineering partners.

What You'll Do

 Build, scale, and optimize statistical, mathematical programming, and ML models for dynamic pricing applications.  Generate data insights to identify opportunities to enhance algorithm performance.  Develop novel experimentation and causal inference methodologies tailored to complex, highly interconnected marketplace settings.  Collaborate deeply across disciplines with Product, Engineering, and Operations to identify growth opportunities, align on key success metrics, and drive systems end-to-end from ideation to production.  Translate granular marketplace data and complex optimization results into clear, actionable business strategies for leadership.  Unblock technical and operational barriers by designing robust diagnostic tools, logging infrastructure, and marketplace metrics. 

 Basic Qualifications 

 Ph.D., M.S., or Bachelor's degree in Operations Research, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or equivalent quantitative field.  5+ years of professional industry experience as an Applied Scientist, Data Scientist, Economist, or equivalent (or 3+ years with a Ph.D.).  Strong foundation in at least one key domain: control theory, mathematical optimization, statistical inference, machine learning, econometrics.  Proficiency in Python/R and SQL for large-scale data analysis and algorithmic prototyping. rows.descriptionText:
About The Team

Grocery and Retail is a startup within Uber, focused on building the future of on-demand commerce. We power delivery across groceries, alcohol, convenience, pet, pharmacy, retail, and more-combining the speed and innovation of a startup with the scale of Uber's global platform.

Our commercial organization supports a diverse portfolio of merchants, ranging from strategic Enterprise partners to thousands of small and medium-sized businesses. Successfully serving both requires a combination of high-touch relationship management and scalable commercial programs.

We're looking for a Commercial Program Manager who will directly own a portfolio of Enterprise merchant relationships while also leading programs that improve how we support, engage, and grow our long-tail SMB business.

About The Role

As a Commercial Program Manager, you will operate across two critical areas of our commercial organization: Enterprise Account Management and SMB Program Management.

You will directly manage a select portfolio of Enterprise merchants, owning the commercial relationship, business performance, and long-term growth strategy for those partners. You'll develop joint business plans, identify growth opportunities, lead business reviews, navigate operational challenges, and work cross-functionally to strengthen each partnership.

At the same time, you will lead programs designed to improve how Uber manages thousands of SMB merchants at scale. Rather than directly managing the SMB long tail, you'll build and optimize the programs, processes, segmentation strategies, reporting, automation, and commercial playbooks that enable Account Managers and Account Coordinators to effectively manage large books of business.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong commercial and relationship-management skills with structured program management, analytical thinking, and operational problem solving. Success requires the ability to move seamlessly between strategic merchant conversations and building scalable solutions for a complex commercial organization.

What You'll Do

 Enterprise Account Management & Growth - 30% 

 Own a select portfolio of Enterprise merchant partners, serving as the primary commercial point of contact and trusted advisor.  Develop joint business plans focused on growing sales, improving operational performance, and strengthening long-term partnerships.  Identify and execute growth opportunities across promotions, advertising, merchandising, product adoption, and other commercial levers.  Lead regular business reviews using performance data and marketplace insights to identify opportunities and establish clear action plans.  Lead commercial conversations and negotiations while balancing merchant objectives with Uber's broader business priorities.
