rows.title: Insurance Business Sr. Manager
rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Join eBay’s Financial Services group to help grow our global Insurance business through crafting protection solutions that foster trust and improve the buying and selling experience on eBay’s marketplace. Your focus will be on enabling and managing insurance products linked to marketplace purchases like extended warranties, product protection, and shipping or transaction-related protection. You will also support B2B insurance opportunities for sellers, including liability, cyber, business interruption, and other relevant commercial coverages.

This is a highly cross-functional role with global reach. You will collaborate directly with Product & Tech, Legal/Compliance, Risk, Analytics, Marketing, regional business teams, and external insurance partners to launch, scale, and optimize insurance programs across key markets.

What you will accomplish

Responsible for growing insurance programs as a business area: Manage the strategy, roadmap, economics, and performance of consumer and seller-focused insurance products.Take ownership of program P&L, revenue, margin, attach rate, conversion, customer experience, and partner performance.Launch and scale insurance solutions across markets: Lead the development and rollout of new insurance programs, from opportunity sizing and making the case through partner selection, commercial negotiation, product launch, and ongoing optimization.Build customer-centric protection journeys: Collaborate with Product, Development, Engineering, Analytics, and regional teams to integrate insurance and protection offers into relevant buyer and seller flows. Enhance targeting, offer presentation, eligibility, quote, purchase, servicing, and claims experiences.Drive insurance partnerships and commercial agreements: Discover, appraise, negotiate, and maintain relationships with insurers, brokers, MGAs, warranty providers, insurtechs, and other key partners. Guide contract negotiations, determine commercial arrangements, carry out performance reviews, and manage operational or commercial issues.Balance growth, trust, and regulatory requirements: Work closely with Legal, Compliance, Risk, and partner teams to ensure insurance programs meet applicable regulatory, conduct, marketing, and customer protection standards across markets. Support compliant product development, customer communications, and claims-related processes.Drive performance through data and operating rhythm: Establish and manage key performance indicators, reporting, and business reviews. Use data to find opportunities to improve conversion, attach rates, loss ratios, claims experience, customer happiness, revenue, and margin.Contribute to the overall insurance strategy by identifying new products, ways to enter markets, partnership types, and commercial frameworks that improve eBay’s Financial Services for buyers and sellers globally.


What you will bring

Insurance experience: Over 8 years of background in insurance, insurtech, financial services, e-commerce, marketplace, retail, or embedded protection products. Solid expertise in consumer insurance is essential, preferably involving extended warranties, product protection, purchase protection, device protection, shipping protection, or other insurance offerings related to e-commerce transactions.B2B insurance exposure: Experience with seller, merchant, SME, or commercial insurance products is preferred, such as general liability, professional liability, cyber insurance, business interruption, goods-in-transit, or other protection products relevant to online sellers.Program P&L ownership: Demonstrated experience owning or materially contributing to large-scale program P&L, including revenue, margin, commercial performance, partner economics, and customer or portfolio-level indicators.Launch and scaling experience: Experience launching new insurance, protection, or financial services programs across one or more markets. Experience moving from concept and developing the case to partner selection, implementation, go-to-market, and post-launch optimization.Business development and negotiation skills: Demonstrated proficiency in business development, partner sourcing, commercial negotiation, and contract management. Able to structure deals, assess partner capabilities, negotiate commercial terms, and manage performance against agreed goals.Customer and product orientation: Practical understanding of how embedded insurance products fit within digital customer journeys. Able to partner with Product and Tech teams to boost offer relevance, conversion, customer trust, servicing, and claims experience.


Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

rows.title: Senior Director, Ecosystem Product (Builder Platform)
rows.descriptionText:
Role Summary

Our mission at HubSpot is to help millions of organizations grow better. As AI transforms how work gets done, HubSpot is building a Builder Platform that unites our ecosystem, data platform, and agent capabilities into a cohesive experience for developers, partners, and go-to-market builders.

As Senior Director, Ecosystem Product, you will define and execute the ecosystem strategy that powers HubSpot's Builder Platform vision. You will lead the developer platform, APIs, MCP strategy, marketplace, strategic integrations, and builder experiences that enable customers, partners, and AI agents to build on HubSpot.

This role sits at the intersection of developer ecosystems, agent platforms, marketplaces, and go-to-market workflows. You will help shape how first-party, second-party, and third-party agents work together to deliver customer outcomes while creating new opportunities for ecosystem growth and monetization.

What You’ll Do

Define and execute the ecosystem strategy that supports HubSpot's Builder Platform vision, enabling developers, partners, and go-to-market builders to create solutions on and around HubSpot. Shape how first-party, second-party, and third-party agents interact with HubSpot through APIs, MCP, and emerging agent frameworks. Drive API parity initiatives so customers and partners can access HubSpot capabilities consistently through both UI and programmatic interfaces. Partner closely with Data Platform, Partnerships, and Product Hub leaders to create a unified builder experience across HubSpot's intelligence, data, and work layers. Develop monetization strategies for APIs, ecosystem products, and agent-powered experiences that support HubSpot's transition toward outcome-based and consumption-based business models. Lead and develop a senior, multi-team product organization across platform, marketplace, and ecosystem experiences.Build a seamless developer experience by improving API/MCP quality, documentation, tooling, governance, and platform reliability.Define how developers, partners, and go-to-market builders create AI-powered applications, workflows, agents, and integrations that drive measurable customer outcomes. Drive a best-in-class marketplace experience that enables customers to discover, evaluate, and adopt ecosystem solutions.Partner cross-functionally with Developer Relations, Partnerships, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to embed ecosystem solutions into the flywheel.Establish operating models, decision frameworks, and execution cadences that enable fast, data-driven ecosystem innovation.Represent HubSpot externally with developers, partners, and industry leaders to shape ecosystem strategy and credibility.

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications

10+ years of product management experience, including leadership of large, multi-team product organizations.Proven success building and scaling developer platforms, APIs, app marketplaces, or ecosystem products serving large developer, partner, or builder communities. Experience evolving platforms to support AI-powered workflows, agents, MCP-enabled experiences, or agent ecosystems.Experience working with partner ecosystems, strategic integrations, marketplaces, or platform monetization models. Track record of turning ecosystems into growth drivers that impact acquisition, retention, or revenue.Strong perspective on AI, agents, platform ecosystems, and how agentic workflows change the design of developer platforms, marketplaces, and customer experiences. Experience partnering with Developer Relations, developer communities, partner programs, or ecosystem-facing functions. Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders at the executive level.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

Experience with CRM, marketing, sales, or service ecosystems.Background working closely with Developer Relations or similar functions.External-facing experience (e.g., public speaking, developer community engagement).Experience in high-growth SaaS environments where ecosystem strategy is core to differentiation.

Pay & Benefits

The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are tailored to your skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see. Learn more about HubSpot’s compensation philosophy.

Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

Annual Cash Compensation Range

$333,500—$533,600 USD

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

Explore More

HubSpot CareersLife at HubSpot on Instagram

If you need accommodations or assistance due to a disability, please reach out to us using this form.

Massachusetts Applicants: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Germany Applicants: (m/f/d) - link to HubSpot's Career Diversity page here.

India Applicants: link to HubSpot India's equal opportunity policy here.

HubSpot may use AI to help screen or assess candidates, but all hiring decisions are always human. More information can be found here. By submitting your application, you agree that HubSpot may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. We may use CLEAR ID Verification during the hiring process to confirm your identity and help maintain a safe, secure, and trusted experience for all candidates. Refer to HubSpot's Recruiting Privacy Notice for details on data processing and your rights.

rows.title: Director - Logistics & Transportation
rows.descriptionText:
Williams-Sonoma, Inc Supply Chain Overview

By managing resources responsibly, caring for our people, and uniting around our values, we lead our industry and are proud to be recognized for our continuous action and progress in the following areas: Barron's 100 Most Sustainable Companies; Forbes Best Employers for Women and Diversity; Newsweek America's Most Responsible Companies; and USA Today Customer Service Champions. These honors reflect that we are truly a people-first organization.

Over 4,000 Full-Time Associates across the Supply Chain.14.5M square feet of small parcel, personalization, furniture, and manufacturing space in the domestic US, Williams-Sonoma has developed an agile and capable distribution network consisting of the following:Large package/furniture distribution centers located in Southern California, Northern California, Texas, Georgia, and New Jersey totaling 9.2M square feet plus another 1.2M square feet of standalone final-mile furniture hubs.Small package eCommerce distribution centers located in Mississippi and Arizona totaling 3.2M square feet, consisting of over 1,000 full-time associates and 1,500 seasonal/temporary associates in Mississippi.Sutter Street Manufacturing upholstery factories located in North Carolina and Mississippi totaling with over 1,400 full-time employees producing approximately $900 million to $1 billion in sales of upholstered furniture.Transportation Department for Ocean, Air, Trucking, and Rail consisting of over 30 transportation professionals located in Memphis, TN.700 associates in our Sourcing offices in 10 countries in Asia and Europe including China, Vietnam, Singapore, India, Italy, and Turkey.The Director, Logistics & Transportation position is located in Memphis, TN.We are seeking a highly accomplished transportation leader to oversee the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of our end-to-end transportation network. This role is responsible for leading all transportation modes, including Less-than-Truckload (LTL), Full Truckload (FTL), Intermodal, Parcel, Ocean, and Air Freight, while optimizing service, cost, network efficiency, and customer experience.
Partner closely with Distribution Operations, Supply Planning, Inventory Management, Merchandising, Customs Compliance, Finance, Customer Care, Procurement, and Technology to ensure our transportation network supports business growth while maintaining operational excellence.

This position requires an executive who combines strategic vision with operational discipline, excels in data-driven decision-making, and is passionate about developing people and building high-performing teams.

Transportation Strategy

You'll be excited about this opportunity because you will:

Develop and execute an enterprise transportation strategy supporting domestic and international operations.Optimize transportation networks across LTL, Truckload, Intermodal, Parcel, Ocean, and Air.Lead transportation procurement, carrier sourcing, contract negotiations, and annual bid events.Develop long-term network strategies that improve service, resiliency, and cost efficiency.Monitor transportation market conditions and proactively adjust network strategies.

Parcel Operations & Optimization

Own the enterprise parcel strategy supporting direct-to-consumer, eCommerce, retail replenishment, and B2B shipments.Develop multi-carrier parcel strategies across multiple parcel carriers, and emerging last-mile providers.Lead parcel carrier negotiations and optimize transportation spend while maintaining service commitments.Drive parcel optimization initiatives including zone skipping, carrier diversification, consolidation, dimensional weight reduction, packaging optimization, and routing improvements.Monitor parcel KPIs including cost per package, on-time delivery, transit performance, delivery exceptions, claims, and customer experience.Partner with Distribution Centers to improve carton utilization, packaging efficiency, and shipping profiles.Ensure peak season parcel capacity and network resiliency.

Carrier Management

Build executive relationships with transportation providers.Negotiate transportation contracts and service agreements.Develop carrier scorecards measuring cost, service, capacity, claims, and performance.Drive continuous improvement initiatives with transportation partners.

Financial & Operational Leadership

Manage a multi-million-dollar transportation budget.Lead freight forecasting, budgeting, and transportation productivity initiatives.Identify opportunities to reduce freight costs while protecting service levels.Utilize transportation analytics to support strategic decision making.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

Develop transportation dashboards and executive KPI reporting.Analyze transportation performance, cost-to-serve, carrier utilization, and network efficiency.Lead transportation optimization projects using data and analytics.Champion continuous improvement and process simplification.Build strong partnerships across the organization and influence strategic decisions through collaboration and data.

People Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing transportation organization by:

Building strong leadership talent.Coaching and mentoring managers and individual contributors.Creating clear accountability and performance expectations.Supporting succession planning and employee development.Fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

Technical Expertise

Demonstrated expertise in:

LTL.Full Truckload.Intermodal.Parcel Operations.Ocean Freight.Air Freight.Carrier Procurement.Transportation Management Systems (TMS).Transportation Analytics.Network Optimization.Routing Guides.Freight Audit and Payment.Transportation Procurement.Preferred experience with Infor, Power BI, SQL, SAP, Oracle, Manhattan, Blue Yonder, or similar transportation and analytics platforms.

Leadership Competencies

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

Strategic thinking with the ability to translate vision into execution.Strong executive presence and communication skills.Exceptional financial and analytical acumen.Customer-focused decision making.A collaborative leadership style that builds trust across the organization.Proven ability to influence without authority.Calm, decisive leadership during periods of change and operational disruption.A continuous improvement mindset with a passion for innovation.High integrity, accountability, and ownership.A commitment to coaching, mentoring, and developing future leaders.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by:

Improved on-time delivery performance.Reduced transportation cost per shipment and cost per package.Improved parcel, LTL, Truckload, Ocean, and Air carrier performance.Increased transportation network resiliency during peak seasons.Enhanced carrier scorecards and supplier relationships.Improved transportation visibility and executive reporting.Measurable productivity improvements and freight savings.Strong employee engagement, leadership development, and succession planning.

Check out some of the required qualifications we are looking for in amazing candidates:

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Engineering, or a related field.At least 10+ years of progressive transportation leadership experience.At least 5 years leading managers and cross-functional teams.Experience managing domestic and international transportation networks.

Our company benefits are second to none in the industry:

Generous discount on all Williams-Sonoma, Inc. brand products.401(k) plan and other investment opportunities.Paid vacations, Employee Assistance Programs, Time Off to Volunteer, Matching Gifts Community Service Program, and Holidays (in some locations).Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits, Legal and Identity Protection Plans and Pet Insurance.For more information on our benefits offers, please visit MyWSIBenefits.com.To learn more about our Supply Chain culture and regional associate events, please visit: https://shorturl.at/R3OAX (Login credentials may be required).

rows.title: Senior Director, HR Technology Products
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

The location for this position is virtual/remote

This is your chance to be part of a Corporate Human Resources team at a top global hospitality company! As a Senior Director, HR Technology Products, you will partner with our business leaders to attract, retain, and develop Hilton's most important asset, our Team Members. On the HR Technology team reporting to the VP of HR Technology & Innovation, you will lead Hilton's global HR Technology Product organization, overseeing the strategy, delivery, and continuous evolution of our Human Capital Management platforms. You will translate enterprise priorities into product roadmaps and technology capabilities that promote an exceptional Team Member experience while supporting Hilton's global HR strategy.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day

Lead the HR Technology Product organization responsible for Core HR, Recruiting, Learning, Talent, and related enterprise HR technology platforms.Execute the multi-year HR Technology product roadmap in partnership with the Vice President, HR Technology & Innovation, ensuring agreement on business priorities and enterprise technology strategy.Lead product lifecycle management across the portfolio, including roadmap planning, feature prioritization, backlog management, quarterly releases, adoption, and continuous improvement.Establish product management standards and governance that promote consistency, scalability, and operational excellence across all HR technology products.Partner with Product Directors to define platform strategies, prioritize enhancements, manage technical debt, and deliver measurable value.Lead modernization initiatives across Oracle Cloud HCM, Oracle Recruiting Cloud, Cornerstone Learning, and future platform capabilities, including Oracle Redwood adoption and AI-enabled functionality.Provide executive oversight of platform health, product adoption, release quality, and user experience, ensuring solutions meet Hilton's operational, security, and compliance standards.Develop and manage strategic vendor relationships, participating in roadmap discussions, quarterly business reviews, and product enhancement planning.Build and develop a Product organization through coaching, succession planning, performance management, and capability development.

How You'll Collaborate With Others

Partner with HR Centers of Excellence to understand evolving business priorities and translate them into scalable product capabilities and technology solutions.Collaborate with Global HR Operations and Service Delivery teams to improve product adoption, operational effectiveness, and the Team Member experience.Work with Enterprise Technology, Information Security, Architecture, Data & Analytics, and Integration teams to ensure solutions align with enterprise standards and technical strategy.Partner with the Vice President, HR Technology & Innovation on strategic planning, technology modernization initiatives, and product investment recommendations.Build trusted relationships with senior HR and business leaders to align product priorities, communicate technology capabilities, and support organizational transformation.Collaborate with strategic technology partners, including Oracle and Cornerstone, to maximize platform capabilities and influence future product enhancements.

Deliverables You'll Take Ownership Of

HR Technology product roadmaps across Core HR, Recruiting, Learning, and Talent platformsOracle Cloud HCM product lifecycle managementOracle Recruiting Cloud product strategy and optimizationCornerstone Learning platform roadmap and enhancementsProduct governance framework and prioritization processesQuarterly release planning, readiness, and adoption strategyPlatform modernization initiatives, including Redwood adoptionProduct performance, adoption, and customer experience metricsVendor performance management and product roadmap alignmentDevelopment Hilton's HR Technology Product Management organization

What It Takes to Make the Stay

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

Ten (10) years of progressive experience in HR Technology, HRIS, Digital HR, Product Management, or a related enterprise technology function.Seven (7) years of people leadership experience, including leading managers and multidisciplinary teams.Experience leading a portfolio of enterprise HR technologies across multiple areas of the employee lifecycle, such as Human Capital Management, Recruiting, and Learning.Experience developing and executing technology strategies and product roadmaps, including leading large-scale implementations, transformations, and platform enhancements.Strong understanding of end-to-end HR processes and how technology, data, and integrations enable the employee experience.Demonstrated leadership in a complex, matrixed environment and experience influencing senior stakeholders across HR, Technology, and business functions.Willing to travel up to 15%.

It Would Be Useful If You Have

Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Human Resources, Computer Science, or a related field.Experience with enterprise platforms such as Oracle Cloud HCM, Cornerstone, ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, or comparable technologies.Experience leading global HR technology or Product Management organizations and managing strategic technology vendors and partners.Experience with Agile Product Management, AI, automation, integrations, identity management, or HR data and analytics.Relevant enterprise technology or Product Management certifications.Experience within hospitality or another large, global, consumer-facing organization.

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we're known for doesn't end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members' wellbeing, supporting you through all of life's moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel programOwn a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial futurePaid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parentsPersonalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved onesCrisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional careMental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters mostHealth & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family coveredFinancial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what's nextBenefits availability may vary depending on Team Member's location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Hilton offers its eligible team members a comprehensive benefits package to support their mental and physical well-being, so they can Thrive personally and professionally. The pay range for this role is $190,000 - $255,000 and is determined based on applicable and specialized experience and location. Subject to plan terms and conditions, you will be eligible to participate in the Hilton Annual Incentive (Bonus) Plan, and the Company's long-term incentive plan, consistent with other team members at the same level and/or position within the Company.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Be part of an amazing story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

Lead Analyst, Product Analytics ensures the organization can measure and understand the impact of new digital features across the customer experience. This role connects analyses across product domains, designs and evaluates experiments, and transforms complex data into clear recommendations and compelling stories. The Lead Analyst also leads team of analysts in their day-to-day work, champions analytics best practices, and raises awareness of team opportunities, blockers, and accomplishments to enable timely, high-quality results.

What You Will Do

Provide analytics thought leadership to digital and enterprise partners to improve site functionality, feature development, and omni-channel analytics.Lead strategic analytics initiatives across teams and product domain.Solve complex analytical problems to identify opportunities that improve the customer experience.Lead analysts by directly overseeing work, supporting day-to-day analyses, and raising awareness of opportunities, blockers, and accomplishments.Develop standard reporting, analytical frameworks, and key performance indicators that enable critical business decisions.Identify opportunities to automate and enhance existing reporting and analytical processes.Define and execute audits of analytics tracking to ensure accurate data collection across analytics systems.Develop training and promote best practices that help product teams and analysts use data and tools effectively.Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.

Skills You Will Need

Product Analytics: Advanced ability to analyze digital feature performance, site usage, and customer experience across product domains.Technical Analytics: Expert proficiency with digital analytics and strong expertise in SQL and data manipulation.Experimentation: Ability to design, implement, and evaluate experiments that generate actionable business insights.Data Storytelling: Ability to translate complex findings into clear recommendations, reports, visualizations, and compelling narratives.Analytics Leadership: Ability to lead analysts, lead cross-functional initiatives, deliver training, and influence digital and enterprise partners.

Who You Are

8+ plus years of experience in e-commerce and/or retail analyticsBachelor’s degree required, with a Master’s degree in Statistics, Analytics, Mathematics, or a related field preferred.Proven track record of applying analytics expertise to complex customer and business problems and influencing cross-functional partners through data-driven recommendations.Advanced proficiency with web analytics tools, preferably Adobe AnalyticsStrong expertise in SQL and data manipulation, with experience using Tableau or other visualization platforms.Regularly required to sit, talk, hear; use hands/fingers to touch, handle, and feel. Occasionally required to move about the workplace and reach with hands and arms. Requires close vision.Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some Additional Benefits We Offer Include

Merchandise discountsPerformance-based incentivesAnnual merit reviewEmployee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial adviceTuition reimbursement

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - apply today! 

This position may be eligible for performance-based incentives/bonuses. Benefits include 401k, medical/vision/dental/life/disability insurance options, PTO accruals, Holidays, and more. Eligibility requirements may apply based on location, job level, classification, and length of employment. Additional benefit details are available at macysJOBS.com.

rows.title: Affiliate Marketing Manager (contract)
rows.descriptionText:
Please note that this is a contract role providing services to Hilton through Talent Solutions. If you are selected for this role, you will be employed by Talent Solutions and will not be an employee of Hilton. Contract workers are not employees of Hilton or any of its subsidiaries, nor will they be eligible for Hilton benefits.

US based remote role***

Job Summary

Hilton has an exciting opportunity for an experienced performance marketing professional to join the Americas Media Activation – Acquisition team. This hybrid role combines performance marketing strategy, partner management, and operational execution to support the planning, execution, and optimization of the Affiliate channel across brands and markets. Working cross-functionally with Planning, Regional Marketing, Content, Analytics, and external partners, this individual will help manage day-to-day affiliate operations, publisher relationships, and performance reporting while supporting broader customer acquisition and revenue objectives. This role serves as the product leader for UXL and is accountable for driving platform adoption, product innovation, operational excellence, and value realization while ensuring alignment with enterprise business and technology objectives.

The Sr Manager partners closely with Digital, Enterprise, Engineering, Architecture, Experience Design, Operations, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, evaluate investments, and deliver scalable capabilities that improve customer experiences, accelerate development velocity, and enhance platform performance. This position owns the integrated multi-year UXL product roadmap and is responsible for balancing customer needs, business priorities, technical dependencies, platform modernization efforts, technical debt, and operational considerations.

As a strategic product leader, this role is accountable for the full product lifecycle, including product discovery, roadmap planning, business case development, prioritization, delivery oversight, adoption strategy, performance measurement, and continuous optimization. The Sr Manager leverages customer feedback, platform analytics, and stakeholder insights to make data-driven investment and prioritization decisions while ensuring successful delivery of measurable business outcomes.

The successful candidate brings a strong product mindset, platform-thinking approach, and experience leading API-based products and shared platform capabilities. This role requires exceptional stakeholder management skills, the ability to influence across a highly matrixed organization, and a proven track record of driving product adoption, alignment, and business value at scale. The candidate should also demonstrate exposure to or proficiency in Artificial Intelligence (AI), including the ability to leverage AI and automation to improve product management practices, introduce process efficiencies, accelerate decision-making, enhance product insights, and identify opportunities to create customer and business value through AI-enabled solutions.

This position serves as a product champion for UXL, promoting platform capabilities, responsible AI adoption, product best practices, and customer-centric thinking across Marriott's Digital and Enterprise ecosystem.

CANDIDATE PROFILE 

Required

Education and Experience 

8+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Digital Product Delivery, Technology Strategy, or related technology disciplines. 3+ years of experience leading cross-functional teams, initiatives, products, or product portfolios in a matrixed environment. Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience/certification. Experience leading digital products, API products, shared platforms, or enterprise technology capabilities. Strong understanding of Agile product development methodologies and tools, including JIRA. Demonstrated experience developing product vision, roadmaps, business cases, and investment recommendations. Proven ability to translate business objectives and customer needs into scalable product capabilities. Experience defining and measuring KPIs, product adoption metrics, platform performance metrics, and business outcomes. Demonstrated ability to influence decisions and align stakeholders across business and technology organizations. Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage technical teams, executives, and business stakeholders. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and competing priorities. Understanding of API technologies, service-based architectures, and platform products. Experience leading shared products, enterprise platforms, or reusable technology capabilities. Exposure to or proficiency in AI, Generative AI, and automation capabilities, with the ability to identify and apply AI-enabled solutions to improve product management practices, product operations, discovery, prioritization, analytics, stakeholder engagement, or process efficiencies. Familiarity with responsible AI principles, governance considerations, and adoption practices for enterprise use of AI-enabled tools and solutions. 

Preferred

Experience with GraphQL technologies and API governance practices. Experience managing platform adoption and consumer enablement programs. Understanding of digital customer experience journeys and channel ecosystems. Experience developing KPI frameworks, product reporting, and value realization dashboards. Familiarity with product discovery techniques, customer research, and experimentation methodologies. Experience partnering with Architecture, Engineering, Design, Operations, Security, and Enterprise teams. Experience managing roadmap dependencies across multiple products and teams. Knowledge of modern product management practices and Product Operating Models. Experience supporting digital transformation, enterprise modernization, or platform transformation initiatives. Experience using AI-powered productivity, analytics, collaboration, or product management tools to improve team effectiveness and decision quality. Strong facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. 

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES 

Product Strategy & Roadmap Leadership

Defines and executes the vision, strategy, goals, and roadmap for the Unified Experience Layer (UXL). Establishes and maintains a multi-year roadmap aligned to Digital and Enterprise business objectives. Identifies opportunities to improve platform capabilities, adoption, scalability, developer experience, and operational effectiveness. Evaluates product opportunities and prioritizes investments based on customer value, business impact, risk, and technical feasibility. Partners with leaders across Digital, Enterprise, and Technology organizations to align priorities and drive product direction. Balances innovation, operational needs, platform modernization, and technical debt considerations within the roadmap. Develops product business cases and supports investment recommendations and prioritization decisions. Evaluates emerging AI capabilities, industry trends, and technology innovations to identify opportunities that accelerate product outcomes and create business value. 

Product Lifecycle Management

Leads the end-to-end product lifecycle from discovery through delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement. Drives product discovery efforts by gathering stakeholder feedback, customer needs, platform insights, analytics, and market trends. Defines product requirements, epics, features, and acceptance criteria to support successful delivery. Partners with Product Owners, Engineering, and Architecture teams to ensure roadmap execution aligns to strategic objectives. Oversees backlog health, prioritization, and roadmap alignment across multiple initiatives and stakeholder groups. Ensures delivered capabilities achieve intended business, customer, operational, and platform outcomes. Uses AI-enabled tools and automation, where appropriate, to improve product discovery, documentation, insights generation, requirements refinement, prioritization, and product operations. 

UXL Product Adoption & Consumer Enablement

Drives adoption of UXL products across Digital and Enterprise channels to expand usage and measurable value. Improves onboarding, consumer readiness, contributor effectiveness, and engagement with UXL capabilities. Partners with consumers and contributors to identify enhancements that improve usability, delivery efficiency, and product value. Serves as a product advocate for UXL capabilities, GraphQL/API products, and reusable experience-layer offerings. Streamlines enablement, intake, onboarding, reporting, and stakeholder communications through automation and AI-assisted workflows. 

Stakeholder Leadership & Governance

Serves as the primary product lead and strategic point of contact for UXL stakeholders. Facilitates prioritization discussions and drives alignment across multiple business and technology organizations. Presents roadmap updates, investment recommendations, KPIs, product performance metrics, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to senior leadership. Establishes governance practices, intake frameworks, and prioritization processes to support effective decision-making. Uses adoption, engagement, performance, reliability, operational, and customer experience metrics to guide product decisions and roadmap priorities. Maintains awareness of emerging industry trends, technologies, and practices relevant to AI, API products, platform products, and digital experiences.

Maintains knowledge of emerging technologies, industry trends, AI-enabled product practices, and modern product management methods. Applies sound judgment and strategic thinking to complex business and technology decisions. Acts as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders. Their objective is to improve the foundation of the website’s taxonomy and navigation, work on attribution of products, and analyze data to optimize the customer’s discovery and selection. They optimize search, execute promotions and marketing tactics, perform site maintenance, maximize onsite assets, and use analytics to drive sales and conversion. Cross-functional partners include digital analytics, merchants, marketing, creative, pricing, affiliate, SEM, and SEO teams.

Marketing and Promotion Execution: Experienced in executing promotions, event optimization, and supporting affiliate and SEM strategies.

Strategic Thinking and Planning: Capable of identifying sales opportunities, collaborating with merchant teams, and conducting competitive analysis.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Excellent in building strategic relationships across functions, demonstrating leadership and interpersonal skills.

Customer Focus: Dedicated to achieving customer satisfaction and improving the customer shopping experience.

Communication Skills: Practices effective, clear, and continuous communication, ensuring others are well-informed.

Creative and Analytical Thinking: Thinks creatively, analytically, strategically, and technically to solve problems and innovate.

Project Management: Manages multiple tasks and projects, ensuring site maintenance and optimization of onsite assets.

Business Acumen: Understands the digital retail landscape, competitive best practices, and collaborates with business intelligence teams for strategic site audits.

Who You Are

Candidates with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. 1-2 years of related experience. This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Merchandise discounts Performance-based incentives Annual merit review Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice Tuition reimbursement 

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - apply today!

JOB DESCRIPTION 

We designed our program to be a game-changing first step in kicking off your career journey. We're looking for the next generation of home merchandisers who can bring fresh ideas and perspectives to our brands. During this 10-week program, you'll develop your skills alongside a team of supportive mentors and inspiring leaders.

Merchandising blends creativity, analytics, and marketing  to drive customer engagement and profitability. As an intern, you'll work closely with a team for a specific category (ex: furniture, tabletop, bath, etc) to get behind the scenes insight on how they create product strategies, manage pricing, and interpret data. You'll use this to develop your own new product recommendations.

ABOUT YOU


 Passionate about product, home decor, and retail  Keep up with home design trends  Currently in your junior year of an undergraduate program  Minimum GPA of 3.5  Able to work onsite at one of our brands in Portland  Know how to prioritize and move quickly to react to our ever-changing business  Think strategically and critically to solve problems  Have Excel experience: vlooks-ups, pivot tables, etc… 


OUR PROGRAM

Our program is designed for undergraduate students graduating in 2028. During your internship, you will be a part of an intern cohort working for Rejuvenation in Portland. Throughout the program, you will attend business critical meetings, lead projects, gain experience working with cross-functional teams, attend professional trainings, and have the chance to brainstorm with our leadership team.

At the end of the program, you are given the opportunity to pioneer a new idea and present it to our executive leadership team. Many of our interns' project proposals have been implemented in new business strategies, as we value the fresh perspective our interns bring to the business.

Of course, we also leave time for a little fun by hosting social and networking opportunities with your fellow interns such as cohort lunches, and social hours.

WHEN

Our 10 week program runs June 7th - August 13th (start date is flexible for students on the quarter system).

WHERE

Portland, OR. Onsite 4x a week.

ABOUT US

Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a global, multi-channel retailer of home furnishings and housewares (our family of brands includes Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn teen, west elm, Rejuvenation, GreenRow and Mark & Graham), but we operate within smaller teams, giving each person an opportunity for hands-on experience. Together, our brands represent a strong, diverse and growing portfolio that allow us to reach customers in a new way every day - and we'd love your help.

Our Performance Driven Culture Is Best Described As Entrepreneurial, Collaborative, And Purpose Driven. Our Teams Are Filled With Smart And Innovative People Who Have Helped Us Achieve Such Accolades Such As:


 American Innovation Index Top 25 Most Innovative Companies, 2023  Barron’s 100 Most Sustainable U.S. Companies, 2023  Newsweek’s America’s Greatest Workplaces, 2023  Newsweek’s America’s Greatest Workplaces for Women, 2022  Newsweek’s America’s Best Customer Service, 2024  Time World’s Best Companies, 2024  Fortune 500 List, 2022

Actual pay will be determined based on experience and other job-related factors permitted by law.  ABOUT US 

Our Company

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

BA/BS/Bachelor's DegreeExperience working in a heavily matrixed environmentA solid understanding of and a passion for Development and the Hospitality industry

We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parentsPersonalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved onesCrisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional careMental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

rows.title: Staff Data Eng, Data Systems, TCGplayer
rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About The Team And The Role

TCGplayer, an eBay company, powers a marketplace for buyers, sellers, hobby shops, and collectors across the trading card community. For many people, TCGplayer is more than a marketplace. It is part of how they discover, enjoy, and stay connected to the hobby they love! The Data Engineering team helps make that experience possible by building the systems, standards, and partnerships that make data easier to trust, easier to work with, and easier to scale across TCGplayer Technology.

As a Staff Data Engineer, you will join our Data Engineering team and server as a technical leader, helping shape technical direction across warehouse and application-facing systems. You will work closely with engineering, platform, and analytics teams to strengthen data governance, improve confidence in data-related changes across distributed environments, and guide sound decisions around datastores, data movement, and system design. This is a highly collaborative Staff Data Engineer role with broad influence across TCGplayer, with the opportunity to raise engineering standards, support long-term platform health, and help teams build with greater clarity and confidence.

What You Will Accomplish

Serve as a technical leader in data systems, setting direction and raising the bar for engineers through architecture guidance, standards, and hands-on partnership across TCGplayer Technology.Strengthen Snowflake governance, access controls, security, observability, and cost management so warehouse workloads are more reliable, efficient, and easier to scale.Improve how teams validate and test data-related changes across distributed environments, increasing release confidence in systems that span warehouse, services, and application-facing platforms.Guide datastore and architecture decisions across operational and warehouse systems, helping teams make strong tradeoff decisions based on reliability, scale, maintainability, and product needs.Lead cross-application datastore initiatives, including migrations and platform upgrades, with emphasis on security, governance, and alignment with architecture standards.Partner with application and platform teams to bring greater clarity to data ownership, service boundaries, and data movement across transactional products, microservices, and event-driven systems.Enable teams to move faster by providing guidance on Postgres design, performance, and datastore decisions, increasing consistency and engineering leverage across the organization.


What You Will Bring

10+ years of experience designing, improving, or supporting production platforms across data warehousing, operational datastores, distributed systems, or data architecture.Hands-on experience with Snowflake in production environments, including governance, access controls, security, observability, performance, reliability, and cost management.Strong experience with relational databases, ideally Postgres, including schema design, indexing, query optimization, transactions, scaling, and production troubleshooting.Experience guiding datastore and architecture decisions across technologies such as Postgres, MongoDB, Redis, Snowflake, and similar platforms.Experience with microservices and event-driven systems (Kafka and Debezium preferred), including retries, idempotency, ordering, and change data capture.Strong communication and technical judgment, with a track record of influencing across teams and improving reliability, testing, governance, observability, or engineering practices in complex environments.

$136,000 - $228,600

Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

rows.title: Analytics Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Our Opportunity:

At Chewy, the Finance and Accounting Business Intelligence team builds trusted reporting and analytics solutions that help our partners make faster, data-backed decisions. We are seeking an experienced Analytics Engineer to design, develop, and maintain dashboards, data products, and analytical workflows that support financial reporting, planning, and operational decision-making.

This team serves a broad audience across Finance, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, and other business functions. In this role, you will partner directly with users to understand requirements, translate complex questions into scalable solutions, and deliver clear, reliable reporting. Your work will span report development, data modeling, pipeline support, automation, and analysis using tools such as Tableau, Sigma, SQL, Python, and cloud data platforms.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical and analytical skills with curiosity, ownership, and clear communication. This opportunity is well suited for someone who is passionate about data, comfortable in a fast-paced environment, and motivated to improve how Chewy turns financial and operational data into trusted insights.

What You'll Do

Own the design, development, testing, and maintenance of dashboards, reports, and analytical content that support critical Finance and Accounting decisions.Partner with business and technical teams to gather requirements, define metrics, and translate user needs into scalable, high-quality BI solutions.Design and maintain semantic views that provide trusted business context, standardized metrics, and governed data for AI agent consumption.Develop self-service reporting and visualizations in Tableau, Sigma, or similar tools, with a focus on usability, performance, and trusted data.Build and support SQL transformations, data models, pipelines, and API-driven integrations that deliver accurate and timely analytical datasets.Champion reporting and analysis best practices, including data integrity, test design, validation, documentation, and change management.Provide leadership and business partners with recurring and ad hoc analyses that clearly communicate findings, trends, risks, and opportunities.Identify automation opportunities using Python, AWS, AI, or other technologies to simplify workflows and reduce manual effort.Investigate data discrepancies and reporting issues, coordinate resolution across teams, and communicate impacts and next steps to stakeholders.Continuously improve reporting, data products, and development processes to increase the quality, accessibility, and value of Chewy's data.

What You'll Need

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.5+ years of experience in business intelligence engineering, analytics engineering, report development, or a related data discipline.Strong SQL skills, including complex transformations and experience working with columnar or cloud-based data warehouses.Hands-on experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions in Tableau or a similar BI and visualization tool.Working knowledge of Python and experience supporting data pipelines, APIs, automation scripts, or analytical workflows.Ability to acquire data from multiple sources, maintain reusable data structures, and validate datasets for analytical use.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present findings to subject matter experts and executive leadership.Comfort with self-directed learning, changing priorities, and taking ownership in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

Bonus

Experience with AWS, Snowflake, and/or Sigma.Experience supporting Finance and Accounting analytics or reporting.Familiarity with dbt, dimensional data modeling, or automated testing.A strong ownership mentality and continuous-improvement mindset.

Chewy is seeking a customer-obsessed, analytically rigorous Senior Manager, Healthcare Media Planning to shape and execute the media strategy for our growing healthcare retail business. Working closely with Marketing, Channels, Finance, Analytics, and Creative teams, you will recommend how we invest, whom we reach, where we reach them, and which messages are most effective in order to drive our business and consumer objectives.

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with deep media-planning expertise. You know how to translate audience insights and performance data into clear investment recommendations, develop integrated plans for channel teams to activate, and identify opportunities to test new approaches. Job Description

About the Team

You will be a key member of the Supply Chain Product Management team responsible for delivering technology capabilities that modernize and optimize Williams-Sonoma's end-to-end supply chain. The team partners closely with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Merchandising, Engineering, Architecture, Analytics, and Technology to deliver scalable product capabilities that improve operational efficiency, inventory productivity, manufacturing performance, and customer experience. You will be a key member of the Supply Chain Product Management team that is responsible for continuous improvement of our supply chain by focusing on removing friction points for our internal and external customers by delivering a highly satisfying experience.

About The Role

Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is in the business of enhancing the quality of our customers' lives at home. This critical Principal Product Manager role owns the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for Williams-Sonoma's Manufacturing technology domain, supporting our in-house furniture and lighting manufacturing operations. This leader will define and deliver capabilities that improve manufacturing planning, production execution, inventory visibility, quality, scheduling, materials management, shop floor operations, and fulfillment while enabling scalable growth across our manufacturing network. This role operates across strategy and execution, partnering with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Technology leaders to define product strategy, prioritize investments, and deliver measurable business outcomes across Williams-Sonoma's manufacturing network. The right candidate will have deep experience with discrete manufacturing as well as the associated logistics and transportation activities and a techno-functional / Product Management background.

Responsibilities


 This role operates across product strategy and execution, partnering with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Technology leaders to modernize manufacturing capabilities and deliver measurable business outcomes across Williams-Sonoma's manufacturing network.  Own the Manufacturing product strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities, identifying opportunities through customer insights, operational data, and hypothesis-driven product discovery focused on measurable business outcomes.  Monitor emerging manufacturing, supply chain, ERP, AI, and digital manufacturing trends, evaluating new technologies and industry practices that can improve Williams-Sonoma's competitive advantage.  Define product success metrics and measurement plans tied to manufacturing efficiency, production throughput, inventory accuracy, schedule adherence, quality, operational productivity, adoption, and business value realization. Continuously measure outcomes to guide product investment decisions and optimization.  Lead product discovery, business process analysis, and solution definition for manufacturing capabilities, translating business needs into product strategy, roadmaps, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized Jira backlogs that enable iterative Agile delivery.  Identify, prioritize, and deliver AI-enabled capabilities that improve manufacturing planning, shop floor productivity, quality, scheduling, operational efficiency, and business decision making while leveraging generative AI to improve product discovery, requirements quality, documentation, and team productivity.  Serve as the primary product leader across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Engineering, Architecture, and Technology teams, aligning stakeholders around product vision, priorities, delivery, and measurable business value.  Partner with Engineering and Architecture teams to deliver iterative product capabilities using Agile methodologies while balancing business value, technical debt, scalability, and long-term platform health.  Serve as the manufacturing product subject matter expert, leading cross-functional exploration, making informed product recommendations, and communicating roadmap priorities, tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes to business partners and senior Technology leadership.  Lead organizational readiness and product adoption activities, including stakeholder alignment, business process design, SOP documentation, training, UAT, hyper-care, and adoption measurement.  Ensure manufacturing solutions meet governance, security, audit, licensing, and compliance requirements while partnering with Internal Audit and Technology teams to establish appropriate operational controls. 


Criteria


 10 years of Product Management or techno-functional experience supporting Manufacturing, Supply Chain, ERP, or related enterprise technology platforms.  Experience with discrete manufacturing, configurable products, production planning, bills of material, routings, work centers, capacity planning, quality management, and manufacturing execution preferred.  Demonstrated ability to influence senior business and technology leaders, drive executive alignment, manage competing priorities, and communicate effectively across executive, operational, and technical audiences without direct authority.  Deep understanding of Microsoft Dynamics AX/Dynamics 365 Manufacturing, Supply Chain Management, Production Control, Inventory Management, Procurement, Warehouse Management, and related manufacturing processes.  Demonstrated experience owning product strategy, roadmaps, and execution for complex enterprise platforms supporting manufacturing or supply chain operations.  Own the product lifecycle from discovery through adoption, continuously measuring business outcomes and incorporating customer feedback into future roadmap priorities.  Experience applying AI, generative AI, machine learning, automation, or advanced analytics to improve manufacturing operations, product management practices, or business processes. Demonstrated ability to identify and deliver AI-enabled business capabilities.  Experience with related supply chain operations, order management, eCommerce and finance / accounting processes.  Experience leading large-scale business transformation initiatives from product discovery through implementation, including business process redesign, organizational change management, UAT, training, and production adoption.  Experience with the process of configurable products as they flow from the eCommerce customer’s orders through order management (OMS) and to Dynamics 365 for manufacturing and order fulfillment.  You have a proven ability to understand and discuss technical concepts, manage difficult tradeoffs, and evaluate new ideas with partners across the organization.  Experience in a large, multi-brand business preferred. Consulting experience is also desirable.  Experience creating and managing product backlogs, including writing epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritizing work within Jira for Agile software delivery.  Strong communication and negotiation skills and the ability to lead and influence others.  Bachelor's degree or more in Engineering, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field or equivalent work experience.  This role requires being onsite in the WSI manufacturing Claremont, North Carolina office Monday through Thursday.  Some travel will be required to other WSI manufacturing and supply chain locations within the United States. (Manufacturing: Claremont, NC; Tupelo, MS; Portland, OR) 


Our Culture & Values 

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First 

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits


 A generous discount on all WSI brands  A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities  Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer  Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits  Tax-free commuter benefits  A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health 


Continued Learning


 In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University  Cross-brand and cross-function career opportunities  Resources for self-development  Advisor (Mentor) program  Career development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series 


 WSI will not now or in the future commence an immigration case or "sponsor" an individual for this position (for example, H-1B or other employment-based immigration). 

 This role is not eligible for relocation assistance. 

 Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Williams-Sonoma, Inc. will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, or other applicable state or local laws and ordinances. 

About Us

Our Company

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Our family of brands are Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Rejuvenation, West Elm, Mark & Graham, Outward, and GreenRow. These brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We offer beautifully-designed, stylish and functional products for every area of the home, including the kitchen, living room, bedroom, home office, closet, laundry room and even outdoor spaces. We've seen some big changes since our first brick-and-mortar store opened more than half of a century ago. What hasn't changed is our passion for high-quality products, functional design, outstanding customer service, and enhancing the lives of our customers and the communities where we operate. Today, we're a multi-brand, multi-channel, global enterprise supported by state-of-the-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing - and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.

 Own day-to-day execution of assigned brand social channels, including maintaining and executing against editorial calendars while proactively managing timelines, accuracy, and quality Define and execute social content aligned to brand and business priorities, contributing to content briefs for internal and external partners and optimizing existing creative resources Create low-lift assets as needed, including platform-native copy and light design updates Manage community engagement across multiple brand channels, applying sound judgment to foster positive interactions, escalate issues appropriately, and protect brand reputation Independently pull and interpret monthly performance data and reporting to identify trends, insights, and opportunities Translate learnings into actionable recommendations for future content and optimizations Monitor platforms and social listening tools to identify emerging trends, cultural moments, and audience sentiment that can inform real-time or near-term social strategy Collaborate cross-functionally with brand marketing, internal partners, and agency teams, building strong working relationships through clear communication, responsiveness, and informed recommendations Balance independent work with strong teamwork, moving projects forward proactively while ensuring alignment with broader social and brand strategies
