25 - 29 USD hourly

rows.title: Senior Financial Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Our Opportunity:

Chewy is seeking a highly motivated and strategic Senior Financial Analyst to join our Corporate Finance Business Partnerships team as a Finance Business Partner supporting enterprise G&A functions! In this highly visible role, you will help steward payroll and G&A expenses, translate executive and functional priorities into financial plans, and provide trusted, data-driven insights to senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders. You will support budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, monthly reporting, and strategic analysis across areas including headcount, professional fees, business matters, settlements, insurance, software, and other corporate costs. This role operates with meaningful autonomy and judgment. Success requires a detail-oriented self-starter who can independently frame problems, build scalable financial mechanisms, operate at depth, and communicate clear recommendations in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment.

What You’ll Do

Serve as a Finance Business Partner for enterprise G&A functions, providing trusted, data-driven financial partnership and guidance to senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.Steward payroll and G&A expenses across the supported functions, with ownership of key performance indicators and mechanisms that drive accountability to financial targets.Translate business strategies and executive priorities into financial plans, tradeoffs, and actionable recommendations, while proactively identifying risks, opportunities, and dependencies.Own and maintain detailed financial models for headcount and payroll, professional fees, business matters, settlements, insurance, software, and other corporate expenses.Support target setting and annual, quarterly, and rolling forecast processes by developing assumptions, evaluating business drivers, and influencing prioritization through clear financial insights.Lead monthly close and management reporting activities, including variance analysis, accrual support, forecast updates, and preparation of accurate, timely, and decision-relevant executive summaries.Create inspection mechanisms for budgets, forecasts, headcount, and actual results to improve forecast accuracy, financial visibility, data quality, and accountability to plan.Partner with functional stakeholders to improve planning and reporting across key spend categories, including professional services, business matters, settlements, insurance, and other corporate expenses.Provide ad hoc financial analysis and decision support for strategic initiatives, investment requests, cost optimization opportunities, and organizational changes. Develop standardized reporting and dashboards that translate complex financial data into actionable insights and ensure consistent communication with business partners and stakeholders.Drive continuous improvement and automation across reporting structures, close processes, governance, and planning mechanisms to increase efficiency and scalability.Extract, reconcile, and analyze data from central systems and databases using tools such as Hyperion SmartView, Oracle ERP, Tableau, Excel, and SQL.

What You’ll Need

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or a related field.3+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, Finance Business Partnering, Accounting, or a related analytical role, with an understanding of GAAP and financial statements.Advanced analytical and financial modeling skills, including demonstrated experience building complex models from the ground up and working with large, detailed datasets.Advanced Excel skills, including lookups, SUMIFS, pivot tables, scenario modeling, and large-data analysis; strong PowerPoint and data visualization skills.Experience with budgeting, forecasting, headcount and payroll analysis, key performance indicators, variance analysis, and financial controls.Confidence interacting with senior business leaders and the ability to distill complex analyses into clear, concise insights and recommendations for senior and executive audiences.Strong influencing, written, and verbal communication skills, with sound business judgment and the ability to build effective working relationships and drive data-backed decisions.Ability to independently navigate ambiguity by framing problems, setting priorities, and driving analytical work forward in the absence of established templates or clear precedent.

Bonus

MBA, CPA, or other relevant advanced degree or certification.Experience supporting executive or corporate functions.Familiarity with an e-commerce or retail business model.Experience with Hyperion SmartView, Oracle ERP, Tableau, SQL, or similar financial and analytical tools.Experience improving or automating financial reporting and planning processes.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender, citizenship, marital status, religion, age, disability, gender identity, results of genetic testing, veteran status, as well as any other legally-protected characteristic. rows.title: AML Transaction Monitoring Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About The Team And The Role

eBay’s Compliance team is building a strong, innovative Anti-Money Laundering / Counter Terrorist Financing (AML/CTF) program that supports trust, safety, and regulatory excellence across our marketplace ecosystem. This team plays a meaningful role in strengthening transaction monitoring capabilities for eBay, Depop, and other subsidiaries, while helping build a culture of compliance through data-driven insights and scalable controls.

The AML Transaction Monitoring Specialist will be a foundational contributor to the Transaction Monitoring Program, partnering across AML Compliance, Engineering, Risk, Product, Customer Experience, Finance, Legal, and Operations. In this role, you will help build, improve, and maintain monitoring rules, analytics, reporting, and system controls that detect potential money laundering and terrorist financing activity. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys working with large datasets, solving sophisticated problems, and shaping high-impact compliance solutions in a fast-moving, global environment.

What You Will Accomplish

Analyze large, sophisticated datasets to identify trends, patterns, and typologies related to potential money laundering or terrorist financing activity, and translate insights into clear reporting for leadership.Design, test, implement, and maintain transaction monitoring rules, scenarios, and supporting analytics that strengthen AML program coverage across eBay, Depop, and other subsidiaries.Build and enhance KPI dashboards, standardized reporting packages, and ad hoc analyses that help measure program effectiveness and support timely business and compliance decisions.Partner cross-functionally with Compliance, Engineering, Risk, Product, Operations, and other stakeholders to define business requirements and deliver scalable monitoring and control solutions.Improve data architecture, mapping, ingestion, and automation to support efficient monitoring processes, strong data quality, and sustainable operational controls.Support high-priority compliance data and technology initiatives, contributing to system improvements, risk mitigation strategies, and the continued evolution of a best-in-class transaction monitoring program.


What You Will Bring

Must reside in the Austin metro area and be able to work onsite in our Austin office 3 or more days per week.2–4 years of experience working with large datasets and writing complex queries across multiple data sources, with hands-on skills in Python, SQL, and data analysis in a compliance, risk, or technology environment.2–4 years of experience in transaction monitoring, AML typologies, financial crime risk, or related compliance disciplines, with the ability to help develop effective monitoring coverage and risk-based rules.2–4 years of experience with data warehousing, big data environments such as Hadoop, and business intelligence tools such as Tableau; advanced Excel skills are a plus.2–4 years of experience in statistical modeling, data mapping, reporting automation, and translating analytical findings into practical business or compliance solutions.Strong communication, documentation, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain insights and recommendations clearly to partners and leaders across functions.

eBay is seeking an accomplished and strategic Senior Director, Compensation to lead the vision, strategy, governance, design, communication, and execution of our global broad-based compensation programs. This is a highly strategic leadership role responsible for ensuring eBay’s compensation programs support employees around the world, reinforce trust and transparency, and strengthen our ability to attract, retain, and engage top talent.

In this role, you will work closely with senior business leaders, the People Leadership Team, People Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, People Analytics, Legal, and other cross-functional partners to align compensation programs with eBay’s business objectives, talent strategy, and compensation philosophy.

Reporting to eBay’s VP, Total Rewards, Global Mobility, and M&A, you will lead a high-performing global team of compensation partners who combine analytical rigor with strong business partnership.

What You Will Do

rows.title: Manager Media Strategy and Planning
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

This role is based at one of our corporate offices in McLean, VA or Dallas, TX

The Marketing & Loyalty team brings to life the unique promise of Hilton's portfolio of brands by defining, creating, and delivering exceptional multi-channel marketing campaigns designed to drive business results. As Manager, Media Strategy & Planning, you will build and oversee the execution of comprehensive, multi-channel media plans for Hilton, contributing to innovative and impactful campaign development from conceptualization through execution in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. You will ensure timelines are met, expectations across multiple partners are managed, and strong media safeguards are implemented, while providing subject-matter expertise, leading media agency relationships, and applying emerging tactics in the evolving advertising marketplace.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day

Lead the planning, management, and execution of Hilton's Masterbrand media campaigns, partnering with internal stakeholders and agency teams to deliver integrated, full-funnel media plans that achieve business objectives.Manage enterprise media partnerships and sponsorships, ensuring successful execution, ongoing optimization, and delivery against agreed business outcomes.Track, evaluate, and communicate partnership performance and value realization, developing executive-ready reporting that demonstrates business impact and informs future investment decisions.Lead the planning and activation of sponsorship and custom media programs with key media partners, ensuring strategic alignment with campaign objectives.Partner closely with internal marketing, creative, brand, and agency teams to ensure media, creative assets, and custom executions are aligned, delivered on time, and optimized across all placements and channels.Build strong cross-functional relationships across Marketing, Brand, Creative, Partnerships, and agency teams to successfully manage complex initiatives and drive projects from strategy through execution.

How You'll Collaborate With Others

Partner closely with Enterprise Marketing, Brand, Creative, Partnerships, and agency teams to align media strategy, creative assets, custom executions, timelines, and business objectives.Lead media agency relationships and provide the Marketing team with media strategy and planning subject-matter expertise.Build trusted relationships within the media community and across internal teams to manage complex initiatives in a collaborative environment.

Deliverables You'll Take Ownership Of

Integrated, full-funnel Masterbrand media plans that achieve defined business objectives.Enterprise media partnerships and sponsorships executed, optimized, and delivered against agreed business outcomes.Executive-ready partnership performance and value-realization reporting that demonstrates business impact and informs future investment decisions.Sponsorship and custom media programs activated with key media partners and aligned to campaign objectives.Media and creative assets aligned, delivered on time, and optimized across placements and channels.

What It Takes to Make the Stay

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

Five (5) years of work experience at a media agency or in a corporate media roleExperience planning across a wide array of media channels, including Social, TV/Video, Audio, Digital, and other non-traditional mediaExperience planning and stewarding cross-channel media campaigns and sponsorshipsStrong understanding of the programmatic digital landscape and how to use audience and data-targeting tacticsThis is a hybrid role based in our corporate office in Dallas, TX or McLean, VATravel up to 10%

BA/BS Bachelor's degreeProject-management ability across critical and often fluctuating deadlinesExperience overseeing college sports marketing and media partnershipsFlexibility as needs evolve, with the ability to establish clear processes and directionStrong reputation within the media communityExperience managing complex media plans across several lines of business

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we're known for doesn't end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members' wellbeing, supporting you through all of life's moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel programOwn a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial futurePaid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parentsPersonalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved onesCrisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional careMental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters mostHealth & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family coveredFinancial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what's nextBenefits availability may vary depending on Team Member's location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Hilton offers its eligible team members a comprehensive benefits package to support their mental and physical well-being, so they can Thrive personally and professionally. The pay range for this role is $90,000 – $130,000 and is determined based on applicable and specialized experience and location. Subject to plan terms and conditions, you will be eligible to participate in the Hilton Annual Incentive (Bonus) Plan, consistent with other team members at the same level and/or position within the Company.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

Job Description
Be part of an amazing story
Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. rows.title: Director, Corporate Strategy
rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Looking for a company that inspires passion, courage and creativity, where you can be on the team shaping the future of global commerce? Want to shape how millions of people buy, sell, connect, and share around the world? If you’re interested in joining a purpose driven community that is dedicated to crafting an ambitious and inclusive work environment, join eBay – a company you can be proud to be with.

With more than 130 million active users across 190 countries and over 1 billion active product listings, eBay is the world’s most vibrant and dynamic online marketplace. Founded in 1995, eBay Inc. connects people around the world, enabling them to buy and sell online. eBay Inc. does this by providing the Internet platforms of choice for global commerce, payments and communications. eBay Inc. is headquartered in San Jose, California. For more information about the company and its global portfolio of online brands, visit www.ebayinc.com

About The Team

We are responsible for setting the strategic direction of eBay: our ambition, where we play, and how we win in the market. The team is responsible for deeply understanding the needs of our core buyers and sellers and crafting the strategies that will differentiate eBay relative to our competitors. We work very closely with product, technology, and regional business teams to ensure the strategy is translated into action across the end-to-end customer experience. Our work can be divided into 3 main topics: we develop eBay Inc’s strategy together with eBay’s executives, we run strategic projects to solve key strategic issues supporting select executives at eBay, we closely monitor the competitive environment & trends.

The opportunity

The Director, Corporate Strategy is a senior leader who will lead several cross-functional projects consisting of 2-6 Strategy Associates, Managers, and Senior Managers. You will bring both process and content leadership to strategy projects and act as the point person between Strategy and cross-functional business teams. Within this role, you will have the ability to influence key elements of eBay’s strategy and to help shape the strategic direction of eBay. The ideal candidate has a track record of making pragmatic, concrete recommendations with real world implementation experience. It is critical for the role that the candidate has strong analytic skills and is excellent in developing creative/ out-of-the-box and well-thought-out solutions for challenging business problems.

Role Responsibilities

Strategy Development: Develop the strategies for eBay to differentiate itself in the market. This will include crafting the strategies, developing the key initiatives to support the strategies and working closely with key eBay constituencies to gain consensus.Project leadership: Independently, lead cross-functional projects involving executive and senior partners from various part of the organization.Thought leadership: Develop content and topic expertise, as well as perspectives on issues important to eBay’s strategy. Structure problems. Develop creative solutions to challenging business problemsStrategy Mobilization: Work with the eBay line organization as needed to support mobilization and implementation of the business strategies.Market and Competitive Analysis: Develop insightful market intelligence about key industry trends (technology, competitors, consumers, regulatory, etc.) and advise the organization of their strategic implications.Business Analytics: Drive business judgment, market understanding, problem solving, and fact-based analysis to identify, prioritize, structure, and solve challenging business problems.Team Leadership: Lead and mentor a driven strategy team in the development and execution of critical initiativesCommunication: Develop storylines for presentations, prepare and deliver presentations to senior leadershipLeading through uncertainty: Self-direct as well as manage resources on the strategy team and across the organization to deliver superior end-products in a dynamic industry and corporate environment


Job Requirements

Intellectual curiosityExcellence in structured thinking, developing sensible, creative solutions to challenging strategic business problems. Creativity and “out of the box” thinking that drives innovation. The ability to “see around corners” and “connect the dots” that enable business to proactively drive businessStrong executive presence and ability to communicate strategy clearly and simply. Ease with executive-level interactions. Ability to create clear and simple storylines.Proven track record to lead and mentor a driven strategy team in the development and execution of key initiatives. Ability to lead, empower and mentor project team membersComfort in reaching out and prioritizing cross-functional collaboration in a highly matrixed environmentOutstanding analytical capabilities (quantitative and qualitative), ability to generate key insightsComfort in handling uncertaintyHighly collaborative – be fun, and easy to work with!


Qualifications

Proven leader with at least 10 years of work experience - at least 2-3 years at a top strategy consulting firm at project management level are a mustBachelors Degree required, MBA or equivalent preferredExpertise in technology, ideally in e-commerce, retail, payments, and/or consumer facing products is highly desirable


Benefits are an essential part of your total compensation for the work you do every day. Whether you’re single, in a growing family, or nearing retirement, eBay offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefit programs to meet your needs. Including maternal & paternal leave, paid sabbatical, and plans to help ensure your financial security today and in the years ahead because we know feeling financially secure during your working years and through retirement is important.

Here at eBay, we love creating opportunities for others by connecting people from widely diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and geographies. So, being diverse and inclusive isn’t just something we strive for, it is who we are, and part of what we do each and every single day. We want to ensure that as an employee, you feel eBay is a place where, no matter who you are, you feel safe, included, and that you have the opportunity to bring your unique self to work. To learn about eBay’s Diversity & Inclusion click here: https://www.ebayinc.com/company/diversity-inclusion/

The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below:

$205,600 - $274,500

Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employees will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

rows.descriptionText:
Please note that this is a contract role providing services to Hilton through Talent Solutions. If you are selected for this role, you will be employed by Talent Solutions and will not be an employee of Hilton. Contract workers are not employees of Hilton or any of its subsidiaries, nor will they be eligible for Hilton benefits.

Hybrid role in our McLean, VA or Memphis, TN office working onsite 3 days/week***

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced cloud architect to join our HSM Digital Solutions team. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in designing and building a next-generation cloud data lake and modern data platform that powers procurement analytics, digital products, and AI-driven capabilities. Reporting to the Senior Manager of HSM Digital Solutions, you will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, data engineering professionals, and external vendors to deliver scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud data solutions. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of a sophisticated data ecosystem within a globally recognized hospitality organization, driving meaningful impact through innovation and technical excellence.

Responsibilities

 Design and document AWS cloud database architectures that support performance, scalability, availability, security, governance, and cost optimization requirements. Lead the modernization and migration of legacy on-premises databases and data platforms to AWS cloud services. Architect and optimize data solutions using AWS services such as Amazon RDS, Amazon Aurora, Amazon Redshift, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Amazon Athena, AWS Database Migration Service, and related monitoring and security services. Define database patterns for transactional, analytical, integration, and reporting workloads, including OLTP, OLAP, and data lake architectures. Develop architecture standards, reference patterns, design decision records, runbooks, deployment playbooks, and operational best practices. Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, security, governance, resiliency, and compliance requirements are met across all data solutions. Develop migration plans, proof-of-concepts, cutover strategies, rollback plans, validation approaches, and post-migration optimization activities. Partner with security and governance teams to implement encryption, IAM, network isolation, auditing, logging, data retention, access controls, and compliance requirements. Drive performance tuning and optimization through data modeling, indexing, partitioning, query tuning, workload management, capacity planning, and observability practices. Implement and promote automation, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, schema migration practices, and repeatable deployment patterns for database-backed solutions. Develop dashboards and operational metrics for database health, cost, usage, SLAs, reliability, and platform performance. Collaborate with application, integration, analytics, and reporting teams to translate business requirements into practical database and data platform solutions. Review and provide recommendations on cloud architecture designs developed by vendors and solution partners. Evaluate and recommend new technologies to support cloud data platform modernization and AI-enabled business initiatives.

Skills

 Deep expertise in AWS cloud database and data platform services, including Amazon RDS, Aurora, Redshift, DynamoDB, S3, Glue, Athena, and AWS Database Migration Service. Strong knowledge of database architecture patterns for OLTP, OLAP, and data lake workloads. Proficiency in infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployment practices. Experience with data modeling, indexing strategies, query optimization, and workload management. Solid understanding of cloud security principles, including IAM, encryption, network isolation, auditing, and compliance frameworks. Ability to design and implement high availability, disaster recovery, and resiliency strategies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience reviewing vendor and partner architecture designs and providing actionable recommendations. Familiarity with AI and machine learning-enabled data platform capabilities and emerging cloud technologies.

Qualifications

 3+ years experience as a cloud architect or senior database architect with a focus on AWS cloud environments. Demonstrated experience leading cloud migration projects, including legacy database modernization and platform transitions. Experience developing architecture documentation, standards, and operational best practices in an enterprise environment. Background working cross-functionally with business stakeholders, engineering teams, security teams, and external vendors. Experience building and monitoring operational dashboards and performance metrics for cloud data platforms. AWS Certified Solutions Architect or equivalent AWS certification strongly preferred. AWS Certified Database Specialty certification is a plus. Additional cloud or data platform certifications relevant to the role are welcomed.

This is a rare and exciting opportunity to make a lasting impact on the digital transformation of a world-class hospitality organization. You will be at the forefront of building a modern, AI-ready data platform that drives strategic decision-making and innovation across the business. If you are passionate about cloud architecture, data engineering, and delivering solutions at scale, this role offers the challenge, visibility, and collaborative environment to help you do your best work.

Pay Rate Range

65 - 76 USD hourly

rows.title: Sr Analyst, Marketing Operations
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

About the Team

You will be part of the Marketing Strategy & Analytics department within Williams-Sonoma, Inc. (WSI). The Audience Strategy & Enablement team partners with marketing teams across all WSI brands — including Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn, West Elm, and more — to drive smarter targeting, measurement, and customer engagement through data and technology.

About The Role

This is a high-visibility role sitting at the intersection of marketing strategy, data, and emerging AI — and an opportunity to shape how a leading omni-channel retailer uses automation and intelligence to drive measurable marketing outcomes.

You will partner closely with Digital Marketing, Customer Relationship Marketing (CRM), and Loyalty teams to turn data into action — building scalable solutions, surfacing insights, and identifying opportunities to automate and accelerate how our marketing organization operates. As AI capabilities evolve, you'll play a meaningful role in piloting and scaling agentic workflows that extend the reach of our marketing data team.

The ideal candidate is analytically rigorous, naturally collaborative, and energized by translating complexity into clarity for business stakeholders.

Responsibilities


 Partner with Digital Marketing, CRM, and Loyalty teams to deliver targeting solutions, performance analysis, and workflow automation that drive measurable outcomes.  Build and maintain data pipelines that connect ecommerce, clickstream, CRM, and third-party data sources to marketing use cases.  Identify high-ROI opportunities to automate repetitive marketing processes and translate them into scalable solutions.  Surface actionable insights from complex datasets and communicate findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.  Evaluate and scale ReAct agents, Custom GPTs and agentic workflows to support workflows across Marketing Operations. 


Criteria


 2+ years of experience in marketing analytics, data engineering, or a related field — ideally supporting a consumer brand or agency.  Strong SQL skills and comfort working in cloud data environments (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks).  Proficiency in Python for data analysis and automation.  Solid grasp of the digital marketing ecosystem — paid media, ad tech, CRM, and how data flows across channels.  Experience with data visualization or BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Domo, Power BI).  A track record of translating ambiguous business questions into structured analyses with clear recommendations.  Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or technical field or equivalent work experience.  Familiarity with agent orchestration frameworks, including tool use, memory management, task decomposition and routing across multi-step agentic workflows.  Experience in retail or e-commerce supporting omni-channel marketing teams preferred.  Hands-on experience deploying AI agents in a business context, including building semantic context layers, prompt and output evaluation, knowledge grounding and iterative testing against defined success metrics preferred.  Familiarity with Python / R libraries for time series and causal analyses or marketing measurement methodologies (MMM, MTA) preferred. By partnering closely with continent and discipline teams, the Senior Director fosters innovation, elevates guest experiences, and ensures brand relevance and measurable business impact across markets.

The Senior Director will have direct responsibility for multiple brands and work closely with continents to monitor and develop strategies and tactics to improve Brand Health metrics, including customer satisfaction, unit growth, and competitive positioning. The role will lead multi-disciplinary projects to deliver complex key brand initiatives, including launching new brands, repositioning brands, and driving transformational change across the brand lifecycle.

As a connector and brand steward, this role balances enterprise objectives with market dynamics, exercises sound judgment in ambiguous, matrixed environments, champions operational excellence, and inspires teams to deliver differentiated results. The ideal candidate is a results-driven, commercially minded brand strategist with exceptional leadership skills, a passion for guest experience, and the ability to influence without authority, align senior stakeholders, and drive sustained performance in service of Marriott’s growth ambitions.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Required

Education and Experience

4-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, or related major 10+ years of relevant brand management professional experience demonstrating career growth and exceptional performance Proven ability to develop and execute strategic brand plans and multi-year business strategies with clear performance outcomes Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing complex, multi-brand initiatives in highly matrixed, global environments Strong analytical skills, with experience leveraging consumer insights and market data to inform strategy and prioritize initiatives based on business impact 

Preferred

MBA or equivalent advanced degree Experience collaborating with continent / business teams to drive initiatives and align competing priorities Track record of delivering results in complex, ambiguous environments requiring strong judgment, decisiveness, and influence Demonstrated commercial and financial acumen, including evaluating trade-offs between brand value, owner economics, and enterprise ROI 

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Brand Strategy, Architecture & Stewardship

Defines and maintains brand positioning for assigned brands; ensures clarity and alignment with global strategy while enabling appropriate local flexibility within established guardrails. Develops compelling, differentiated brand strategies informed by consumer, competitive, and stakeholder needs and grounded in commercial and operational realities. Supports creation of strategic brand business plans, including economic strategy, product/service models, brand positioning, and value proposition. Defines and manages brand initiatives and projects through execution across continents, ensuring strategic pull-through and accountability for outcomes. 

Brand Health, Advocacy & Growth

Defines brand performance metrics and recommends performance targets aligned to both brand health and business growth objectives. Monitors performance for assigned brands and identifies optimization opportunities, making data-driven recommendations to course-correct as needed. Serves as brand advocate, educating stakeholders on brand strategy, positioning, and strategic pillars to build shared understanding and commitment. Represents the brand in external forums, reviewing and evolving standards and operational practices with credibility among owners, partners, and industry stakeholders. 

Innovation, New Product Integration

Leads new product creation / integration for the Select category from concept through sustained market performance. Plays point across product and customer teams to ensure new brands are positioned, launched, and sustained effectively, making prioritization decisions to maximize long-term brand and business value. 

Leadership, Continent Empowerment & Cross-Functional Influence

Serves as the primary liaison between global leadership and continent teams, supporting communication strategies and integration plans, escalating challenges and sharing best practices while driving clarity, alignment, and decision velocity. Collaborates with cross-discipline teams—including design, standards, end-to-end experience design, marketing, and global operations—to shape and implement brand initiatives through influence, executive presence, and strong storytelling. 

Insights-Driven Product Innovation & Operational Feasibility

Leverages consumer insights, market trends, and data analytics to identify opportunities for innovative products and experiences that differentiate the brand and drive guest engagement. Leads brand-specific innovation projects, supports integration within global guardrails and ensures solutions are scalable across regions. Partners with cross-discipline teams to ensure new products and initiatives are operationally feasible, scalable, and aligned with brand strategy from concept through implementation balancing speed, quality, and cost considerations. 

Leadership Development, Culture & Team Excellence

Translates global vision into actionable team strategies, ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities and clear ownership of results. Inspires and leads high-performing teams, fostering innovation and excellence while developing future brand leaders and building a strong talent pipeline. Drives a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and learning across the team.

rows.title: Senior Director, Enterprise Initiatives Support
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

This role is based at one of our corporate offices in McLean, VA or Memphis, TN

This is your chance to be part of an in-house Brand Performance Support (BPS) team that delivers responsive and effective support to Hotel Leaders across over 9,000 hotels through close collaboration with many parts of the business. As the Senior Director of Enterprise Initiatives Support (EIS) reporting to the Vice President of Brand Performance Support, you will be responsible for leading the support of key enterprise-wide initiatives and programs through driving maximum hotel-level compliance, participation and utilization.

When initiatives and programs are supported through EIS, you and your team will collaborate with many other stakeholders while also driving participation and utilization through innovation, technology, data-driven decision making, and automation. You will balance execution with strategic thought leadership, building strong partnerships across the enterprise to continuously evolve how BPS supports critical enterprise-wide initiatives and programs that drive hotel performance.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day

Oversee BPS-led strategies and efforts to support Stay Score improvement through both targeted programs and “always on” resources.Oversee Digital Stay Experience strategies and support efforts to ensure hotel-level engagement and participation with critical Digital tools such as Guest Messaging (Kipsu), Digital Key, and Connected Room.Oversee the BPS support of Hilton Commercial enterprise-wide initiatives/programs to ensure high levels of hotel compliance, participation, and utilization to drive maximum performance success.Oversee the BPS support of operational enterprise-wide initiatives/programs to drive high levels of hotel compliance, participation, and utilization to ensure maximum success.Executive level communications to share current action status, progress, and impact, both written and verbal, across Brand Management Americas (BMA) and Hilton stakeholder audiences.

How You'll Collaborate With Others

Work closely with other BPS/BMA functional leaders to ensure awareness and education of the enterprise initiatives being supported.Leverage BPS support channels to ensure a wholistic support approach to driving participation and utilization levels of enterprise initiatives.Partner closely with the Customer Promise team to ensure BPS support efforts are aligned appropriately across core CP strategic initiatives.Partner closely with Commercial leaders to ensure BPS support efforts are aligned appropriately across the Commercial initiatives that need maximum hotel-level participation to be successful.Partner closely with key Hilton stakeholders related to new enterprise initiatives to ensure all necessary support has been identified – before, during, and after the launch of the initiative.Partner with BMA leaders to surface trending topics and hotel/owner friction points that need to be addressed through stronger program support.

Deliverables You'll Take Ownership Of

Targeted and “always on” Stay Score support and communications efforts led by BPS.BPS-led support of critical Hilton enterprise initiatives (operational and commercial) to drive maximized levels of hotel participation.BPS-led support of the Digital Stay Experience tools, namely Guest Messaging (Kipsu), Digital Key, and Connected Room, to ensure high levels of hotel utilization measured through key program KPIs and brand standards.

What It Takes to Make the Stay

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

Seven (7) years of related professional experience.Five (5) years of Hotel and/or Hospitality Management experience.Three (3) years of management or supervisory experience.Experience supporting strategic initiatives through cross-functional collaboration and implementation.Demonstrated experience using data-driven and test-and-learn approaches to developing and implementing support programs.Strong executive level presentation skills, both verbal and written, across key stakeholder audiences including senior leaders.

It Would Be Useful If You Have

Experience working with Hilton Brands.Experience in project management and customer experience strategy.Knowledge of Salesforce CRM, BOSS, and related support technologies.Experience in managing vendor relationships and enterprise partnerships.Bachelor's Degree in Business, Analytics, Hospitality, or a related field.

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we're known for doesn't end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members' wellbeing, supporting you through all of life's moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel programOwn a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial futurePaid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parentsPersonalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved onesCrisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional careMental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters mostHealth & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family coveredFinancial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what's nextBenefits availability may vary depending on Team Member's location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Hilton offers its eligible team members a comprehensive benefits package to support their mental and physical well-being, so they can Thrive personally and professionally. The pay range for this role is $160,000 – $210,000 and is determined based on applicable and specialized experience and location. Subject to plan terms and conditions, you will be eligible to participate in the Hilton Annual Incentive (Bonus) Plan, and the Company's long-term incentive plan, consistent with other team members at the same level and/or position within the Company.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500+ employees and ~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. rows.descriptionText:
At Chewy, taking care of pets and the people who love them through the highs, the lows, and the everyday is what drives us. Grounded in that purpose and focused on our mission to be the most trusted and convenient destination for pet parents and partners everywhere, we work every day to help people feel more confident, supported, and capable in caring for the animals they love—showing up with the products, services, care, and guidance they need, whenever they need it.

Bringing that to life takes exceptional leaders.

Leadership at Chewy is guided by our Operating Principles, which define how we lead, make decisions, develop talent, serve our customers, and grow our business. We value leaders who think strategically, stay close to the customer, and aren't afraid to roll up their sleeves alongside their teams. They solve complex challenges, build high-performing organizations, and partner closely with senior leaders to shape the future of Chewy.

If you're energized by building, leading, and making a meaningful impact, this leadership opportunity may be the right fit for you.

Our Opportunity

Chewy is seeking an experienced and strategic Director, Transportation Strategy & Network Planning to define and own the long-term strategy for Chewy’s transportation network planning, network design, carrier strategy, and transportation capabilities. This leader will establish the multi-year vision and operating mechanisms required to optimize transportation cost, service, speed, capacity, reliability, and customer experience while enabling Chewy’s long-term growth. The Director will own the five-year transportation strategy and capability roadmap, translating enterprise growth, customer, and financial objectives into clear network, carrier, planning, and investment strategies. This role will have significant influence over network strategy, capability development, portfolio prioritization, and transportation planning. The Director will make and influence complex decisions requiring tradeoffs across cost, speed, service, capacity, customer experience, operational complexity, and long-term flexibility. The Director will lead a high-performing organization responsible for transportation strategy, network planning, programs, and capabilities and will partner closely with Transportation Operations and third-party carriers to translate strategy into executable operating plans. This leader will also work across Fulfillment Center Operations, Engineering, Technology, Product, Delivery Experience, Customer Care, Finance, Procurement, HR, and other enterprise functions to establish priorities, secure investment, and drive alignment.

A successful leader will consistently demonstrate Chewy’s Operating Principles, particularly Customers First, Act as an Owner, Operate at Depth, Deliver Results, Earn Trust, and Debate Openly; Commit Fully. This leader must be comfortable operating autonomously in a highly complex environment, making consequential decisions with imperfect information, and creating alignment across teams where direct authority is distributed.

What You’ll Do

Define and own Chewy’s long-term transportation strategy, translating enterprise growth, customer, and financial objectives into network design, carrier, mode, capacity, planning, and capability strategies.Own the five-year transportation strategy and portfolio roadmap, defining the physical, operational, analytical, and technology capabilities required to support Chewy’s future transportation network.Establish the strategic direction for transportation network planning, including supply and capacity planning, equipment requirements, carrier and mode strategy, network connectivity, and short-, mid-, and long-term planning horizons.Make and influence complex network decisions across cost, speed, service, capacity, reliability, customer experience, operational complexity, and long-term flexibility. Establish clear principles, analytical frameworks, and mechanisms for evaluating these tradeoffs.Develop and maintain an integrated transportation portfolio roadmap, prioritizing physical, operational, analytical, and technical enhancements based on customer impact, financial value, network requirements, and enterprise priorities.Partner with Transportation Operations to translate long-term network strategy into executable operating plans while maintaining ownership of network design, planning strategy, capability roadmaps, and optimization frameworks.Establish and own transportation performance mechanisms across cost, transit time, delivery reliability, capacity, carrier performance, and customer experience. Identify structural opportunities and drive actions when performance does not meet expectations.Develop business cases and investment strategies for major network and capability changes, incorporating financial return, customer impact, operational feasibility, capacity, risk, and long-term strategic value.Use advanced analytics, modeling, and simulation to improve decision making, understanding customer, network, and carrier behavior and translating those insights into clear business, operational, and technical improvements.Catalyze innovation across the transportation network by understanding industry trends, emerging carrier capabilities, technology advancements, and evolving customer expectations. Challenge conventional approaches and identify opportunities to create structural competitive advantage.Influence senior leaders across Operations, Finance, Technology, Product, Procurement, Customer Experience, and other enterprise functions to establish priorities, resolve complex tradeoffs, secure investment, and drive alignment around transportation strategy.Build strategic relationships with third-party transportation providers, engaging senior carrier leadership to influence capabilities, network design, service models, capacity strategies, and long-term partnership opportunities.Build and lead a high-performing organization by establishing the appropriate organizational structure, hiring and developing exceptional talent, building leadership depth and succession, and creating mechanisms that establish clear accountability and consistently Deliver Results.Operate at Depth while maintaining strategic perspective, developing a deep understanding of network economics, carrier performance, transportation flows, capacity constraints, customer outcomes, and planning assumptions while empowering the organization to own day-to-day execution.Synthesize complex information into clear strategies and recommendations, communicating effectively with senior executives and translating transportation complexity into actionable business decisions.Lead high-impact, executive-level initiatives that enable growth, unlock incremental profitability, improve customer experience, and create scalable capabilities for Chewy’s future transportation network.

of transportation networks across multiple modes, carrier structures, operating models, and contract structures.Demonstrated experience defining and implementing long-term transportation, logistics, or network strategies with significant business impact.Experience developing or implementing network planning, optimization, simulation, or decision-support capabilities.Demonstrated ability to rows.title: Research Engineering Internship - AI, Computer Vision, & Visualization
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

About Outward, Inc.

Outward, Inc. is based in San Jose, CA and is a wholly owned technology subsidiary of Williams Sonoma, Inc.

At Outward Inc., our vision is to 'lower the friction' in every aspect of the customer shopping journey for our Williams-Sonoma, Inc. brands. We achieve this by leveraging cutting-edge technology to create innovative and intuitive experiences, with top-notch product visualizations. We are at the forefront of product visualization, integrating 3D, AR/VR, and web technologies to redefine the shopping experience.

In addition, we are pioneering the use of generative AI to transform e-commerce. By harnessing the power of AI, we aim to revolutionize how products are presented and interacted with, enhancing consumer engagement and driving the future of online shopping. Our mission is to deepen consumer connections with the products that matter and deliver best-in-class experiences.

Summary

We’re looking for talented research interns for our engineering team focusing on delivering new visual experiences. The team works on problems in imaging, computer vision, graphics, and machine learning.  Some areas of interest are: 


 Deep Neural Networks for Vision: Apply advanced techniques in DNNs for tasks such as segmentation and detection to solve complex vision problems.  Generative Algorithms: Work with generative models, including Stable Diffusion, to enhance visual content creation and realism.  AI Integration and Automation: Support the integration of AI into production processes, streamline workflows, and transition tasks to AI-driven automation.  Quality Control and Product Enhancement: Contribute to developing AI solutions that improve quality control and enhance product visuals.  Synthetic Content Creation: Generation of realistic photo quality content via the image content pipelines 


We Are Looking For The Following


 You are currently enrolled in a graduate program in CS, EE, Applied Math or similar field  1-2+ years of working experience as an engineer in a software development position  You are on track to graduate with your Ph.D. or MSc degree between Fall/Winter 2025 or Spring/Summer 2026  You have a minimum GPA of 3.5  You have experience with scientific libraries such as NumPy, scikit-learn, image manipulation libraries like OpenCV, Blender API, Machine learning frameworks like Tensorflow, PyTorch, Image GenAI models  You have skills in design and implementation of algorithms  You have strong software engineering skills in Python or C++  You have strong communication skills  You must be able to work onsite in our San Jose location 


Desired Skills (Nice-to-have)


 Skills in processing and cleaning data.  Experience with maintaining PostgreSQL databases and image content  Building UI using Python or React framework ecosystems  Experience working with Blender API  Understanding of Image and Unstructured data  Working experience on cloud infrastructure 


Internship Duration (start & End Date)


 This is a three month internship starting in fall 2025, with the opportunity to work 20-40 hours a week.  Paid internship. Non-Exempt. Hourly 


Our Culture & Values 

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First 

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits


 A generous discount on all WSI brands  A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities  Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer  Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits  Tax-free commuter benefits  A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health 


Continued Learning


 In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University  Cross-brand and cross-function career opportunities  Resources for self-development  Advisor (Mentor) program  Career development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series 


 WSI will not now or in the future commence an immigration case or "sponsor" an individual for this position (for example, H-1B or other employment-based immigration). 

 This role is not eligible for relocation assistance. 

 Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Williams-Sonoma, Inc. will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, or other applicable state or local laws and ordinances. 

 The expected pay range for this position is $50-$60/hourly. Actual pay will be determined based on experience and other job-related factors permitted by law. In addition to competitive pay, compensation may include a variety of other components like benefits, paid time off, merit, and bonus opportunities. 

About Us

Our Company

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Our family of brands are Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Rejuvenation, West Elm, Mark & Graham, Outward, and GreenRow. These brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We offer beautifully-designed, stylish and functional products for every area of the home, including the kitchen, living room, bedroom, home office, closet, laundry room and even outdoor spaces. We've seen some big changes since our first brick-and-mortar store opened more than half of a century ago. What hasn't changed is our passion for high-quality products, functional design, outstanding customer service, and enhancing the lives of our customers and the communities where we operate. Today, we're a multi-brand, multi-channel, global enterprise supported by state-of-the-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing - and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.

rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About The People Team

The People Team is responsible for shaping every aspect of the employee experience at eBay. We drive business performance through talent acquisition, learning and development, compensation, benefits, people operations, employee experience, and people technologies. We are committed to creating an environment where employees can thrive while enabling the business to achieve its strategic objectives globally.

The Opportunity

eBay is seeking an accomplished and strategic Senior Director, Compensation to lead the vision, strategy, governance, design, communication, and execution of our global broad-based compensation programs. This is a highly strategic leadership role responsible for ensuring eBay’s compensation programs support employees around the world, reinforce trust and transparency, and strengthen our ability to attract, retain, and engage top talent.

In this role, you will work closely with senior business leaders, the People Leadership Team, People Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, People Analytics, Legal, and other cross-functional partners to align compensation programs with eBay’s business objectives, talent strategy, and compensation philosophy.

Reporting to eBay’s VP, Total Rewards, Global Mobility, and M&A, you will lead a high-performing global team of compensation partners who combine analytical rigor with strong business partnership.

What You Will Do

Compensation Strategy & Program Design

Set the long-term vision and multi-year strategy for eBay’s global compensation programs, ensuring our compensation philosophy continues to differentiate eBay in a highly competitive market for talent while anticipating future workforce and regulatory trends.Drive the design, implementation, communication, and continuous improvement of compensation programs globally, ensuring alignment with eBay’s business objectives, talent strategy, compensation philosophy, and competitive talent needs.Serve as an enterprise thought leader on compensation, translating external market trends, competitive intelligence, workforce insights, and evolving regulations into forward-looking strategies and clear, actionable business recommendations.Oversee recognition program strategy and effectiveness, ensuring programs reinforce eBay’s culture, performance expectations, and employee experience.Foster strong collaboration across People, Finance, Legal, Talent Acquisition, People Analytics, regional teams, and external partners to deliver scalable, equitable compensation solutions with measurable impact. 


Business Partnership & Compensation Delivery

Act as a trusted advisor to senior executives, People leaders, and cross-functional partners, helping shape workforce and talent decisions through thoughtful compensation strategies that balance business and people priorities, market competitiveness, sound governance, and employee experience.Navigate complex, ambiguous business challenges by balancing competing priorities, bringing clarity to high-impact compensation decisions, and making informed tradeoffs. Lead compensation partner support for annual and mid-year compensation planning, ensuring strong governance, leader enablement, effective execution, and consistent application of eBay’s compensation philosophy.Advise on compensation-related activities, including strategic new hire compensation, promotions, domestic and international transfers, retention plans, and other critical talent decisions.Drive innovation by leveraging emerging technology, responsible AI practices, and market practices to enhance eBay’s approach to compensation, simplify processes, and improve the employee experience.Partner with Executive Compensation and Total Rewards leadership on executive offers, annual executive pay review, executive separations, and Compensation and Human Capital Committee materials, as needed.Own the compensation communication and education strategy, with a focus on leader enablement, employee understanding, transparency, accessibility, and effective program adoption.


Governance, Analytics & Compliance

Establish and maintain compensation governance, including decision rights, approval frameworks, exception management, program documentation, audit readiness, and alignment with eBay’s compensation philosophy.Define and use compensation analytics, market benchmarks, pay equity insights, workforce trends, and program effectiveness metrics to guide strategy, decision-making, and continuous improvement.Lead or influence job architecture, leveling, and job evaluation initiatives to support scalable organization design, career frameworks, market alignment, and internal equity.Monitor global legal and regulatory developments impacting compensation, including pay transparency, pay equity, incentive compensation, and compensation reporting requirements; partner with Legal and People teams to ensure compliant and equitable practices.Balance global compensation philosophy and governance with locally relevant, compliant, market-competitive solutions across regions.


Leadership & Enterprise Initiatives

Build, coach, and lead a high-performing global compensation partner team, strengthening business partnership, analytical capability, technology-enabled practices, execution discipline, and talent development.Lead compensation-related due diligence, integration planning, and execution associated with M&A activity.Lead, participate in, and partner on broader global Total Rewards programs, projects, and initiatives.


Who You Are

Strategic, curious, and agile leader with 15+ years of experience designing, managing, and evolving compensation programs in complex, global organizations.Trusted advisor and influential partner who builds strong relationships with senior business leaders, People Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, People Analytics, Legal, and cross-functional stakeholders.Strong compensation strategist with deep understanding of broad-based compensation, incentives, market pricing, job architecture, pay equity, pay transparency, and global compensation practices.Data-driven decision maker who uses market data, workforce insights, pay equity analysis, and program metrics to develop clear recommendations and drive action.Executive communicator who can translate complex compensation topics into clear business cases, leadership recommendations, and employee-facing messages.Enterprise leader equally comfortable defining long-term strategy, influencing executive stakeholders, and being hands-on to solve complex problems and ensure disciplined execution.Experienced people leader who can coach, develop, and inspire high-performing global or matrixed teams.Proven ability to lead organizational change, build alignment across diverse stakeholders, and successfully implement transformational initiatives at enterprise scale.Strong project and process leader with the ability to manage complex initiatives, prioritize effectively, and deliver high-quality outcomes in a fast-paced environment.High-integrity operator who can balance governance, business judgment, confidentiality, and client service in ambiguous or sensitive situations.Proficiency with compensation analytics, Excel, PowerPoint, and global people systems.


Additional Requirements

Bachelor’s degree.Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed.


Additional Details

$240,000 - $320,400

The base pay range for all other U.S. work locations is expected in the range below:

The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). rows.title: Senior Member of Technical Staff
rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Senior Technical Staff Member, Applied Research (T27)

San Jose, CA

Position Overview

eBay is looking for a Senior Member of Technical Staff, Applied Research to update the search stack and develop new conversational search and natural language query features. This role involves hands-on work as an individual contributor who can shift between applied research, quick prototyping, production deployment, and close collaboration with engineering and product teams.

This position centers on improving how users convey shopping intent through natural language and how eBay interprets, retrieves, ranks, and responds to those signals in modern search experiences. The ideal candidate blends solid research instincts with practical production skills and is eager to transform new NLP and LLM capabilities into scalable systems that deliver clear customer and business results.

Based in San Jose, the role partners with applied research, search engineering, product, and platform teams to improve discovery foundations and foster richer conversational experiences.

What You Will Own

Build, prototype, and productionize solutions for conversational search and natural language query understandingAssist in updating the search stack across query understanding, retrieval, ranking, and response generation layersDevelop methods for intent understanding, query rewriting, semantic retrieval, result grounding, and multi-turn refinementPartner with science and engineering teams to integrate data-informed approaches into production systems with strong latency, quality, and reliability characteristicsBuild and evaluate NLQ solutions that help buyers express complex shopping needs more naturally and get more relevant outcomesBuild offline and online evaluation frameworks for conversational quality, retrieval efficiency, relevance, and customer impactContribute technical depth on model selection, timely and system build, experimentation, and measurementRaise the technical bar through hands-on implementation, code reviews, build discussions, and cross-team collaboration


What Makes This Role Distinct

This is a highly practical individual contributor role, not a people-management positionSuccess relies on technical implementation, prototyping speed, and the capacity to transform unclear problem areas into functional systemsThe role combines applied research with product-focused engineering, placing a strong emphasis on delivering practical improvements in conversational search and NLQ.


Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical area, or equivalent hands-on experience8+ years of experience in applied research, machine learning, search, NLP, or related engineering rolesStrong hands-on experience building and shipping production-quality ML, NLP, or search systemsDeep expertise in one or more of the following areas:


Dialogue-based search and information retrieval

 NLP, intent understanding, semantic parsing, or query reformulation


Large language model applications for search, assistance, or question answering

 Ranking, retrieval, embeddings, or relevance optimizationStrong coding and system development skills, with the ability to independently drive complex technical work from concept through productionDemonstrated ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs across quality, latency, scalability, and maintainability


Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree such as an MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, NLP, Information Retrieval, or a related field, or equivalent experienceExperience modernizing search or discovery systems in ecommerce, consumer technology, or large-scale digital platformsExperience working on natural language query platforms, conversational interfaces, or LLM-powered product experiencesTrack record of translating research ideas into product impact through experimentation and iterative deploymentStrong communication skills and the ability to guide technical direction across partner teams without formal authority


Location and Ways of Working

This position is located in San Jose, California. It involves close cooperation with both local and remote teams and demands effective interaction across departments and locations.

Occasional travel may be needed for planning, reviews, and partner collaboration.

Why This Role Matters

This role will help build the technical foundations of how conversational commerce evolves at eBay. You will develop systems that let customers search more naturally, express intent more richly, and discover the right inventory with less effort and more confidence!

Additional Details

The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below:

$217,600 - $290,500
