rows.title: Associate Director, Data Engineering
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Our Opportunity

Chewy is reimagining enterprise data for an AI-first future—one where engineers build alongside AI, data platforms actively prevent and resolve problems, and people and AI agents can discover, understand, and safely use trusted data.

We are seeking an Associate Director of Data Engineering to lead Foundational Data within Enterprise Data Systems. You will lead managers and engineering teams responsible for creating the authoritative, reusable data foundations behind Chewy’s data products, analytics, automation, and AI experiences.

This role is not about applying AI to a traditional data-engineering model. You will help redesign that model: embedding AI throughout development and operations, making data understandable to machines as well as people, and replacing fragmented, manual processes with intelligent and increasingly autonomous experiences.

What You’ll Do

Define the strategy and roadmap for Chewy’s foundational data, creating authoritative and reusable representations of the company’s most important business entities, events, and relationships.Reinvent how data work gets done by embedding AI throughout design, development, testing, documentation, deployment, monitoring, and incident response.Make trusted data easy for people and AI agents to discover, understand, and safely use through semantic context, machine-readable metadata, lineage, quality signals, and clear access controls.Create AI-first experiences that guide users to the right data, explain its meaning and quality, recommend next actions, and automate routine work with appropriate guardrails.Move data quality from reactive monitoring toward proactive detection, prevention, and increasingly automated resolution.Simplify fragmented pipelines, models, definitions, and processes while establishing shared engineering and governance standards.Partner with Data Products and Platform Reliability to turn trusted foundations into reliable, intelligent experiences across Chewy.Lead and develop managers and engineering teams, measuring success through faster delivery, greater reuse, stronger reliability, reduced duplication, and increased confidence in enterprise data.

What You’ll Need

10+ years of experience building enterprise data systems, platforms, or products, including significant experience leading managers and multi-team organizations.A track record of transforming complex data environments—not simply operating them.Strong technical judgment across modern data architecture, including Snowflake, dbt Cloud, Kafka, AWS, metadata, governance, and observability.Experience building authoritative data foundations that support multiple products, departments, and use cases.Practical experience applying AI, automation, or agent-based capabilities to engineering, data quality, metadata, observability, or platform operations.A clear point of view on how generative AI changes how data is built, operated, discovered, and consumed.Demonstrated ability to translate ambitious technical ideas into practical roadmaps and measurable outcomes.Exceptional leadership and communication skills across engineering, product, business, and executive audiences.A strong record of developing managers, senior engineers, and inclusive, high-performing teams.

Why You’ll Love This Role

Define what AI-first enterprise data looks like at Chewy.Lead the teams creating the trusted foundation behind Chewy’s data products, analytics, automation, and AI experiences.Move beyond incremental modernization and reinvent how enterprise data work gets done.Develop talented managers and engineers while shaping the next generation of data leadership.Help Chewy use trusted data and AI to serve pet parents better and operate smarter every day.

The base salary range for this role is $154,000 - $265,000.00.

The specific salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate’s relevant experience, education, and work location. In addition, this position is eligible for 401k and a new hire and annual equity grant. C08+ positions may also be eligible for annual bonus.

We offer different types of insurance and benefits, such as medical/Rx, vision, dental, life, disability, hospital indemnity, critical illness, and accident. We offer parental leave, family services benefits, backup dependent care, flexible spending accounts, telemedicine, pet adoption reimbursement, employee assistance program, and many discounts including 10% off pet insurance and 20% off at Chewy.com.

Exempt salary team members have unlimited PTO, subject to manager approval. Team members will receive six paid holidays per year. Team members may be eligible for paid sick and family leave in compliance with applicable state and local regulations.

Chewy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender, citizenship, marital status, religion, age, disability, gender identity, results of genetic testing, veteran status, as well as any other legally-protected characteristic. rows.descriptionText:
Additional Information

Job Number26088355

Job CategoryHuman Resources

Location7750 Wisconsin Ave, Bethesda, Maryland, United States, 20814 VIEW ON MAP

ScheduleFull Time

Located Remotely?N

Position Type Management

Pay Range: $151,100-$244,000 annually

Job Summary 

As part of Marriott’s Change Management and Associate Engagement team, the Senior Director, Change Management and Associate Engagement plays a pivotal role in advancing enterprise-wide transformation and elevating the associate experience. This leader will serve as a trusted change advisor, partnering across HR Centers of Excellence (COEs), including Associate Development, Talent Management, and Organizational Capability, to support the successful design and implementation of high-impact strategies that reshape how Marriott develops talent, builds leadership capability, and delivers learning at scale. 

In addition to leading end-to-end change management and associate engagement strategy across priority initiatives, this position will support the preparation of Board-level materials and strategic updates on behalf of Human Resources. The role demands a high degree of cross-functional collaboration, strategic thinking, and executive presence. The Senior Director will also manage a high-performing team, cultivating a culture of curiosity, courage, and connectedness, empowering team members to grow, challenge the status quo, and work boldly and collaboratively in support of Marriott’s transformation. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

Change Management Leadership 

Lead change management strategy, planning, and execution across global learning, talent, and capability-building programs.  Translate HR and business priorities into comprehensive change and engagement plans that accelerate adoption and sustain impact.  Guide senior stakeholders through the change journey with clear messaging, alignment, and sponsorship strategies.  Build repeatable frameworks and scalable toolkits that support organizational change across disciplines and business units.  Conduct impact assessments, readiness analyses, stakeholder interviews, and journey mapping to inform tailored interventions.  Define and monitor adoption, utilization, and sustainment metrics to measure success and enable course correction.  

Associate Engagement & Communications 

Design and deliver associate engagement strategies for transformational HR and enterprise initiatives.  Develop compelling communications tailored for a range of audiences; from senior executives to frontline associates, leveraging storytelling and digital engagement tools.  Manage internal platforms and communication assets, including MGS presence, DLZ activations, toolkits, and cascade materials.  Integrate data and insights from Talent Analytics to inform messaging and enhance engagement effectiveness.  Equip leaders and people managers to serve as effective communicators and champions of change.  

Executive & Board-Level Support 

Prepare high-impact presentations, reports, and briefings for Board meetings and senior leadership updates, on behalf of the CHRO and EVP, Global Operations Services.  Ensure complex strategies and progress updates are communicated in a clear, concise, and visually compelling manner.  Coordinate input across stakeholders to align narratives and deliver polished, timely submissions that reflect Marriott’s people and operational priorities.  

Cross-Functional Influence 

Serve as a connector across HR COEs and broader business functions to align change and engagement strategies.  Provide coaching and consultation to initiative owners and project teams on change enablement and communications best practices.  Collaborate with regional HR and business teams to localize strategies and support implementation across markets.  

 

Candidate Profile 

Required Experience & Qualifications 

8+ years of progressive experience leading large-scale, enterprise-level change efforts preferably within HR, learning, or talent development domains.  Demonstrated success in driving change for complex, global initiatives such as system implementations or learning transformations.  Strong experience in preparing and presenting executive-level materials, including for Board or C-suite audiences.  Deep knowledge of organizational behavior, stakeholder dynamics, and change communication principles.  Proven ability to consult and influence senior leaders in matrixed environments; hospitality industry experience preferred.  Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in Organizational Development, Business, Communications, or a related field strongly preferred.  

Skills & Attributes 

Expert-level knowledge of change management methodologies and their practical application.  Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on strategic storytelling and executive communications.  Enterprise-wide thinker with an ability to simplify complexity and align cross-functional efforts.  Data-driven mindset; experience using insights to guide decision-making and improve engagement.  Collaborative, inclusive leader with high emotional intelligence and organizational savvy.  Results-oriented, detail-driven, and comfortable navigating ambiguity and shifting priorities.  

 

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Benefits are subject to terms and conditions, which may include rules regarding eligibility, enrollment, waiting period, contribution, benefit limits, election changes, benefit exclusions, and others. Click here to learn more.

Washington Applicants Only: Employees will accrue paid sick leave, 0.077 PTO balance for every hour worked and be eligible to receive a minimum of 9 holidays annually.

Headquarters-based positions are considered hybrid, for candidates within a commuting distance to Bethesda, MD; candidates outside of commuting distance to Bethesda, MD will be considered for Remote positions.

rows.descriptionText:
Location

London

Business Area

Sales and Client Service

Ref #

10045987

Description & Requirements

The Analytics and Sales program is a unique opportunity to develop a comprehensive understanding of our Bloomberg products and clients in the wider context of financial markets. Following our comprehensive training program, you will apply your knowledge by assisting our clients in the Analytics department.

In our Analytics business, you will provide 24/7 support for Bloomberg Professional Service users all over the world and across multiple industries. Reaching us via our Helpdesk using the 'Instant Bloomberg' chat system, clients access unparalleled customer service where we answer their questions and help them maximize the value of Bloomberg's products. On any given day we respond to over 12,000 queries in more than 15 languages. From- educating a portfolio manager on Bloomberg’s risk management solutions to helping a trader use our functionality to discover new sources of market liquidity - the variety of problems we solve is immense.

Bloomberg is constantly innovating, and Analytics plays a key role in ensuring clients are educated on new products and enhancements by proactively working closely to upskill them through technology and delivering on-site training and seminars. We also work in conjunction with Sales to deliver strategic initiatives, supporting product roll-out and onboarding clients. We want to ensure our clients are making the most of our service and using tools and features that allow them to work smarter.

As you deepen your knowledge, you will have the opportunity to enter our sales department. In Sales, we are the face of Bloomberg for our clients. Consultative and entrepreneurial, we manage client relationships, whilst striving to continually grow our revenue by identifying new business opportunities. We spend our time with our clients, understanding their business goals and outpacing their expectations. Guided by curiosity and purpose, we work to understand their workflows and present them with the most appropriate solutions across our range of enterprise offerings.

What’s in it for you? 

You will start by completing our comprehensive Analytics & Sales training program, covering all aspects of the financial markets: industry principles, market players and asset classes - while teaching you all there is to know about the functionality and analytical tools Bloomberg has to offer!

You will join one of our Analytics teams, delivering exceptional customer support to our clients by providing fast and accurate solutions to their queries, while continuing to develop your knowledge through asset class and workflow specialist training.

There are multiple opportunities to further your career across the department or the company, with most Analytics representatives progressing towards opportunities in Sales. You may also develop into a specialized support role in our Advanced Team and in time take on a leadership role.

Who you are? 

You understand the drivers behind market moving stories and events. You are a solution-finder, with a real passion for providing exceptional customer service in a fast-paced environment and a desire to build a career in a client-facing role, you understand the importance of credibility and building relationships!

You’ll Need To Have

 Business fluency in GERMAN, in addition to English (written and verbal) Sponsorship is available for this role. To be eligible you must be eligible for the UK Skilled Worker under the New Entrant Requirements* (see below). A Bachelor’s degree (or above) or relevant work experience Ability to multitask and resolve client inquiries while also proactively identifying sustainable workflow solutions for our clients Demonstrated interest in the financial markets and the aspiration to work in the financial services industry Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills The desire to learn and adapt quickly in a dynamic training and client facing environment The ability to demonstrate resilience and agility in a fast-paced environment A commitment to achieve the highest levels of efficiency and effectiveness Ambition to pursue a client-facing career, with a strong interest in relationship management and sales Outstanding communication skills (both written and verbal) Willing and able to travel around EMEA to meet the business needs of our clients Flexibility to occasionally work weekends or on a bank holiday (weekday off in lieu)

We’d Love To See

 Demonstrated exposure to Python or other coding languages preferable Previous experience engaging with clients in a relationship management capacity Beginner to intermediate experience with excel and/or VBA

If This Sounds Like You

Apply if you think we're a good match. We'll get in touch to let you know what the next steps are, but in the meantime feel free to have a look at: https://www.bloomberg.com/company/.

Where the applicant does not meet the salary threshold for experienced workers, they may be able to meet a reduced threshold as a New Entrant if they meet the criteria.

To be a ‘New Entrant’ at least one of the following criteria must be met:

 Applicant is under 26 on the date of application; or Applicant is working towards a recognised professional qualification in a UK-regulated profession; or Applicant is working towards full registration or chartered status with the relevant professional body for the job they are sponsored for; or Applicant’s most recent permission, other than as a visitor, was under the Student route (within last 2 years) and the course has finished (or will finish within 3 months); or Applicant’s most recent permission, other than as a visitor, was under the Graduate route (within last 2 years).

rows.descriptionText:
Location

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg runs on data. Our products are fueled by powerful information. We combine data and context to paint the whole picture for our clients, around the clock - from around the world. In Data, we are responsible for delivering this data, news, and analytics through innovative technology - quickly and accurately. We apply problem-solving skills to identify workflow efficiencies and implement technology solutions to enhance our systems, products, and processes.

Our Team

Data AI contributes to the building of Bloomberg’s AI-enhanced products at scale by curating model training data and enhancing how our internal processes use AI. We provide evaluation and annotation frameworks connecting natural language processing and human judgment in order to elevate the quality, intelligence, and usability of the data that drives our products.

By investing in AI at a strategic level, we expand our practice of engaging with AI to one that is embedded across Data. Our internal processes to take advantage of new AI technologies and strengthen Data’s role in providing robust domain expertise and influential data artifacts to Bloomberg’s products. As a result our clients will continue to have high quality data and access to new types of datasets.

What’s The Role

The Data Product Owner serves as the strategic leader responsible for transforming business operations through data and AI. By aligning product, engineering, and operational partners around a shared vision, they define and deliver the data capabilities that enable intelligent automation, operational scale, and continuous improvement.

This role goes beyond managing requirements to shape how the organization uses data as a strategic asset. Through workflow optimization, process simplification, and the thoughtful application of AI, the Data Product Owner drives solutions that increase efficiency, improve quality, and create sustainable business value.

Success in this role is measured by the organization's ability to operationalise data and AI at scale, turning complex business challenges into streamlined, reliable, and measurable outcomes.

We’ll Trust You To

Own and evolve scalable frameworks and sophisticated strategies for instruction and evaluation task design, ensuring datasets remain fit-for-purpose for complex Generative AI behaviorsAlign data frameworks and evaluation strategies with overarching product objectives to guarantee trustworthy, consumable intelligence that supports actionable user decisionsAct as the primary multi-functional liaison, driving alignment between Product, Engineering, and Data teams to translate technical complexities into actionable insightsPartner with multi-functional teams to define product-aligned requirements and reusable evaluation rubrics, ensuring outcomes meet rigorous Data Quality standardsDrive the strategic evolution of our evaluation infrastructure by pioneering reusable, automated frameworks that consistently accelerate multi-functional product delivery

You’ll Need To Have

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Business, Economics, Accounting, STEM or degree-equivalent qualificationsA minimum of four years of demonstrated experience in data management concepts, including data quality, modeling, and random samplingExtensive experience using data visualization tools such as Tableau or Qlik Sense to communicate sophisticated results to partners in a clear, concise mannerDemonstrable experience in Data Profiling/Analysis using tools such as Python, R, or SQLPast project/experience analyzing financial datasets or demonstrable experience working on financial market conceptsA logical approach to problem-solving with the ability to resolve complex annotation and data-architectural challengesKeen interest in and familiarity with generative AI frameworks and the requirements of Agentic AIExcellent stakeholder management and project leadership skills, with a demonstrable ability to evaluate design trade-offs and seamlessly translate technical complexities between Engineering, Product, and Data teams.Experience in data management concepts such as data quality, data modeling, and data engineering

We’d Love To See

DAMA CDMP or DCAM certificationsExperience in using Bloomberg Data, Bloomberg Terminal, and/or enterprise financial data productsInterest in solving problems and developing data-driven methodologies for high precision & high recall anomaly detectionPast project experience using Agile/Scrum methodologies to manage complex data lifecyclesExperience customizing or developing annotation interfaces using Javascript or HTML.

Description & Requirements

Our Team 

Bloomberg’s Portfolio & Risk Analytics business delivers some of the industry's most sophisticated risk management, valuation, and investment analytics solutions to leading asset managers, pension funds, insurers, hedge funds, and sovereign institutions around the world.

Built on Bloomberg’s market-leading pricing engines, derivative libraries, and data infrastructure, our solutions help investment professionals value complex instruments, measure market and counterparty risk, streamline enterprise workflows, and make better portfolio decisions in real time.

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Job Function: 

Supply Chain Planning

Job Sub Function: 

Integrated Business Planning

Job Category:

People Leader

All Job Posting Locations:

Leeds, West Yorkshire, United Kingdom

Job Description:

Job Title: IBP Lead: Spine, Robotics & Power Tools

GCF: 26

Job Description

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an IBP Lead to join the UK DePuy Synthes business at a pivotal time in our evolution as a more focused, standalone orthopaedics company. This role will play a critical part in connecting commercial ambition, customer need, inventory discipline and supply chain execution — helping ensure the right products, instruments and investment are available where they are needed most.

Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopedics business to establish a standalone orthopedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.

In this role, you will lead investment and supply planning for the Spine, Robotics & Power Tools business, translating commercial strategy into robust demand signals, capital plans and inventory decisions. You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Regional Supply Chain and Global Planning teams to balance growth, service, inventory and cost — supporting customer outcomes while strengthening business performance. The role requires curiosity, pace, commercial judgement and the confidence to challenge how we work today.

Key Areas Of Responsibility:

Partner with Commercial, Finance and Supply Chain leaders to ensure capital expenditure and inventory decisions support growth priorities, customer commitments and financial targets.undefinedLead monthly engagement with field sales teams to build investment plans that are commercially grounded, financially disciplined and netted against under-utilised assets.undefinedConvert local investment plans into clear upstream demand signals that are accurately reflected in Global Demand Planning systems.undefinedCoordinate network capacity planning with UK and EMEA warehouses and kitting branch plants to enable on-time consignment shipments to hospitals in line with agreed investment plans.undefinedAct as a trusted business partner to the Commercial organisation, ensuring customer and commercial investment needs are planned, prioritised and delivered through the end-to-end supply chain.undefinedOptimise consignment stock levels through deployment planning, supporting inventory reduction, improved utilisation and service reliability.undefinedManage the consignment order book proactively, identifying supply gaps early and working with the International Deployment Group to expedite, unblock and resolve issues.undefinedDrive effective use of consignment sets available in Loaners, UK Kit Build and regional hubs, with particular focus on under-utilised assets.undefinedLead IBP alignment meetings for the business units in scope, creating clear visibility of demand, risks, trade-offs and decisions required with Business Unit Directors and their teams.undefinedChampion simplification, digital enablement and continuous improvement, using data, analytics and emerging technology to improve decision quality, visibility and speed.undefinedAct as a cross-functional connector across Customer Services, Commercial, Deliver, Finance, Global Planning and Regional Supply Chain, building alignment around shared priorities.

What Success Looks Like:

Clear, insight-led investment plans that support commercial priorities and customer needs.Stronger alignment between sales ambition, inventory choices and supply execution.Improved visibility of risks, trade-offs and decisions required across the IBP cycle.A culture of ownership, constructive challenge, collaboration and continuous improvement.Practical use of digital tools and analytics to simplify work and improve outcomes.

Education And Qualifications:

Educated to degree level, ideally in Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Engineering or a commercially orientated subject.Minimum 3–5 years’ experience in planning, sourcing, supply chain, S&OP, IBP or commercially connected business planning.

rows.title: Senior Research Consultant – Primary Research
rows.descriptionText:
The Senior Consultant on the Primary Research team will be ready to take a step up in developing client relationships, is well-versed in strategy, primary research methodologies and design, and is eager to develop great consumer and market research.

Candidates should come into this role with at least five years of experience and will be asked to demonstrate skills in critical thinking, be skilled at presenting to groups, display poise under pressure, and have the ability to manage multiple projects. Candidates must have the ability to design, execute and analyze proprietary quantitative and qualitative studies on our client’s behalf, creating actionable, data-driven insights.

This is a Hybrid position based in Chicago.

What You Will Be Doing 

Data Synthesis and Insights Generation:Utilizing advanced analytical techniques to analyze complex datasets and extract meaningful insights.Rapidly organizing information, drawing conclusions, identifying patterns, and succinctly communicating key points.Presentation:Presenting findings to clients in a clear and compelling manner, facilitating discussions and addressing client queries.Crafting a tight strategic narrative and providing solid recommendations.Welcoming public speaking opportunities beyond client work, such as industry events, special Mintel initiatives, and writing articles/blogs.Collaborating:Working with account managers and the greater consulting team to win business and build client relationships.Working collaboratively across several different Mintel divisions such as sales, marketing, research analytics, and operations to deliver best-in-class custom work to our clients. Engaging with ClientsServing as the main point of contact for clients, communicating effectively with a wide range of industries (e.g., manufacturers, retailers, and advertisers) and positions (Directors, VPs, and C-suite).Building and maintaining strong client relationships, ensuring client satisfaction and loyalty.Research Project ManagementScoping client briefs using second and third level questioning to deeply understand client need.Designing and pitching the most appropriate Mintel Consulting solution for each client challenge.Leading the execution of custom research projects, including coaching the project team and managing timelines and budgets to ensure high-quality deliverables tailored to meet client needs.Managing research projects across multiple industries from kick-off to completion, including: questionnaire design, data analysis, and final reporting.Analyzing complex data to provide insightful implications and actionable recommendations within the context of the client’s business objective and competitive environment.Staying updated on industry trends, market dynamics, and competitor landscapes.Displaying the ability to innovate (e.g., developing new products/services with clients, new ways of working in Mintel, developing new research tools).
You will be expected to work effectively both independently and collaboratively with a team in a consultative setting, multi-tasking on several projects at once to effectively meet all deadlines. You will be expected to peer mentor Consultants when collaborating. We are looking for someone who exhibits strong analytical capabilities, pays close attention to detail and demonstrates excellent professional writing and communication skills. You should have a high level of proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint with at least 5 years of experience managing primary custom marketing research projects.

Who We Are Looking For

Commercially-Minded: You have a demonstrated talent for abstract thinking, spotting trends and patterns, an instinct for commercial opportunities, and a nuanced understanding of consumer insights are critical.A Storyteller: You are a lateral thinker, an intuitive dot-connector, and have experience weaving compelling narratives through data across a wide range of categories.Data-Driven: You have solid familiarity with most forms of quantitative and qualitative research methodologies and working knowledge of when and how to apply them to a given client challenge. You should have expertise working with complex data sets. Strong data analysis and Excel skills a must. Experience with tools such as Q, SPSS, SAS or other cross-tabulation and statistics tools are strongly preferred.Naturally Curious: You are always drawn to knowing the “why” behind things and great at navigating client conversations, asking second and third level questions to get at the heart of clients’ challenges and goals.An Influencer: You have experience with and expertise in primary research methodologies and the energy, intellect, humility and passion that draws people to wanting to learn more from you.A Great Communicator: You are able to visualize strategic thought in evocative and engaging presentations, delivered with confidence and authority and can adapt your communication style to suit each client and internal business partner.A Collaborator: You take pride in the team you are a part of and the work you produce. Cultivating professional relationships with your colleagues is important and you are constantly finding innovative and unique ways to create an exceptional work environment.

Alongside salary, Mintel offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical/dental/vision insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, employer paid life and disability insurance, 401(k) with employer match and paid time off. We are invested in our employees' wellbeing which is why we also offer flexible working hours, ClassPass subsidy, mental health benefit through Modern Health, paid volunteer time off, paid birthday leave and paid parental leave.

Ability to break down challenging problems into manageable components and derive actionable insights. Testing & Deployment

Develop business test scenarios, test scripts, and test data requirements.Support Unit Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Business Simulation activities.Assist testers in translating business requirements into expected test outcomes.Support defect triage, resolution validation, and regression testing.Partner with Change Management and Deployment teams to support business readiness and go-live activities.

Stakeholder Engagement & Change Management

Build strong relationships with business stakeholders across regions and functions.Facilitate workshops and process discussions to achieve alignment and decision-making.Support organizational change management efforts through communication, training input, and business readiness activities.Communicate risks, dependencies, and escalation requirements effectively.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Operations Management, Information Systems, or related field.Minimum 5 years of experience in Supply Chain Planning, Procurement, Manufacturing, or related business functions.Strong understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes and process interdependencies.Experience participating in ERP implementations, preferably SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.Demonstrated experience translating business requirements into functional specifications or user stories.Experience supporting Agile delivery methodologies and backlog management.Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.Excellent verbal, written, and facilitation skills.

Purpose

The Manager, Data Quality is accountable for improving the integrity of data across the One Data Platform (ODP). The role leads data quality operations, business-rule validation, data profiling, monitoring, and issue remediation to ensure enterprise data products are accurate, complete, consistent, timely, and fit for use in reporting, analytics, artificial intelligence, and business decision-making. This role provides functional leadership for delivery partners, establishes priorities, develops team capabilities, and is accountable for the quality and timeliness of data quality services across ODP.

The Manager partners with commercial business teams, data product owners, master data management, data governance, analytics teams, and external data providers to establish ownership, embed preventive controls, resolve recurring issues, and improve platform trust and adoption across J&J Innovative Medicine

Job Description To Follow

The Associate Director, Cross TA Clinical Risk Management, works with the trial teams and/or Program teams to coordinate the identification, assessment, and mitigation of quality risks that could impact on trial data integrity, patient safety, well – being, or rights. Throughout the duration of the trial/program, this Associate Director executes data-driven, risk-based trial oversight activities to deliver quality in the execution of clinical trials (and/or programs), compliance with regulatory requirements and internal procedures, and to maintain a continued state of inspection readiness.

Key Responsibilities

Actively and independently participates in all study activities, contributing to the identification and assessment of key risks in the clinical protocol/set-up and advising clinical team members on effective mitigation strategies for complex clinical trials, compounds and programs. Leads regular review of risk areas in collaboration with Risk Owners, to evaluate progress of risk mitigations and risk reduction, and to identify potential new risks or additional mitigation needs (trial and/or compound, as assigned). Maintains CQP (Clinical Quality Plans) in quality repository to facilitate regular progress reviews of quality support services in addition to risks and mitigationsIndependently drives quality risk monitoring reviews and coaches others on risk monitoring and mitigation reviews Communicates and facilitates risk updates to R&D colleagues as part of the regular review cycle through Quality Working Groups and Governance Fora, as applicable (trial and/or compound, as assigned). Highlight new potential systemic risk to RDQ CRM management. Develops and ensures a consistent interpretation of issues that require quality investigations Provides guidance for significant quality issues (SQI) per corporate standards and escalates SQI to senior R&D management. In collaboration with partners in RDQ, provides advice on the development and implementation of Corrective and Preventative Action (CAPA) Plans and Effectiveness Checks (Self - Identified, Inspection, Audit) Drives ongoing inspection readiness activities with trial teams to develop inspection narratives, identify and prepare sites of interest for inspection (including, pre-inspection visit support), ensure availability of key documents/records and coordinates mock inspection in collaboration with Regulatory Compliance teams. Provides support for Investigator, Sponsor-Monitor and third-party inspections including post inspection supportProvides independent advice on questions related to research quality and compliance from clinical teams in collaboration with other Quality Professionals and Subject Matter Experts to ensure consistent interpretation of international regulations and policy. Participates in Clinical risk Management, cross R&D quality, cross functional and cross sector working groups to develop or refine processes, tools, and systems that deliver innovative quality solutionsProvides training and coaching to peers and new employees, as needed

Qualifications

About Us

Assembly is a global omnichannel media agency that combines data, technology, and talent to drive growth for the world's leading brands. We bring together data, performance, creativity, and innovation to create smarter marketing solutions and measurable business outcomes.

Overview

Assembly is seeking a strategic, influential, and highly visible Director of Brand & Communications to elevate and protect the Assembly brand globally.

Reporting to the Global SVP of Brand, this role will lead the development and execution of Assembly's global brand strategy, corporate communications, thought leadership initiatives, executive visibility programs, and industry engagement efforts. The Director will play a critical role in shaping how Assembly is perceived by clients, employees, prospective talent, industry partners, and the broader marketplace.

This individual must be an exceptional storyteller, writer, and communicator with proven experience developing executive narratives, authoring thought leadership content and white papers, representing brands at industry events, and delivering compelling presentations to both internal and external audiences.

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and highly collaborative global environment.

Responsibilities

Brand Strategy & Positioning

 Reporting to the Global SVP of Brand to implement and execute Assembly's global brand strategy and positioning across the four regions, with North America being the focus.  Ensure consistent brand messaging and visual identity across all markets, channels, and stakeholder groups.  Develop compelling narratives that communicate Assembly's vision, values, capabilities, and competitive differentiation.  Act as a brand steward, ensuring all communications align with Assembly's strategic direction. 

Corporate Communications

 Lead internal and external communications initiatives that strengthen brand reputation and engagement, supporting the appropriate communication of executive voices to the global business, to a generation that consumes and receives messages different from any that have come before.  Develop executive communications, key messaging frameworks, company announcements, and strategic communications plans to reach existing and talent we want to attract – make Assembly a go to destination  Support organizational change, business transformation, and major company initiatives through effective communication strategies.  Collaborate with regional and functional leaders to ensure alignment and consistency of messaging globally. 

Thought Leadership & Content Development

 Lead Assembly's thought leadership strategy across industry, client, and media audiences.  Research, write, and oversee the development of:  White papers  Industry reports  Executive articles  Opinion pieces  Case studies  Client-facing insights  Conference presentations  Partner with subject matter experts across Media, Data, Technology, Commerce, and Analytics to translate complex topics into compelling content.  Maintain a strategic editorial calendar that supports brand and business objectives. 

Executive Visibility & Public Speaking

 Build and manage executive visibility programs for Assembly leadership.  Identify opportunities for speaking engagements, conferences, industry panels, webinars, podcasts, and media appearances.  Support senior leaders with presentation development, speech writing, talking points, and keynote content.  Serve as a visible brand ambassador capable of presenting Assembly's vision, capabilities, and thought leadership to internal and external audiences.  Represent Assembly at industry events and networking opportunities. 

Public Relations & Industry Influence

 Partner with PR agencies and media partners to strengthen Assembly's market presence alongside key identified talent  Develop proactive media and analyst relations programs. Job Description To Follow

The Associate Director, Cross TA Clinical Risk Management, works with the trial teams and/or Program teams to coordinate the identification, assessment, and mitigation of quality risks that could impact on trial data integrity, patient safety, well – being, or rights. Throughout the duration of the trial/program, this Associate Director executes data-driven, risk-based trial oversight activities to deliver quality in the execution of clinical trials (and/or programs), compliance with regulatory requirements and internal procedures, and to maintain a continued state of inspection readiness.

Key Responsibilities

Actively and independently participates in all study activities, contributing to the identification and assessment of key risks in the clinical protocol/set-up and advising clinical team members on effective mitigation strategies for complex clinical trials, compounds and programs. Leads regular review of risk areas in collaboration with Risk Owners, to evaluate progress of risk mitigations and risk reduction, and to identify potential new risks or additional mitigation needs (trial and/or compound, as assigned). Maintains CQP (Clinical Quality Plans) in quality repository to facilitate regular progress reviews of quality support services in addition to risks and mitigationsIndependently drives quality risk monitoring reviews and coaches others on risk monitoring and mitigation reviews Communicates and facilitates risk updates to R&D colleagues as part of the regular review cycle through Quality Working Groups and Governance Fora, as applicable (trial and/or compound, as assigned). Highlight new potential systemic risk to RDQ CRM management. Develops and ensures a consistent interpretation of issues that require quality investigations Provides guidance for significant quality issues (SQI) per corporate standards and escalates SQI to senior R&D management. In collaboration with partners in RDQ, provides advice on the development and implementation of Corrective and Preventative Action (CAPA) Plans and Effectiveness Checks (Self - Identified, Inspection, Audit) Drives ongoing inspection readiness activities with trial teams to develop inspection narratives, identify and prepare sites of interest for inspection (including, pre-inspection visit support), ensure availability of key documents/records and coordinates mock inspection in collaboration with Regulatory Compliance teams. Provides support for Investigator, Sponsor-Monitor and third-party inspections including post inspection supportProvides independent advice on questions related to research quality and compliance from clinical teams in collaboration with other Quality Professionals and Subject Matter Experts to ensure consistent interpretation of international regulations and policy. Participates in Clinical risk Management, cross R&D quality, cross functional and cross sector working groups to develop or refine processes, tools, and systems that deliver innovative quality solutionsProvides training and coaching to peers and new employees, as needed

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Location

New York

Business Area

Data

Ref #

10053235

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg runs on data. Our products are fueled by powerful information. We combine data and context to paint the whole picture for our clients, around the clock - from around the world. In Data, we are responsible for delivering this data, news, and analytics through innovative technology - quickly and accurately. We apply problem-solving skills to identify workflow efficiencies and implement technology solutions to enhance our systems, products, and processes.

Our Team

The Entities Data team is responsible for Bloomberg’s core entity and issuer reference data—a foundational component of the financial data ecosystem. Entity data uniquely identifies and defines legal and operating entities such as public and private companies, government bodies, investment vehicles, and corporate structures. It provides critical linkages between datasets and is crucial for use cases including regulatory compliance, risk modeling, investment analysis, counterparty exposure, and ownership research.

This data powers a wide range of financial applications—from mapping issuers to securities and understanding corporate hierarchies, to identifying exposure to private market entities and aggregating risk at the parent or group level. Maintaining accurate, timely, and scalable entity data is crucial for client trust and operational efficiency, and as such, we are undergoing a strategic modernization of our platform to support new capabilities and emerging market needs.

The Role

We are seeking a Data Product Owner to lead the strategy, development, and evolution of Bloomberg’s Entity and Issuer data products. You will be accountable for the overall value delivery of the dataset—ensuring it meets the current and emerging needs of Bloomberg clients, aligns with internal product goals, and adheres to high standards of quality, transparency, and usability.

You will evaluate and prioritize improvements to the dataset based on feedback from clients, internal consumers, and subject matter experts. You will create and maintain a comprehensive delivery roadmap that balances short-term enhancements with long-term innovative goals. Working in close partnership with Engineering, Data, and Product Management teams, you’ll drive initiatives that modernize the dataset, improve delivery mechanisms, and support advanced analytical capabilities across platforms.

We'll Trust You To

Own the end-to-end strategy and roadmap for the Entity data, balancing technical modernization with business impact. Define the vision of what a fit-for-purpose Entity data product looks like and ensure its continuous alignment with evolving industry use cases. Lead discovery and prioritization activities to evaluate dataset needs—including structural, quality, coverage, and delivery enhancements. Translate internal and external clients feedback into actionable product requirements and define acceptance criteria for new features. Coordinate with Engineering and Core Product to deliver iterative improvements, manage technical dependencies, and ensure high performance and scalability. Define and supervise data product health metrics such as completeness, freshness, linkages, and fitness for consumption. Champion the importance of Entity data across Bloomberg, helping internal teams design and deliver better data experiences. Stay current on market trends, regulatory changes related to reference data and entity resolution. 

You'll Need To Have

4+ years working within the domain of financial data, with domain knowledge of Entity and Reference Data, including how it is built, maintained, and consumed in financial markets. Proven experience as a Data Product Owner or Product Manager working with large-scale datasets or data platforms. Description & Requirements

We are a team of technologists that provides Functional Integration solutions as a product to our clients across various financial institutions, as well as software infrastructure within Bloomberg. Our clients are primarily financial institutions in the capital markets, and the Bloomberg products they typically use include market data, trading systems, portfolio solutions, and risk analytics.

Functional Integration solutions are among the most commonly used software offerings in EPP, as they serve as the primary systems for transferring bulk data files between our clients’ applications and Bloomberg analytics. The files processed by these systems contain business-critical financial data such as clients’ positions, transactions, private securities, and pricing information. The number of files handled daily is very large and growing rapidly. Therefore, one of the main goals of the engineering team is to provide stable and scalable backend systems leveraging cloud-based object storage, distributed systems, and microservice architecture. There is also a strong focus on full-stack development so that we can provide sophisticated user interfaces to our customers, as well as web-based tooling for the Bloomberg Enterprise Service team to support clients’ complex workflows involving data mapping, data enrichment and overrides, encryption, and decryption.

Our technologies

rows.descriptionText:
About Startpage

Startpage is System1's flagship privacy technology brand, serving millions of users worldwide with private search and browsing experiences built around privacy, trust, and user choice.

Founded in the Netherlands and built on privacy-by-design principles, Startpage has grown into one of the world's leading privacy-focused search platforms. Today, Startpage is a profitable, scaled global consumer internet business with meaningful revenue, EBITDA, and a loyal international user base.

As consumers become increasingly aware of how their data is collected and used online, Startpage is uniquely positioned to become the trusted alternative for users seeking a safer, more private web experience.

The Opportunity

Search is undergoing its most significant evolution in decades. Advances in AI are changing how consumers discover information, how platforms compete for attention, and how digital businesses create value.

Startpage is uniquely positioned to capitalize on these shifts as a trusted privacy-first alternative serving millions of users worldwide.

We are seeking a General Manager to lead the next phase of Startpage's growth by expanding our user base, strengthening our brand, accelerating product adoption, deepening user engagement, and driving profitable growth.

The successful candidate will understand how emerging technologies, including AI, are reshaping consumer behavior and will help ensure Startpage continues to innovate while remaining true to its privacy-first mission.

This role is ideal for a consumer internet operator who has successfully scaled digital products through growth, product marketing, partnerships, and operational excellence. You should be equally comfortable discussing acquisition economics, retention cohorts, brand positioning, distribution strategy, monetization, and product priorities.

You will operate with an owner mentality, running Startpage as a standalone business while leveraging the scale, resources, and infrastructure of System1.

Core Mandate

 Accelerate global user growth, engagement, user retention, activation, and lifetime value Strengthen Startpage's position as the leading privacy-focused search and browsing platform Expand distribution through strategic partnerships and platform integrations Grow revenue and profitability through disciplined product and commercial execution Build a world-class consumer growth organization across product, marketing, analytics, and partnerships

This position is an onsite role requiring you to work in our headquarters located at 4235 Redwood Ave. Los Angeles, CA 90066.

Business Leadership & P&L Ownership

 Own the overall operating plan, strategy, and financial performance of Startpage. Drive sustainable growth in users, engagement, revenue, and profitability. Allocate resources effectively across growth functions and competing opportunities Identify and execute new opportunities for expansion and long-term value creation. Operate with founder-level accountability and ownership.

Growth, Marketing & User Acquisition

 Own global user acquisition, activation, retention, and engagement metrics. Lead cross-functional growth initiatives spanning product, marketing, analytics, and partnerships. Scale acquisition channels while improving efficiency and return on investment. Drive lifecycle marketing programs that improve retention and user lifetime value. Build a culture of experimentation and data-driven decision making. Expand Startpage's reach across key international markets.

Product Strategy & Consumer Experience

 Define and execute the product strategy for Startpage's search and browsing experiences. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Design leaders to deliver compelling consumer experiences that drive acquisition, engagement, and retention. Champion the voice of the customer across all product decisions. Ensure product investments align with business objectives, user needs, and brand positioning. Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends, including AI-powered search and discovery, where they can improve user experiences while preserving Startpage's privacy-first values.

Search & Market Evolution

 Monitor changes in search, browsers, AI-assisted discovery, and consumer behavior. Evaluate emerging technologies and partnerships that can strengthen Startpage's competitive position. Help shape Startpage's long-term strategy as search and AI continue to converge. Ensure Startpage remains relevant as the search ecosystem evolves while maintaining its commitment to privacy and transparency.

Partnerships & Distribution

 Expand distribution through strategic partnerships with browsers, OEMs, publishers, privacy-focused platforms, and other ecosystem partners. Identify, negotiate, and manage high-impact commercial relationships. Develop new channels for user acquisition and business growth. Strengthen Startpage's position within the broader privacy and consumer technology ecosystem.

What Success Looks Like (24–36 Months)

 Sustained growth in DAU, MAU, and search volume Increased user retention and engagement Expanded global distribution footprint Stronger brand awareness and consideration among privacy-conscious consumers Successful introduction and adoption of new search and discovery experiences that strengthen Startpage's competitive position in an evolving search landscape Improved monetization and unit economics Continued growth in revenue and EBITDA Strengthened market position as the leading privacy-first alternative in search

Required

What You’ll Bring:

 8+ years of experience building and scaling consumer internet businesses. Experience leading growth and/or product marketing for a consumer product at scale. Demonstrated success driving user acquisition, engagement, retention, and revenue growth. Strong understanding of lifecycle marketing, consumer acquisition, monetization, partnerships, and brand development. Experience managing meaningful business metrics and operating plans, ideally with direct P&L responsibility. Ability to partner effectively across product, engineering, marketing, analytics, and commercial teams. Strong strategic thinker with a bias toward execution and measurable results. Passion for consumer products and delivering outstanding user experiences.

Preferred

 Experience with search, browsers, consumer subscriptions, digital media, marketplaces, or other scaled consumer internet businesses. Experience leading international consumer products. Experience overseeing both product and growth organizations. Familiarity with how AI is influencing consumer search, discovery, content, or digital experiences. Interest in privacy, trust, and consumer technology.

Ideal Candidate Background

Successful candidates often come from leadership roles within consumer internet businesses such as:

 Search and browser platforms Consumer subscription businesses Digital media companies Creator and content platforms Privacy-focused technology companies Consumer productivity and utility products

Why This Role Is Unique

A profitable, scaled consumer internet business with millions of users worldwide.The opportunity to shape the future of privacy-first search as search and AI continue to evolve.Significant autonomy and direct P&L ownership.The resources and infrastructure of System1 combined with the agility of an independent business.

What We Have To Offer

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg is a global leader in business and financial information, news and insight, and we use innovative technology to deliver trusted data and bring transparency to the financial markets. Our team comprises several key pillars: sales, service, operations, culture and brand. As a department, we are united by a common goal: We create meaningful relationships with clients by understanding their needs and delivering exceptional end-to-end support from sales and implementation, through their ongoing relationship with Bloomberg.

Our Team

We are Bloomberg Enterprise Data - fast paced, innovative and fast-growing. We have worked hard and smart to become the $2.5B business we are today. We collaborate closely with our clients, taking the time to understand their unique businesses while focusing on specific data and technology needs. We have an endless selection of data sets covering all asset types which are available through multiple delivery technologies. This allows our clients to get exactly the data they need, when they need it, in the format they prefer.

Today’s financial institutions operate in an increasingly complex environment where understanding and managing risk is critical to investment decision-making. Market volatility, evolving regulatory requirements and increasingly sophisticated portfolios have created a growing need for high-quality, transparent and scalable risk and investment analytics. Firms need consistent analytics and data across their organizations to understand portfolio exposures, assess potential risks and make informed investment decisions.

Bloomberg’s Risk & Investment Analytics data solutions help clients identify, measure and manage risk across their investment processes. By delivering robust analytics and data that can be incorporated into clients’ enterprise workflows, Bloomberg helps risk managers, portfolio managers, investment teams and senior executives gain greater transparency into their portfolios and make more informed decisions. When investment and risk teams work from consistent, trusted data and analytics, the entire enterprise benefits.

Risk teams will appreciate Bloomberg's ability to help identify, measure and manage uncertainty, particularly during volatile market conditions. Investment teams can leverage analytics to better understand the drivers of portfolio risk and performance, while senior executives gain greater transparency into exposures across their businesses. Bloomberg’s Risk & Investment Analytics solutions provide the data and analytics clients need to support increasingly sophisticated investment and risk management workflows.

Description & Requirements

What we do

Bloomberg is the global leader in financial data, analytics, and technology. Our products power the workflows of financial professionals across research, trading, portfolio management, and risk.

BQuant reimagines the Bloomberg experience by putting code at its core - it brings together the cutting edge of our Data, API, and AI strategies to enable unprecedented customization and time-to-value for our code-aware users, and in a manner that is instantly available. Your Role

As Product Lead for the Data User Experience, you will define and drive the vision, strategy, and execution of the core data and analytics experience within BQuant.

You will be responsible for how users discover, access, understand, and work with data, enabling them to combine Bloomberg data with proprietary datasets to power research, trading and AI applications - with confidence and trust.

Your customers will include both end users and internal teams building workflow-specific solutions on top of the platform, such as backtesting and trading systems integrations. Description & Requirements

Bloomberg’s Quantitative Analytics team is responsible for the design and implementation of modeling analytics that support client pricing and risk management solutions for financial products across the entire suite of Bloomberg products and services, including its terminal with 300,000+ clients, trading system solutions, buy- and sell-side enterprise risk management, and derivatives valuation services. These models include those for pricing derivative products across all major asset classes, including market data; counterparty credit, XVA and initial margin; Value-at-Risk and other Market Risk metrics; Credit Risk models, and Climate Risk models. The team has two recent Risk Quant of the Year winners and is dedicated both to novel research as well as efficient model delivery through modern C++ and Python libraries.

Within the Quantitative Analytics team, the Quantitative Market and Liquidity Risk Analytics group (“QMLRA”) is responsible for all market and liquidity risk related modeling. This includes, but is not limited to, stress testing, including modelling of various stress scenarios for cash and derivatives portfolios, VaR, stressed VaR and various tail-risk measures, regulatory capital calculations, CCAR scenarios, FRTB, SIMM, and liquidity Assessment. The group is responsible for model research and development, as well as model deployment into production in collaboration with our Model Validation, Engineering, and Product Manager partners.

The QMLRA group has an open position in New York for an experienced Market Risk quantitative analyst to support our growing client business. The candidate will be responsible for researching, and prototyping models, documenting models, planning project execution, and coordination of team members.

We Will Trust You To

Research, design, prototype, implement, test, document and support statistical, machine-learning, and econometric Market Risk modelsSupport the integration and release of quant code into production systems in association with our Model Validation and Engineering partnersCommunicate modeling concepts and assumptions to external clients, product managers, sales, the risk product support unit, and engineering teams. This includes writing technical documentation and delivering presentations to a variety of audiencesAssist the QMLRA Team Leader with Market Risk project management. This includes coordination of fellow team members as well as collaboration with Engineering, Product Managers, and Model Validation partnersMaintain Market Risk methodology thought leadership. The Quant Analytics team sometimes publishes research papers in academic and industry journals

You Will Need To Have

Ph.D. or equivalent experience in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, or Quantitative FinanceWork experience at VP level or above (4+ years) at a Market Risk modeling team of a buy-side or sell-side institution, or at the equivalent level at a vendorHands-on experience in Market Risk modeling, understanding of risk measures, familiarity with financial products and derivatives (expertise needed in at least two asset classes), along with fluency in the relevant regulatory and non-regulatory Market Risk calculationsKnowledge of probability theory and stochastic processes, probabilistic and machine learning techniques, statistical estimation and testing, Monte Carlo methods, numerical analysis, and linear algebraExperience with Natural Language Processing modeling techniques, e.g. Sentiment Analysis, Topic Modeling, Text Classification, Semantic Analysis, and Named Entity Recognition. Proficiency with agentic modeling is a bonusProven C++ and Python programming and software engineering skills. This includes code design, implementation, testing and production release, as well as working knowledge of common data science librariesHands-on experience in project management, execution and delivery, and communications with internal and external stakeholders and clients

Strong oral and written communication skills. You enjoy working in teams with other quants, engineers, and product managersPassion about the Capital Markets, Finance, and EconomicsHigh-level of intellectual curiosity and demonstrated capability to generate new and interesting approaches to solving complex problems

Description & Requirements

The energy of a newsroom, the pace of a trading floor, the buzz of a recent tech breakthrough; we work hard, and we work fast - while keeping up the quality and accuracy we're known for. It's what keeps us inventing and reinventing, all the time. Our culture is wide open, just like our spaces. We bring out the best in each other through collaboration. Through our countless volunteer projects, we also help network with the communities around us, too. You can do outstanding work here. Work you couldn't do anywhere else. It's up to you to make it happen.

What is the role?

At Bloomberg, we are committed to delivering timely, accurate, and insightful financial information that supports strategic decision-making across the organization. As part of the Chief Accounting Office, the Consolidations Reporting team plays a critical role in overseeing Bloomberg's global close and reporting processes while maintaining the integrity of the Company's consolidated financial results.

We are looking for a Senior Analyst to join our Consolidations Reporting team. This role is responsible for supporting Bloomberg's monthly consolidated close process, preparing the consolidated close package for the Chief Accounting Officer, and performing analytical review of Bloomberg's financial results. The position offers broad exposure across the finance and accounting organization and will partner closely with Corporate Accounting, Technical Accounting and Financial Reporting, FP&A, and Finance Systems teams to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and transparency of the Company's consolidated reporting.

In addition to accounting and reporting responsibilities, this role will contribute to initiatives aimed at improving reconciliation, certification, and reporting workflows and modernizing Bloomberg's finance and accounting technology solutions.

We'll Trust You To

 Prepare and maintain Bloomberg's monthly consolidated close package for senior accounting and finance leadership. Perform analytical reviews of consolidated balance sheet and income statement results, identifying trends, fluctuations, and areas requiring further investigation. Partner with Technical Accounting and Financial Reporting to support quarterly reporting requirements and provide consolidated analytics and commentary. Support the monthly consolidated close process, ensuring timely and accurate completion of critical reporting deliverables. Coordinate with accounting teams across the organization to ensure consistency, completeness, and accuracy of consolidated financial information. Review intercompany, elimination, and consolidation activities to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with U.S. GAAP. Monitor and improve balance sheet reconciliation and account certification processes, ensuring appropriate controls and timely resolution of outstanding items. Collaborate with Finance Systems and business partners to enhance reporting, close management, and reconciliation processes across platforms including SAP, Oracle, BlackLine, and Workiva. Support initiatives to streamline and accelerate close activities as Bloomberg continues to evolve its financial reporting processes and timelines.

You'll Need To Have

 7-10 years of relevant experience in accounting, financial reporting, consolidations, or external reporting. Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP and financial statement presentation. Experience supporting month-end and quarter-end close processes. Demonstrated ability to perform analytical review of financial results and investigate significant variances. Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet critical deadlines. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across departments and levels of management. A proactive, detail-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and operational excellence.

We'd Love To See

 Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA (preferred but not required). Experience with consolidated financial statements and multi-entity accounting environments. Experience working within large, complex organizations with global operations. Familiarity with SAP, Oracle, BlackLine, Workiva, or similar financial systems. Public accounting experience, particularly within assurance or financial reporting practices. Experience participating in finance transformation, systems implementation, or process automation initiatives.

Salary Range = 110,000 - 140,000 USD Annual + Benefits + Bonus

The referenced salary range is based on the Company's good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level.

We offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans available and offer a range of total rewards that may include merit increases, incentive compensation (exempt roles only), paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability benefits, 401(k) +match, life insurance, and various wellness programs, among others. rows.title: Sales Operations Junior Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
We're not here to add to the noise. We're here to cut through it- with AI that actually works for marketers.

From AI-powered content creation to world-class CMS and the industry's most trusted experimentation platform, Optimizely is the tool modern marketers actually want to use. AI-Ready. Set. Go.

10,000+ brands including H&M, PayPal, and Zoom already get it. So do Gartner, Forrester, and IDC, who consistently recognize us as leaders in MarTech.

But here's the thing about building great products: it takes great people. Our 1,600+ Optimizers across 12 global offices are curious, collaborative, and refreshingly human. We don't do corporate speak. We do real conversations, big ideas, and genuinely care for the work we make together.

If you want to be part of a team that's shaping the future of marketing technology — and actually enjoys doing it — you're in the right place.

Find us on Instagram: @optimizely

Introduction 

Optimizely is seeking a Sales Operations Analyst, Conversation Intelligence to join our GTM Operations team.

Every day, Optimizely generates thousands of recorded customer conversations — discovery and negotiation calls, onboarding and implementation sessions, QBRs and renewal discussions, support interactions, and AI-agent exchanges. Individually they are anecdotes. Systematically captured, tagged and routed, they are the most honest signal we have about why we win, why we lose, why customers churn, and what the market actually wants from us.

This role exists to build that system. You will own how conversation data is captured, structured and turned into decisions across the revenue organization — starting with seller performance and deal health, and extending across the full customer lifecycle.

This is a build role, not a reporting role. You will be the connective tissue between Sales, Customer Success, Onboarding & Services, Enablement, Marketing, Product and our Operations, Technology, Data & Analytics team.

Job Responsibilities

What You’ll Own

 The conversation data foundation

⚬ CI Strategy & Roadmap: Execute Zoom Revenue Accelerator (ZRA) strategy across Sales, CS, and Onboarding.

⚬ Signal Taxonomy & Routing: Build a cross-functional signal taxonomy and routing logic to direct insights to owners.

⚬ Data Quality & Capture Strategy: Track recording coverage, establish quality thresholds, and manage tooling capture strategies.

 Sales execution and performance

⚬ Workflow Transformation & Auditing: Integrate transcript insights into key deal milestones and use Salesforce data to audit deal stages and forecast accuracy.

⚬ Methodology Adherence & Performance: Build scorecards to measure sales methodology on live calls and surface coaching insights.

⚬ Productivity & Win/Loss Program: Scale top-performing rep behaviors and run a win/loss program to identify cycle friction.

 Retention, onboarding and expansion

⚬ CS & Onboarding Workflows: Operationalize CI across adoption, onboarding, risk identification, and renewals.

⚬ Risk & Health Signals: Define early risk indicators to feed health scores and alert CSMs early.

⚬ Expansion Detection: Surface cross-sell opportunities for Optimizely One and route qualified signals to CSMs/sellers.

 Cross-functional intelligence

⚬ Competitive & Pricing Insights: Provide evidence on competitors, objections, and discount triggers to PMM, Deal Desk, and Finance.

⚬ Product & Messaging Feedback: Extract feature requests for Product and deliver ICP/messaging evidence to Marketing.

⚬ Enablement & Risk Flagging: Measure post-enablement behavior, flag off-script commitment risks, and create process docs.

 Platform and AI operations

⚬ Platform & Prompt Management: Build, test, and maintain AI prompt frameworks (e.g., ZRA, LLMs) and optimize the CI tech stack.

⚬ Product Fluency: Maintain functional knowledge of our Opal platform and apply internal AI capabilities to GTM ops.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12 months, you will demonstrate:

⚬ Expanded Coverage: Measurable conversation coverage across Revenue with shrinking blind spots.

⚬ Methodology Impact: Documented methodology adherence that correlates with higher win rates.

⚬ Forecast Accuracy: Improved forecast accuracy via conversation-validated deal stages.

⚬ Proactive CS Signals: Early risk and expansion signals delivered to CS and Onboarding.

⚬ Cross-Functional Trust: A recurring intelligence readout consumed outside Revenue.

Behavioral Expectations

⚬ Process-First Mindset: Strong project management background to build scalable AI workflows in a fast-paced environment.

⚬ Outcome-Oriented: Prioritize work aligning with company objectives and business outcomes.

⚬ Cross-Functional Influence: Operate comfortably across boundaries to align non-direct-report teams.

⚬ Accountability & Problem-Solving: Blameless mindset focused on transparency and preventative solutions.

⚬ Self-Driven Innovation: Continuously experiment, research, and self-teach emerging AI/CI tools.

⚬ Curious & Transparent: Curious about GTM AI tech, maintaining clear communication and healthy work/life balance.

Knowledge And Experience

2+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or GTM Process Strategy, ideally at a SaaS company Conversation intelligence and AI tool fluency: hands-on experience with conversation intelligence platforms (e.g. Zoom Revenue Accelerator, Gong, Clari, Chorus) and modern GTM AI tools, including large language models and prompt engineering Analytical acumen: comfortable turning qualitative conversational data and AI outputs into clear, actionable metrics for leadership Taxonomy and data structuring instinct: able to impose consistent structure on unstructured, messy conversational data Cross-functional delivery: experience running programs that span Sales, CS and other functions Experience with Salesforce or a comparable enterprise CRM
